entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTattoo2_2\",\"Te: Tasalio bids you take a moment to stop and enjoy the calm of the ocean.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTattoo3\",\"Text: When Ngamahu's chosen truly wish to destroy an enemy, nothing can stop them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTattoo3_2_\",\"T: The Ngamahu Tribe believes the Karui will be reforged in a volcano at the end of time.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTattoo4\",\"Text: Hinekora is not the master of Death, but she is its Mother.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTeardrop\",\"Tex:
"T'gnagn iia y r'ngusla ph'tu Tsoatha nga mekghul'an."
 - Indecipherable verse
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTemplarCourtKey\:
Eyes blazing with holy flame, the Pilgrim saw
a great palace descend from the burgeoning sky,
its gates barred against the unfaithful.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestThaumeticSulphit:
Essence of pure thaumaturgy.
Apply with trepidation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTolmanBracelet\":
A craftswoman's ode to
fresh hope, a new love.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTowerKey\",\"Tex:
God will only offer the door.
Man must choose whether to open it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestTukohamasTooth\":
"The belly cannot hunger for what the eyes cannot see."
 - Karui Proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestUnasLute\",\"Tex:
This grelwood heirloom hums softly with latent emotion,
imbued by centuries of songs passed from mother to daughter.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestVaalKeyGem\",\"T: Ancient facets remain warm to the touch.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestValakosJaw\",\"T:
"One day you eat the fish. One day you feed the fish."
 - Karui Proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestVerisium\",\"Tex: A shooting star may bring great fortune.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestVerisiumSpikes\": They are engraved with the runes for 'Authority,' 'Break,' and 'Release.'
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestWingsOfVastiri\":
And mounting her mighty Roc, Garukhan, holy queen of the sky,
descended upon her enemies and their armies of darkness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QuestZigguratDoorKey\: This idol seems strangely shaped, as if made specifically to fit into something.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"QusetEssenceOfTheWate: The last few drops from veins dry as sand.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RainOfChaos\",\"Text\:
<size:27>{Fire filled the sky that night 
Chaos reigned 
Where the shards fell 
All was destroyed 
-Jozen Kasigi, retelling an urban legend of the Cataclysm}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RakiataLineageSupport:
The Tasalio Tribe developed their own Way, seeing
the world not as it is, but as it should be, given its
roiling and endless grace of constant motion.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Rats\",\"Text\",0]: Whoever said 'more is always better' has obviously never met a rat.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Rebirth\",\"Text\",0]:
He shattered Her smile
Scattered the fragments like ash
All she did was laugh
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RigwaldLineageSupport:
"Skothe kept us idle, sitting safe on these islands, while our
brethren remain slaves. We are one and the same! We must
fight! So, I bring you his head. I am now your Wolven King!"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Ring11\",\"Text\",0]: God blesses those who bless themselves.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Ring12\",\"Text\",0]: To truly appreciate life you must be there when it ends
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Ring13\",\"Text\",0]:
"Shavronne held Sanity in her right
hand and Revelation in her left.
Brutus chose the left hand."
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RingB1FlavourText_\",: Preserve the essence, so that it may evolve.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RingB2FlavourText\",\: Grow the flesh, so that it may endure.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RingB3FlavourText\",\: Build the mind, so that it may serve.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RingB4FlavourText_\",: Sharpen the claw, so that it may rend.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RingB5FlavourText\",\: Devour the dream, because we must.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RingB6FlavourText\",\: Seek all that is, so it may become ours.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RitualBossFragment\",: On the edge of existence, he watches with ire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RitualPinnacleEffigyP: Answer the whispers... as they did.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RomiraLineageSupport\:
"Come, my faithful wife," he crooned. "Sit. Eat. I wanted to
reward you for your loyalty. I even cooked this myself..."
She looked 'round for her sons, but hers was the only chair.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RuneAnointFlavourText:
It reached out a long, horrific limb, and touched it
to my forehead. Awareness grew there. The truth.
A window into limitless darkness... and loneliness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RuneConvertChaosFlavo:
Aldur made a choice to share the art of runesmithing
with all those who would seek the craft. He knew it
might be used for ill, even by his own descendants...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RuneConvertColdFlavou:
The first runes ever carved by the hand of man refused
to cool. Aldur trekked to the highest peak of the tallest
mountain, bringing his sword to the primordial snows.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RuneConvertFireFlavou:
The priests had long charted the dance of the stars,
but it was Aldur who brought that meaning to his forge.
Night and day, he wrestled the flames into submission.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"RuneConvertLightningF:
On the highest peak, Aldur discovered the true secret
of runes. They awaited willpower, and command. Raising
his sword high, he received the might of the skies.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SanctumKeyNonQuest\",:
"Take me to the Trial of the Sekhemas.
I will serve."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabAbyss1\",\"Text:
As the hordes of bone and blood and foul magic surge across the Vastiri Plains,
the scant survivors of our akhara agree to your alliance, ash-scarred Ahkeli.
Disorder means death. Order may mean life.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabAbyss2\",\"Text:
Your golems and your leadership have slowed the tide of death, Clayshaper.
The relics of power you bid us find have kept the Vastiri Plains from the brink
of oblivion. The defences of the Maraketh will hold.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabAbyss3\",\"Text:
The Winter of the World has ended at the hands of the Three Sisters. We lay this scarab
upon your ancient grave in thanks for your efforts, Honoured Founder. As you hoped,
the fate of your people will never befall another.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabAbyss4\",\"Text:
The Abyssals creep forth by night and by storm. Their eons underground were not
a respite, but an amassing, and now they number beyond comprehension.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBeasts1\",\"Tex:
Feuding Ezomytes slaughtered your kin, young Agnar, but we pulled you
from the flames. The Order of the Djinn is your clan now.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBeasts2\",\"Tex:
None among us understand the beasts of this world better than you,
honoured Agnar. You will root out the mysteries of wild-artefacts.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBeasts3\",\"Tex:
The Order was your clan in life, Agnar, Beastmaster, but the First Ones call
back their favoured son. The gift of their Visions will pass to another.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBeasts4\",\"Tex:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBeasts4a\",\"Te:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBeasts4b\",\"Te:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBeasts4c\",\"Te:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBeasts4d\",\"Te:
Without an experienced Beastmaster to find them new realms,
the First Ones' ravaging hunt brings them ever closer to Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBlight1\",\"Tex:
We pulled you from the raging ocean, young Dhunan,
but we cannot return you to your home. The Order of the Djinn
offers you a place on Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBlight2\",\"Tex:
For using the techniques of your homeland to contain
the fungal plague, honoured Dhunan, you shall lead the war
to eliminate it and end the century-cycle of infestation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBlight3\",\"Tex:
Be at rest, Blightmaster Dhunan, on the distant shores of
your home. A dangerous expedition, but one worthy for
he who gave his life to cleanse Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBlight4\",\"Tex:
The fungal plague returns, and its roots have adapted.
The undiscovered Blightheart that Dhunan theorised
must still exist somewhere, yet none remain
with the skill to see to its destruction.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBreach1\",\"Tex:
The Ember-dwellers sought to throw you to their volcanic god, young Omid,
but we caught you instead. The Order of the Djinn is your tribe now.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBreach2\",\"Tex:
We task you, honoured Omid, with the investigation of this mysterious
'Xoph' and artefacts related to rifts in the boundaries of our world.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBreach3\",\"Tex:
Omid, Master Researcher, has left a final commandment upon his death:
the world must never know.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabBreach4\",\"Tex:
The Master Researcher's final commandment has failed.
The High Templar has seen the truth of our situation,
and the world will be undone by his fear.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabDivinationCards:
You were a casualty of callous Karui warfare, ageless Narumoa, but the Order
mended your wounds. You are bound to us now by your own code.

Though your peers fear you, Narumoa, the elders have decided that your
second sight is ideal for handling all artefacts that seek to subvert Fate.

Your centuries of service have been invaluable to us, Narumoa. Go now,
return to Hinekora, and join your ancient kin in the halls of the dead.

Hinekora has sent the world another herald, but this hatungo walks another path.
We are left blinded, and subject to the vagaries of Fate.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabElderRares1_\",:
Your visions led the Azmeri down into a world left abandoned by the Vaal.
They cast you out, young Egrin, but the Order of the Djinn accepts you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabElderRares2_\",:
Speaker of unclean truths, Egrin of the Dark Between Stars.
We curse you whose soul echoes the madness of the void!
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabElderRares3\",\:
Egrin of the Dark Between Stars, Forger of the Sealing Blade,
let your name be redeemed by your unexpected sacrifice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabElderRares4\",\:
We are all equally fools for our childish notions.
That dread force Decay cannot be defeated by self-sacrifice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabHarbinger1\",\":
Your ancestry has been much maligned by history, young Sarina Titucius,
but to the Order of the Djinn, you are born anew.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabHarbinger2\",\":
For deciphering the language of the inscrutable ones, honoured Sarina,
we charge you with investigating their intent in our land.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabHarbinger3\",\":
For your valour beyond the Gate, Sarina Titucius, we honour you with the first
Gilded Scarab awarded while its recipient still lives. Remain vigilant.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabHarbinger4\",\":
The thousand year truce has faltered, for the inscrutable ones have imprisoned their own God.
Should they invade again, there will be no warning.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabLegion1\",\"Tex:
Your faith and our Order are not in opposition, young Eutychus. 
Let this be the start of a new era of cooperation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabLegion2\",\"Tex:
As our hand in the Chamber, we grant you, Deacon Eutychus,
access to a domain we lack the resources to explore.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabLegion3\",\"Tex:
Given the fate of Deacon Eutychus and the men under Cardinal Sanctus Vox,
let none dare the Domain, lest they too feed that vile hunger eternal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabLegion4\",\"Tex:
As the passage between Wraeclast and the land beyond time's reach is torn open,
we stand on the precipice of eternal war.
And no one remains to hold us back.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabMaps1\",\"Text\:
Consider yourself an orphaned Eternal no longer, young Betucia.
The Order of the Djinn is your family now.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabMaps2\",\"Text\:
For your loyalty and valour, honoured Betucia, we are proud to put
the requisition of dream-artefacts in your capable hands.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabMaps3\",\"Text\:
Betucia, Bearer of the Sealing Blade, the Order of the Djinn survives
because of your sacrifice, but will be forever wounded by your loss.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabMaps4\",\"Text\:
The Sealing Blade has been removed, and the agent of Decay
shall feed upon this world until nothing remains but dust.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabMetamorph1\",\":
Rejected even by the Faridun outcasts, young Saresh, you were cursed to walk the
white sands until we found you. The Order shall command your penance now.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabMetamorph2\",\":
As you explore the vast well of human darkness, Saresh, our Surgeon of the Dead,
remember that the price can sometimes exceed the value of knowledge.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabMetamorph3\",\":
There was a man of bone, rotting flesh, and weeping black, but his name, his
ill-gotten knowledge, and his role in the Order shall be stricken from memory.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabMetamorph4\",\":
Though the Necromancer of Weeping Black fell in the desert by the hand of Garukhan,
his mindless legions remain scattered throughout Wraeclast, with no master to curb their hunger.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabPerandus1\",\"T:
Your people no longer walk this continent, young Revna,
but the Order of the Djinn will give you a new home.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabPerandus2\",\"T:
As you delve into the mysteries of this world, apprentice Revna,
remember to learn from the past, not be consumed by it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabPerandus3\",\"T:
We lay you to rest in the forest deep, Runesmith Revna, so that you may be
forever hidden from the stars which so terrified you in your final days.
May the secret you took to your grave be lifted from your burdens.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabPerandus4\",\"T:
Darkness surges in the shadows of the past. Ancient evils stir. The stars
watch, forever aloof, forever menacing. None remain who know the
secret, so we are defenseless in the face of the unknown.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabShaperRares1\",:
The Peak-dwellers saw you as impure, young Qianga, but the Order of
the Djinn sees you as all the stronger for your uniqueness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabShaperRares2\",:
Bold dreamer, Qianga of the Stars, she of the Celestial Cold! These titles
we bestow upon the one among us whose soul speaks to the ineffable.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabShaperRares3\",:
Qianga of the Stars, Deliverer of the Sealing Blade to the Watchers, go now, and
let your half-dreamt life be troubled by nightmares of achromic hunger no more.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabShaperRares4\",:
The Watchers have gone silent, yet they scream still.
Something lurks among the stars of our dreams, knocking at the door,
whispering with the voices of long lost friends...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabStrongbox1\",\":
Your outlaw camp abandoned you when their surprise attack failed, young Rindwik.
Now that you know we exist, we cannot let you go. You have two choices.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabStrongbox2\",\":
Your people were renegades, Rindwik, but you have proven your loyalty.
You will lead the martial defence of our expeditions.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabStrongbox3\",\":
Master Warrior Rindwik fell to one opponent alone: old age.
Only the greatest soldiers can say as much.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabStrongbox4\",\":
In the absence of a strong martial presence, the renegades rise once more.
Their poisons threaten to cloud the land.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabSulphite1\",\"T:
As the first Brinerot to join the Order, you have much to prove,
young Raethan. We are confident you will succeed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabSulphite2\",\"T:
For harnessing and controlling the power of lightning, you, Raethan,
are now charged with researching this new energy.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabSulphite3\",\"T:
Let him not be called Raethan the Betrayer. His discovery was too important
to keep locked away. Now, for good or ill, it is in civilisation's hands.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabSulphite4\",\"T:
Madness marches in machine form.
Harnessed lightning, grim faces, and cold ambition abounds.
Civilisation will be its own undoing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabTorment1\",\"Te:
Young Tsarsk, you were a broken and forgotten child lying glassy-eyed
in a flesh-pit in Trarthus, but the Order found and cleansed you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabTorment2\",\"Te:
Your tortured soul long kept you isolated from your peers, Tsarsk, but has attracted
new kindred in kind. You are tasked with appeasing these anguished spirits.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabTorment3\",\"Te:
Though you were swallowed by your own darkness, you saved countless others
from eternal misery, young Tsarsk. You were not nothing, as you feared.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabTorment4\",\"Te:
Without a speaker of the dead, the countless anguished spirits only grow in number.
They have no voice, and no hope. The sun darkens with each passing year.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabUniques1\",\"Te:
The Maraketh left you to die alone in the desert, young Sumei, but we
saw the potential in you. The Order of the Djinn is your akhara now.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabUniques2\",\"Te:
As the best of our lorekeepers, honoured Sumei, it is now your task
to investigate the mysterious duplication of artefacts of power.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabUniques3\",\"Te:
Go to your rest now, Sumei, Master Lorekeeper. The Order shall keep
contained the terrible secret that burdened your final years.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScarabUniques4\",\"Te:
The books were burned, and the scribes set themselves aflame.
What secret so terrible could they have discovered?
Though centuries have passed, we must investigate this for ourselves.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ScholarOfTheSeas\",\": I've never come upon a ship I could not command. I have however met sailors that were not willing to be led.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SentinelController\",:
For aeons, ancient constructs have lain dormant,
but now their designs are under your control.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SeraphsHeartLineageSu:
Intricate machinery imperceptibly woven into a
biological foundation. It felt delicate in her hands.
In him, it would be her greatest achievement.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SerlesTriumphFlavourT:
The pinnacle of Serle's work was not a grand artefact.
It was a subversion; a window. He stood upon a peak
and saw beyond mortal limitations, understanding, in
that moment, that so much more was possible...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperFragment1\",\"T:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperFragment2\",\"T:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperFragment3\",\"T:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperFragment4\",\"T:
Enter the crucible. The nexus of
nothingness and equilibrium of eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperKey\",\"Text\",:
I spent my life shining a light on truth...
but some things should remain in darkness,
locked away for all eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment1:
"...It wasn't long before we were met by the Shade itself.
The very essence of the Elder, demanding of me in visions to
tell it why I had returned. But before I could answer,
Venarius stepped forward and greeted the phantom..."

"...Before we knew it, we stood at the base of that blasphemous effigy.
"Pull the sword from my chest." The Elder imposed, and Venarius didn't hesitate.
The earth shook in the face of the Elder's reunion with its body. The true scope of the
Elder befell the High Templar and his men, and as it began to feed, I began to run..."

"...I fear this to be the end. Not just the end for me, but the end of all things. 
The Elder has been freed. Soon it will feast on me... on the rest of the world.
It was too late for me. The Elder had to be stopped. I knew of the shaping powers.
Only I could have a hope at defeating the Elder..."

"...A golden machine was found broken in the ruins of Wraeclast. 
Believing it to contain some dark infernal secret, 
High Templar Venarius asked that I restore it 
and weaponize whatever powers it might contain..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment2:
"...Though the device seemed to be mostly functioning, 
something important appeared to be missing...
...I worked tirelessly in search of answers, until finally, 
at the base of that cruel device, I fell into a deep, deep sleep..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment3:
"...I awoke in the most beautiful of places, and as I wandered this strange new land, 
I felt a growing sense of realization that I was not alone. 
A Shade, a whisper of embodied smoke, spoke to me through thoughts and pictures.
I found myself enthusiastically volunteering information in detail of Oriath..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment4:
"...The Shade knew of the device - a doorway between my world
and the dreamlands. It offered to help me rebuild the missing part, 
to create a conduit between this beautiful land and Oriath. 
All that the Shade asked of me was to return the favour..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment5:
"...Every night, I found myself asleep at the foot of the strange device, 
awoken to the reality of another world within my own.
The Shade taught me how to shape and build things from my imagination,
how to transport such phantasmagorical treasures back into the world of man..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment6:
"...The missing part of the great device had finally been formed.
The Shade requested its one favour. I was shown images of the past,
the Shade as King of the dreamlands, the hateful Watchers of Decay...
It led me deep into a cave, to a statue pierced by a sword..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment7:
"Pull the blade from my chest. Free me!" the Shade imposed.
But doubt entered my mind, and the Shade flew into a fury!
I felt my mind torn asunder as images of murder and mutilation were forced upon me. 
I fled in a panic, cursing myself for ever trusting such a strange creature so blindly..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment8:
"...Months have now passed since the Shade revealed its true nature.
Each morning, I lock myself inside my study, searching for some knowledge 
that might save us. I have found at last, some information on the Watchers of Decay. 
The truth is so unutterable that I hesitate, even now, to write it down..."

"...They called it the Elder. A creature of malignant madness... it cannot be killed.
The Watchers built the device to lock tight its kingdom, bringing with them the
blade - 'Starforge'. A weapon to give the Elder eternal rest. But the Shade...
I must find a way to put a stop to it before it finds a path to freedom..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShaperMemoryFragment9:
"...I've spent every waking hour since, trying to find a way to end this unholy Elder.
Within my secret study, I've begun work on a device of my own, tinkering and shaping.
When I'm finished, this Elder will never bother our world again.
The creature cannot be killed, but maybe... it can be exiled..."

"...Lack of progress on the device has given the High Templar cause for suspicion.
Clapped in irons, I was lead off to the Theopolis prisons for my insubordination.
I must find my way from these chains at all costs. The Elder is coming for us.
Only I can save us from this blasphemy that will soon befall Oriath..."

"...Venarius, that bastard... he marched me through the streets.
His men beat me within an inch of death... I... I told him everything. 
He demanded that I take all of us into the dreamlands, to meet with the Elder.
Using the device, we stepped through, setting foot in the Atlas of Worlds..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ShardOfFate\",\"Text\:
Their whims left unknown,
Their life left for others.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SirusFragment1\",\"Te:
He sought to be the best,
but lost his family.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SirusFragment2\",\"Te:
He sought God,
but lost himself.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SirusFragment3\",\"Te:
He sought a kingdom,
but lost his people.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SirusFragment4\",\"Te:
She sought to bring salvation,
but lost her compassion.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"StruckByLightning\",\:
'Lightning never strikes the same place twice'
is really just wishful thinking.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"StyrnsFerocitySupport:
Each knight who encountered Styrn challenged
him to the traditional duel. One by one, he fought
his way across all of Middengard... and beyond.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"StyrnsMountainSupport:
Bound by his oath to the Runefathers, Styrn the
Indomitable refused to bow to Cadigan the First.
His resistance laid the seeds for future defiance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SupportGemEshLineage\:
"Where life once thrived, now only metal grows, inching
like endless worms through the ash. Where silence fell,
now sourceless thought whispers numbers in the dark."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SupportGemTulLineage\:
"Countless graves glow silently in endless rows that stretch
on unseen. The living lie within, but do not decay, do not
die. Their eyes remain open, their essence stilled, waiting."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SupportGemUulNetolLin:
"The Lords could not breathe, so they grew new lungs.
The Lords could not venture, so they grew new skin.
The Lords were alone, so they grew us, to serve them."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"SupportGemXophLineage:
"They drank until only dust remained. Ate until their gums
bled rust. Such was their greed, the only thing that remains
of the Broken Sun... is the Red Pyre, the Torus Eternal."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TacatiLineageSupport\:
He almost saved the Vaal. His unique poison made it past
the Queen's cupbearers; he had only to direct his anger...
but in her presence, he could feel naught but lust.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_1\",\"Text\:
The First Ones stalk with us
upon this lifelong hunt,
and cast their contempt
upon those that would make us their prey.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_10\",\"Text:
The First Ones hold us
between two sharpened blades.
That should we stray too far from the path,
we find ourselves severed.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_11\",\"Text:
The world of the First Ones is harsh;
We struggle on our bellies to survive.
But that which imprisons us also changes us
And soon we will emerge anew.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_12\",\"Text:
For too long we have crawled in darkness,
scavenging through rotten scraps.
The First Ones teach us to scavenge until we can hunt,
and then never crawl again.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_2\",\"Text\:
The civilised man must wrestle
with the demands of heart and mind.
The First Ones share no such struggle.
For their Spirit is swift and deadly certain.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_3\",\"Text\:
The fire of the hearth is a docile dog,
leashed and tamed.
The fire of the First Ones is a ravening wolf,
wild and free.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_4\",\"Text\:
The First Ones thundered over Ezomyr
upon hooves of grey and black.
The people felt their stamping rage
and cowered as the fury rained down.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_5\",\"Text\:
We have basked in the cloying warmth of servitude.
Now the First Ones harden us
against the numbing chill of despair
so that freedom will not slip through our trembling fingers.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_6\",\"Text\:
I stood among the stones
And called out to the First Ones;
That with tooth and mighty claw,
They should tear our enemies asunder.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_7\",\"Text\:
The Empire poisons our blood with sweet wine.
Poisons our flesh with silk.
Poisons our minds with civil lies.
Poisons our children with servitude.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_8\",\"Text\:
'Sleep when you are weary,' our mothers told us.
'Sleep when you are dead,' our fathers told us.
To the First Ones, the slumbering and the corpse
are one and the same.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman1_9\",\"Text\:
To catch a big fish you need tempting bait. 
And there is no fish bigger than the Empire,
and no bait as tempting as Ezomyr.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman2_1\",\"Text\:
The Hunter faced the First One
and notched his final arrow.
The First One bared its fangs
and savoured its final breath.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman2_2\",\"Text\:
With the will of the first ones in our sinews
we shall tear down the walls of Sarn.
Yet as is the way of the wildlands,
Only the strong may grow stronger.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman2_3\",\"Text\:
It's said to be noble to stand one's ground.
To soak the earth in stalwart blood.
While the First Ones chose to laugh and run
and caper with untamed glee.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman2_4\",\"Text\:
From flesh and ferocity,
the First Ones roamed
through the realm of Spirit,
and into the darkness beyond. 
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman2_5\",\"Text\:
Fear the children of the First Ones.
Let fear shield your back.
And let the dullard speak of bravery
when the First Ones come for him.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman2_6\",\"Text\:
The first ones live where they can, where they must.
They embrace the frost, the storm, the drought.
Waxing and waning, breaking and mending,
living with time and happenstance, as must we.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman2_7\",\"Text\:
The First Ones are the forever ones.
There is no dust of the hourglass in their blood.
No fissures of weariness in their faces.
To drink of their blood is to drink of time itself.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman2_8\",\"Text\:
The Empire hides lies and falsehoods
Behind a mask of politeness and civility.
The First Ones teach us to look through the lies,
And that no beast can truly cover their tracks.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman3_1\",\"Text\:
We Ezomytes are beasts of burden
bearing wealth of an empire on our backs,
growing lean and strong
while our masters grow fat and weak.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman3_2\",\"Text\:
When we free ourselves from the shackles
of civilised existence
we learn to feed and run and breathe
as the First Ones have always done.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman3_3\",\"Text\:
The first ones marked their hunting grounds
with blood and piss.
We have tried to paint our future in words.
Now we shall paint with inks of savagery.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman3_4\",\"Text\:
We grew contemptuous of our past.
Dismissed the first ones as ignorant and wild.
We were fools and naive children
to turn our backs on our inheritance.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman3_5\",\"Text\:
Death met with the First Ones
and demanded they hunt with mercy.
For while pain might delight the mind,
it does not fill the belly.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman3_6\",\"Text\:
Look not upon me with fear, my men.
Though I seem strange, even monstrous,
were you to see with the eyes of your forebears,
your hearts would be filled with wonder.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman3_7\",\"Text\:
We breed thoughts of single mind,
fashion tools of single purpose.
While the First Ones bring to bear
anything that the wildlands provide.
- The Wolven King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Talisman4\",\"Text\",:
The wolf greeted the king,
In the light of the harvest moon.
The wolf offered the strength of the wild,
And the king paid for it in blood.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TangleBossKeyFlavourT:
From the heart of the Tangle, the Eater of Worlds
reaches out for control of the Atlas.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TangleKeyFlavourText\:
The Infinite Hunger awaits in a cosmic stomach where
whole civilisations are digested - but do not die.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TangmazusThuribleLine:
In his roiling fog, their fear becomes form.
Dark truths unveiled by a shroud. They see only
their perception of him, and thus, he is remade.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TasalioLineageSupport:
The Chieftain built a grand waikoama, and boasted that
it could never be sunk. Tasalio grinned, and the waves
rolled in, tilting the ship, cresting higher and higher...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TawhoaLineageSupport\:
A scavenging warrior found Tawhoa meditating in a grove.
"There is only so much jade in this world," intoned the god.
"Take my gift to your tribe. Ironwood will grow for all time."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TecrodLineageSupport\:
The Lich Lords destroyed his body, but with his dying fury,
Tecrod found a way. He lurks deep, in the blood, in the flesh,
in the Well... perhaps walking among them even now, unseen.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TemporaryTutorialSupp: This gem is only temporary, and only for the tutorial.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TestUniqueRing1\",\"T:
"When one stares into the depth of the flavour text
file, one will gain no knowledge, only an addiction
to speculation." - Maligaro, Grand Trolllord
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheAdmirer\",\"Text\": Lucian lost himself in ancient scrolls and found in those scrolls a love whose power bridged a millennium.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheAesthete\",\"Text\:
"Some see our mortal flesh as a limitation. I see it as an opportunity for vast, miraculous improvements."
- Shavronne of Umbra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheArenaChampion\",\": The fight is the easy part. It's the years of training that'll kill you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheArmyOfBlood\",\"Te:
<size:28>{I gave my mind without a fight, 
The twelfth hour I lost control. 
The day is gone but there is light, 
eyes that glow like red-hot coal.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheArtist\",\"Text\",: "Paint, metal, flesh... A true artist does not limit himself." - Malachai the Soulless
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheAvenger\",\"Text\":
Justice comes swift 
Equal to the crime 
Revenge is a gift 
Life for a life 
Eye for an eye
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheBattleBorn\",\"Tex: "No man can best me, no demon can fell me. For I vanquish all with my axe!"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheBeast\",\"Text\",0: To know the monster, you must become the monster.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheBetrayal\",\"Text\: It's sad times we live in when a friendship has a price people are willing to pay.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheBlazingFire\",\"Te: Lethal, untouchable, keen, aflame. Just what I was looking for.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheBody\",\"Text\",0]: They say it is the head that leads, but all must flow through the body at some point.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheBreach\",\"Text\",: Ever get the feeling you're being watched...?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheBrittleEmperor\",\:
<size:31>{"When Voll spared Malachai, accepting his aid in pursuit of Purity, the strongest faith was infected by Corruption and made brittle as glass."
- Victario, the People's Poet}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCacophony\",\"Text: Nothing can be heard above the din or seen amongst the turmoil. The senses are shattered. All is left to fate.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCalling\",\"Text\": <size:32>{Blood flows not just through veins, but through worlds.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCarrionCrow\",\"Te:
From death, life. 
From life, death. 
The wheel turns, 
and the corbies wheel overhead.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCartographer\",\"T:
<size:31>{My son, you lost your way before you arrived.
To never lose you again,
I make a path in my heart.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCataclysm\",\"Text: <size:27>{The mighty warriors traded in blows, the nimble archers in arrows, yet it was the brazen thaumaturgists who would bring catastrophe to all.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCatalyst\",\"Text\: Simple actions can lead the world to an early grave.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCelestialJusticar\: Wrapped in the glory of the heavens, she comes to mete out justice for the fallen.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCelestialStone\",\: Stare into its depths too long, and you may lose yourself entirely.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheChainsThatBind\",\: Scarier than any criminal is an innocent man in chains, for when he breaks free, his revenge will be justified.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheComingStorm\",\"Te: No man may hope to turn back the storm. You can only hope you do not attract its ire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheConduit\",\"Text\": The path to godhood is guided by the hand of sacrifice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheCursedKing\",\"Tex:
The First Ones
may be blasphemy,
but they are
powerful blasphemy.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDapperProdigy\",\": "Many believe murder is a grisly, grim, and grotesque crime. Then there are those who simply make art of it."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDarkMage\",\"Text\:
With staff in hand
and wrath in heart,
your soul and corpse
shall surely part.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDarkestDream\",\"T: A dream from which you cannot awake is nothing other than a nightmare.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDeceiver\",\"Text\: Beware the combatant who shows no confidence, yet still enters the ring, for they are surely hiding something.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDemoness\",\"Text\: Wherever she went, death was sure to follow.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDevastator\",\"Tex: Only a fool tries to contain unlimited power.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDoctor\",\"Text\",: "They said I needed my head examined, but I'd rather just take yours." - Klopek the Cannibal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDoppelganger\",\"T: Upon seeing her face, I am terrified—the moon shows me my own form!
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDragon\",\"Text\",:
<size:28>{Scaly beast of the skies,
watching with his golden eyes.
Shadow that blocks out the sun,
it's too late for you to run.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDragonsHeart\",\"T: They say when a dragon dies, the flesh smoulders and burns until all that remains is the still, white-hot, heart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDreamer\",\"Text\":
<size:29>{A dark note drips 
from the dreamer's lips, 
A honeyed melody. 
We stand, we fall 
on his beck and call, 
for in his dream we're free.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDreamland\",\"Text: All dreams vanish when the dreamers wake.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheDrunkenAristocrat\: The finer the brew, the harder it is to remember drinking it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheEncroachingDarknes: No matter where your dreams take you, Nightmare follows close behind.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheEndlessDarkness\",: Gaze towards the stars, but beware what gazes back.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheEndurance\",\"Text:
<size:28>{Crimson rubies, drops of vigour,
flowing through my veins,
flesh like coal, try to crush me,
diamond is what remains.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheEnlightended\",\"T:
Weaving the six,
a serpent stands tall.
Wearing a crown,
the thousand petals call.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheEthereal\",\"Text\:
<size:30>{"Long ago, people looked to the stars, believing they influenced us. Soon, it will be us who influence the stars."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturge}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheExplorer\",\"Text\: A map is only useful if you know where you stand.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheEyeOfTheDragon\",\:
Some powers are far too great even for the
gods of old.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheFathomlessDepths\": Fall into endless night; a voyage into an ocean of oblivion.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheFeast\",\"Text\",0: Shame what happened to my husband. He had such good taste.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheFiend\",\"Text\",0:
<size:31>{Your era is now,
your power unwavered, 
soon we will see
who the gods truly favoured.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheFletcher\",\"Text\: Let these fine arrows pack a punch.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheFlorasGift\",\"Tex:
Sturdy and strong,
grown from the stream.
The Flora that live here,
A combatant's dream.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheFormlessSea\",\"Te:
Formless might,
Wild beauty tamed,
The brine of gods,
The seas restrained.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheForsaken\",\"Text\: You gave us life and love, more than you could spare. Now you're gone, and we are stranded, alone, cold and without purpose.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheFox\",\"Text\",0]:
"Masters of wit, strength and cunning. To survive the harsh winters, you must be like the fox."
- Ezomyte Proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheGambler\",\"Text\": "I don't believe in karma. If it were real, I would never win."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheGarishPower\",\"Te: Maligaro may have valued function over form, but that did not mute his flair for the dramatic.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheGemcutter\",\"Text: In the hands of a master craftsman, a worthless pebble can adorn the crown of a king.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheGentleman\",\"Text: "Axes and mauls are so uncivilised. A good clean cut to the neck with a sharp blade, that's the Sarn way!"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheGladiator\",\"Text:
The thumb turns down
and the crowd roars, 
they want death 
and the blood is yours.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheHaleHeart\",\"Text: Though the years weakened his mind, his body remained deadly as ever.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheHarvester\",\"Text:
<size:30>{Taste not of their
forbidden fruit.
Theirs is a harvest of
the darkest kind,
twisted, rotten and
damned for eternity.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheHermit\",\"Text\",: The hermit's only friend is the greenery he can find.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheHoarder\",\"Text\": "More! I want more!" - Faendris, the Insatiable
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheHunger\",\"Text\",:
"How many lives have you consumed?" 
"How many times have you blinked?"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheImmortal\",\"Text\:
<size:30>{"Greetings! Just because you think I'm greedy doesn't mean I'm not willing to share. You'll just have to kill me first."
-Grandmaster Dy'Ness}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheIncantation\",\"Te: When there is no other choice, even the meekest whisper can bring about the greatest storm.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheInnocent\",\"Text\: His brother would not atone, so he took his brother's life, and with it, his sins.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheInoculated\",\"Tex: Chaos spread, wreaking havoc and death. They said none would be spared, and yet here I stand.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheInsatiable\",\"Tex: A lust for souls. The urge to kill just to satisfy its thirst. An unbearable burden that would make even the purest heart blacken over time.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheInventor\",\"Text\:
Jump right in, 
But beware 
Of things broken 
Or beyond compare.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheIronBard\",\"Text\:
<size:19>{Fourfold the refrain, fortissimo cheer.
One hundred rent twain, naught left for a bier.
The song rattles on, though hollow a bit.
See the hope is gone, no prize shall ye get.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheJester\",\"Text\",:
<size:25>{Summoned for the King's desire,
soon applause came from the court.
However insanity was his only sire,
so the King's reign was cut short.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheJewellersBoon\",\": The jeweller's true talent is the capacity to see a jewel's beauty before they draw it out.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheKingsBlade\",\"Tex:
<size:25>{"To know for what you fight. To get up again when you've been struck down. To outmanoeuvre someone faster, trick someone smarter, crush someone stronger. That's what it takes to claim the crown."
- Daresso, the King of Swords}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheKingsHeart\",\"Tex: <size:31>{500 times Kaom's axe fell, 500 times Kaom's Heart splintered. Finally, all that remained was a terrible, heartless Fury.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheLastOneStanding\",: The strongest emerge from suffering. The toughest bear the most scars. The sole survivor claims the greatest of rewards.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheLich\",\"Text\",0]: When the dead raise and master their own, the land is truly lost.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheLion\",\"Text\",0]: <size:31>{The Eternals lauded his valour. The Karui relished his defeat. Yet the final thoughts of Marceus Lioneye were naught but lament for his pride.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheLordInBlack\",\"Te:
<size:27>{Thy knee shall bend
in shifting dark,
thy blade shall serve his vigil.
Thy oath shall bind thee
to his mark,
thy flesh shall bear his sigil.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheLover\",\"Text\",0: <size:26>{"I wanted to give you three things. I've given you my eternal love. I've sung to you my most beautiful song. I'd have given you the moon last, but it couldn't be found. I hope you'll accept this instead."}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheLunarisPriestess\":
Embrace the Light,
Await the Morrow,
No more Spite,
And no more Sorrow.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheMaster\",\"Text\",: In a world filled with chaos, he could always seek comfort in the hands of his master.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheMayor\",\"Text\",0:
A ruler is only as powerful as he is wealthy. 
Control the coin, control the empire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheMercenary\",\"Text: Loyalty can be bought. Just make sure you know who the buyer is.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheMetalsmithsGift_\": <size:31>{A month's work, a year's wages, a foolish shortcut through a Rhoa's nest, and a grieving bride-to-be, who never received her betrothed's great gift.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheOath\",\"Text\",0]: An oath once made is an oath never broken. Do not delay in keeping it, for I take no pleasure in fools.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheObscured\",\"Text\: Our world, dangerous as it is, is far safer than what lies just beyond our sight.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheOffering\",\"Text\: Eternal beauty has a cost, one which Shavronne was happy to pay with the lives of others.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheOneWithAll\",\"Tex:
<size:26>{Embrace death to honour the lost,
no fear in life no matter the cost. 
With one of all we are, 
and all of one we trust, 
throughout past, present and future... be just.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheOpulecent\",\"Text: Wealth can, in fact, buy happiness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThePackLeader\",\"Tex: Become the leader you were born to be.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThePact\",\"Text\",0]: "On this day I mark the first of many agreements that I will have with this land and its people."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThePenitent\",\"Text\: <size:28>{First, I gave my wealth, and we went hungry. Next, I gave my land, and we were homeless. Then, I gave my family, and I was alone. Last, I gave my eyes, and all I could dream was mine.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThePoet\",\"Text\",0]:
<size:27>{God had forsaken the land 
And Victario wept.
Corruption consumed the land 
And Victario's tears turned to blood.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThePorcupine\",\"Text: The first quill separates the quick learners from the dead.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThePriceOfProtection\:
To protect her mansion, she would cut a deal with anyone. Anything. 

Something answered.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheProfessor\",\"Text: The academic route to knowledge is wide and well-trodden; but it is the untaught one who scales the mountain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThePuzzle\",\"Text\",: As countless fractures weaken the divide, nightmares seep through from the other side.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheQueen\",\"Text\",0:
The power of the world, 
lies upon your hands.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheRabidRhoa\",\"Text:
"Experiment 22A: Rhoas, when deprived of water, secrete a most delightfully potent toxin."
- Maligaro
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheRealm\",\"Text\",0: If you wish to rush into strange places, be prepared to face strange things.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheRisk\",\"Text\",0]: "There is no right or wrong choice, no best or worst. There are only choices and their consequences."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheRiteOfElements\",\:
<size:29>{A mind as quick as lightning, 
fists as hard as stone, 
a heart that burns with fury, 
and eyes that chill to the bone.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheRoadToPower\",\"Te: A beacon on the horizon; a guiding light, a call for help, or a warning to turn back.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheRuthlessCeinture\":
In combat, a warrior must first be resourceful,
and second, decisive.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSaintsTreasure\",\: <size:31>{Publicly, he lived a pious and chaste life of poverty. Privately, tithes and tributes made him and his lascivious company very comfortable indeed.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSamuraisEye\",\"Te: At night, when the seas are calm, and the skies dark, he can see it. The formless fiend that took his eye, and fractured his mind.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheScarredMeadow\",\": The earth offers nourishment, growth and healing. Unless, of course, the sky has other plans.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheScavenger\",\"Text: Take small pieces of things and then assemble them together
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheScholar\",\"Text\": It is with the smallest of words that we find the largest of truths.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSephirot\",\"Text\: If the path to divinity were simple, we'd all be gods.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSigil\",\"Text\",0:
<size:29>{Three men travel
through the gate;
they carry a protective ward.
A faction conspires
against their fate,
but magic unravels the sword.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSiren\",\"Text\",0:
<size:26>{At the beck and call
of The Siren's hand,
winter ravages
the trembling land,
and the weight of ice that binds
will break the strongest of minds.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSoul\",\"Text\",0]: "Most people only have one. I'm a bit of a hoarder."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSparkAndTheFlame\": When sky meets ground the flames can be found, but who has the will to tame them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSpoiledPrince\",\": A boy who grows up with everything learns to appreciate nothing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheStandoff\",\"Text\: Sometimes your greatest enemy is the only one keeping you breathing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheStormcaller\",\"Te:
If you beckon the
Lord of Lightning,
do not be surprised
when you are struck.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSummoner\",\"Text\: To own a piece of the Nightmare, you must first belong to the Nightmare.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSun\",\"Text\",0]: <size:31>{Each night, the light dies, and each morning she is born anew, embracing the land in her golden wings.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSurgeon\",\"Text\":
"He might be lacking in vision, but his virtuosity is undeniable."
- Malachai, on Maligaro
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSurveyor\",\"Text\: Exploring lands made of flesh and sorrow, we'll reap and plunder like there's no tomorrow.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSurvivalist\",\"Te:
A lucky number 
For us all 
To help us through 
The perils told.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheSwordKingsSalute\":
<size:26>{Many were slain by the sword king 
Their blood decorating his ring 
Those who retreated were slaughtered 
Those who fought bravely were honoured}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheThaumaturgist\",\":
<size:31>{"Mastery of thaumaturgy is like any other pursuit; it requires dedication and sacrifice. Sometimes several sacrifices."
- Shavronne of Umbra}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheTower\",\"Text\",0: A tower built of the strongest stone is not eternal; a towering intellect is not enlightened.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheTraitor\",\"Text\":
<size:31>{Sometimes an apprentice becomes a master through countless hours of hard work and practice.
Sometimes it happens by force.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheTrial\",\"Text\",0: You cannot journey to new lands until you have the courage to leave the safety of home.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheTwilightMoon\",\"T: The day is dying, the night is born, the air grows cool, the sky is torn.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheTyrant\",\"Text\",:
"Fear controls the masses."
- Laszlo, the Scourge
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheUndaunted\",\"Text:
<size:29>{"Fate was always my nemesis... 
But it didn't stop me then, and it won't stop me now."
- Kjetilbrann, The Undaunted}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheUndisputed\",\"Tex: To create something truly spectacular, you must risk total failure.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheUnion\",\"Text\",0:
On the 21st of Eterni, 
two become one, 
their light outshines 
the setting sun.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheValkyrie\",\"Text\:
<size:26>{The villain strikes,
the world is torn.
A war begins, a hero is born,
The nemesis sets the sky alight.
A hero's sacrifice
sets everything right.
- Drake's Epitaph}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheValleyOfSteelBoxes:
"The most valuable treasures should be hidden in plain sight." 
- Ina, Keeper of Goods
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheVast\",\"Text\",0]:
<size:30>{Can you hear the siren's calls,
Just beyond the sea?
A voice which hearts
of men enthralls,
I too am hooked to thee.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheVisionary\",\"Text: Lioneye looked to the heights of glorious victory. And thus he missed the defeat right under his nose.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheVoid\",\"Text\",0]: Reach into the Void and claim your prize.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWarden\",\"Text\",: <size:31>{Brutus' first innovation as Lord Incarcerator was a weighted chain around every neck so that his prisoners would forever bow to him.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWarlord\",\"Text\":
To cure the Goddess,
and break the chains of corruption,
you must shatter the world.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWatcher\",\"Text\":
<size:31>{Strange eyes on top of spines 
Gaze beyond the veil of time 
Deep down below the mines 
A dream of crimson and of grime}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWeb\",\"Text\",0]:
<size:30>{A weapon, a shelter, a prison.
The web's purpose changes
with the spider's needs.
A lesson we should
take to heart.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWiltedRose\",\"Tex: Though the path to divinity is fraught with peril, hope may bloom from within.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWind\",\"Text\",0]: <size:33>{Weaving through the cracks, searching for weaknesses, silent, indiscriminate, leaving sorrow in its wake.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWitch\",\"Text\",0:
<size:27>{A wanderer in the wild strives 
Against countless foes he survives 
A fool pursues a quest contrived 
By the gift of the witch, alive.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWolf\",\"Text\",0]: <size:29>{The largest beasts cannot be overpowered. The Greatwolf teaches us to use guile, not strength, to probe for the soft flesh and strike deep.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWolfsShadow\",\"Te: "If I fall, we will fall together with my fangs in your throat."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWolvenKingsBite\",: <size:31>{A wolf does not bite his mate as he does his prey, yet both begin with bared teeth. Know who you are, and you will know the meaning of the bite.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWolverine\",\"Text: Claw them from the bottom, you'll be glad that you have got 'em, claw them from the top, you'll never want to stop.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWorldEater\",\"Tex: Its body knows no limits. Its appetite knows no bounds.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWrath\",\"Text\",0: <size:31>{"Daughter of catastrophe, mother of pain. Amongst the filth of Wraeclast, she wanders, and her wrath follows." - Quintoon the Returned}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TheWretched\",\"Text\: Necromancers, believe me, are more terrifying than their thralls.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThesisOfBlood\",\"Tex:
"We are nothing but flesh. Blood. If we are to
ascend, we must empower that flesh."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThesisOfExperiments\":
"The results prove it. With enough focused Corruption,
we can alter the fundamental laws of existence in a
small area... the question now: what do we try first?"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThesisOfSacrifice\",\:
"Altering reality, even locally, is no simple matter.
Let us start not with ourselves, but with willing subjects."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThesisOfSouls\",\"Tex:
"The soul carries the truth of what we are.
That is where we should focus our efforts."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThiefsTrinketSculptur: Rubbing the eel's head is said to bring smugglers good fortune.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThreeFacesInTheDark\": For every threat you spy in the shadows, there are two others you don't.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThreeVoices\",\"Text\: The village elders had a curious rule: If you hear three voices scream for aid, flee as fast as you can.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ThunderousSkies\",\"T: <size:30>{Many that have wielded the power of lightning have said that death by electrocution looks like the victim is more alive than ever before.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TimeLostRelic\",\"Tex: Time cannot wash away that which cannot be forgotten.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Tranquillity\",\"Text: Beware the sudden calm, for it is a sure sign of a storm on the horizon.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TreasureHunter\",\"Te:
"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
- Toggo's Last Words
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TrialMasterFragment1\:
You walk away bloodied and exhausted,
but victorious. You have overcome.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TrialMasterFragment2\:
Your broken body lies forgotten,
nourishing only the worms.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TrialMasterFragment3\:
Mortals spend their lives wondering which
fate shall be theirs. Chaos takes amusement
in knowing the answer: all of them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TrialMasterFragment4\:
You stagger away, embarrassed by your failure.
Your only consolation prize is your life.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TrialmasterKey2\",\"T:
Fight enough battles, and it
becomes all but inevitable.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TrialmasterKey3\",\"T:
There is always a chance, however small,
that you might actually succeed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TrialmasterLineageSup:
Few mortals can comprehend the horror of experiencing
every possibility. Chaos alone takes joy in the
unthinkable and the unimaginable made manifest.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TrickstersShardLineag:
They'd cast him out, declared him a dark omen. Their judgement
rattled in his head. He'd no control over crops, or herds, but
that mattered little. Upon his return, their fear was his weapon.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TulsAvalancheSupport\:
Then, there was movement. What once preserved them
now pulled them free from their silence. In the
absence of stillness, their screams echoed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TurnTheOtherCheek\",\:
"Only after one forsakes rage, can true power be found."
- Sekhema Asenath
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"TwilightOrderVaultKey:
They knew the truth, but had no choice
Generations hence, perhaps, one day,
there would be a chance
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UberEaterOfWorldsKey\:
That which could not be digested
remains lost within, the buried remnants
of whole cultures, of entire worlds.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UberElderFragment1\",: Beauty is in the eye of the creator.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UberElderFragment4\",: What is not cannot cause harm.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UberMavenKey\",\"Text:
Champions of her collection may take what
they wish, so long as they use it to entertain her...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UberSearingExarchKey\:
Minds are not the only thing
the Cleansing Fire keeps eternal...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UberShaperKey\",\"Tex:
Step into the inner sanctum of the minds of old
Enter a realm untouched even by starlight
Through transcendence, bend reality to your will.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UberSirusKey\",\"Text:
There is a place, a state of being,
where all that you love forgets you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UberVenariusKey\",\"T:
I have already lost more
than you shall ever possess.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UhtredLineageSupportO:
By the time Uhtred realised the truth, only Vorana remained
to defend them. While the rest fled, she implanted her flesh
with gems and set forth alone to face the endless hordes.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UhtredLineageSupportT:
Studying the ill omens of the stars, Uhtred came to suspect
something was very wrong among the first Kalguurans.
Olroth, Vorana, Medved... three there were. Three dangers.

Day and night, his priests followed each of the Kalguuran
heroes. When Medved disappeared, Uhtred grew even more
paranoid. Now, only two remained... Olroth and Vorana.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UhtredsChaliceLineage:
"To control the stars, we swallow the firmament.
We imbibe the truth. We are filled with the void.
We embrace the vast emptiness, or we die."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UhtredsConstellationS:
"In the stars, I see our future. My plans are laid,
lines tracing a constellation. You may only see
pieces, but I see the whole, and it will be glorious."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UhtredsCrestFlavourTe:
The Order of the Chalice still exists today.
Its priests teach engineering, mathematics,
and science to all those who would learn.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UltimatumKey\",\"Text:
Mortals spend their lives wondering which
fate shall be theirs. Chaos takes amusement
in knowing the answer: all of them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UltimatumKeyQuest\",\:
Mortals spend their lives wondering which
fate shall be theirs. Chaos takes amusement
in knowing the answer: all of them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Unique340Reliquary\",:
Though flesh may decay, and bones turn to dust, the spirit fades not.
Floundering eternal in pools of tranquil dark.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet1\",\"Tex:
You are slow, foolish and ignorant.
I am not.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet10\",\"Te:
The world is but a piece of parchment, blank and symmetric.
We label each side: one Good, one Evil; one Black, one White.
The divine truth, however, is that both are one and the same.
-Jaetai, Vaal Advisor
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet10x\",\"T:
"A rare unequivocal success, Prototype #11 causes wounds to heal so quickly
the type Delta test subject actually survived the entire testing regimen."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet16\",\"Te: Forge your Perseverance on the Anvil of Faith.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet17\",\"Te:
"Marylene stroked the medallion at her breast
before every duel and every cast of the die."
- Victario, the People's Poet
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet2\",\"Tex:
The maidens of court swoon to see
the challengers crushed at your feet.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet20\",\"Te:
As you have lived, so you shall die 
forever trying to keep up with me. 
Your blood on these hands of mine
forever makes me the public enemy.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet21\",\"Te: The first light to grow in the primordial darkness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet22\",\"Te:
A shimmering symbol of Purity, clear as water,
but I know better than most how quickly
Purity can succumb to Corruption.
How quickly water turns to blood.
- Victario, the People's Poet
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet23\",\"Te:
In my dream, a voice spoke to me. It said:
'My reach knows no bounds.
All that is pure is destined to rot.
All that lives is destined to serve.'
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet24\",\"Te:
Shackled fires dance about;
Might within from force without.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet25\",\"Te:
Combat is simple.
Keep your blood in.
Take theirs out.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet26\",\"Te:
When slaughtered flesh falls silent,
the soul may yet scream on.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet27\",\"Te:
"I offer to you an eternal oath 
that binds your heart to mine;
a bond that not even death will break.
Will you accept?"
- Daresso, to his beloved
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet28\",\"Te:
Those who dwell in the deep freeze
enjoy a special kind of madness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet29\",\"Te:
Those who dwell in the deep freeze
enjoy a special kind of madness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet29x\",\"T:
"Researcher Graven spent eleven hours suffering electrocution in the lab
before he was found. Prototype #14 somehow kept him from dying."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet3\",\"Tex: The breath of life is yours to give.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet31\",\"Te: Remember the past, anticipate the future.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet32\",\"Te: Many things come to one who has nothing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet33\",\"Te:
Each death witnessed is a valuable lesson, 
and what use is knowledge if it is not put into practice?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet35\",\"Te:
"...and so He said: 'Let only the good meet my gaze'
and no eye met His. So He called down the cleansing flames
and let black smoke sweep the Sinners away."
- Book of Innocence
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet36\",\"Te:
Friendship worth its weight in gold,
a treasure every day.
I thought together we'd grow old,
until fate pulled you away.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet38\",\"Te:
We are his blood.
Through us he carries his burning message.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet4\",\"Tex:
It is said to make you invisible when the Great
Spirit comes to take you on your final journey.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet40\",\"Te:
A single moment sets in motion an eternal fall,
beneath which all are buried.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet42\",\"Te:
But the fool did not bow.
The fool stood and questioned.
And the fool was unwritten.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet43\",\"Te: The dreamer stirs, the world trembles.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet44\",\"Te:
"He does not love. He does not feel regret or remorse.
He does not think about consequences, only possibilities.
If that does not describe a monster, tell me: what does?"
- Archbishop Geofri
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet45\",\"Te:
Though its body was locked in stone,
its essence wandered the infinite,
learning, and preparing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet45Uber\",:
There is no darker void than the hollow
ache of love disremembered...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet46\",\"Te: Let the unrepentant be dragged ever downwards by the weight of their sins.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet48\",\"Te:
The seed of life, saved and savoured.

<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Sacrifice}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet49\",\"Te: We are incapable of change without sacrifice, for we are both the iron and the forge.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet5\",\"Tex:
"Shoot first, ask no questions."
- Karui wisdom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet50\",\"Te:
"No man, before or since,
has climbed to such lofty heights
or fallen so far."
- Voll, Emperor of Purity
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet51\",\"Te:
The leash of the lifegiver
binds in both directions.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet52\",\"Te: He was a lot luckier before he lost this.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet53\",\"Te:
It was not his fearlessness or ferocity, nor his tactical genius,
it was his leadership that earned Aul, the Last King, his crown.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet54\",\"Te:
Time, like light, can be refracted into all its myriad colours.
The first shade is beautiful, but the last will drive the unwary insane.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet55\",\"Te: Strike true, strike hard, and leave no survivors to retaliate.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet55x\",\"T:
"The type Delta test subjects could have escaped with the power offered by
Prototype #15, but they suddenly chose to murder each other instead..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet56\",\"Te:
"Hyrri and her arrows broke the sacred code, damning herself. 
Kaom seized her sacrifice, and in doing so, seized victory." 
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet57\",\"Te: Greater than any blade, agility and intellect will be your weapons.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet59\",\"Te: A single act of anger travels countless paths of destruction.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet5x\",\"Te:
"In testing, Prototype #9 had no effect on fired arrows. However,
an unknown spell did destroy the entire firing chamber."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet6\",\"Tex:
Never blinking, always watching.

<default>{This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Chayula}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet60_\",\"T: The storm cannot break that which bends.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet63\",\"Te: Death creeps closer; unseen, inexorable, hungry.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet64\",\"Te:
For how little time they had together,
their love was all the more powerful.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet65\",\"Te:
"Remain poised. Remain balanced. Keep all the emotions of a lifetime caged.
Let only your enemies see the truth of your rage."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet67\",\"Te:
The time is nigh.
War has come.
We dream as one.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet68\",\"Te:
That winter, scorched refugees emerged from the shrine,
speaking only in strange tongues. They prayed to a new
symbol of power, not out of love, but out of fear.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet69\",\"Te:
A single facet contains the wisdom
of countless disintegrated worlds.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet7\",\"Tex: The light that reveals is the glare that blinds.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet70\",\"Te: Simply the way it must be, so that existence may be.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet71\",\"Te: The price of immortality is isolation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet72\",\"Te:
Maligaro did the cutting... at her request.
In the new void, a malevolent power emerged.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet73\",\"Te:
Beidat made false promises to many denizens,
converting only one into a conduit through
which Wraeclast might be consumed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet74\",\"Te:
"Atziri ordained that we exploit the weaknesses inherent in our slaves.
With relish, we did exactly as she instructed."
- Guatelitzi, Architect of Flesh
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet8\",\"Tex:
Mindless rage will shake the world,
Cunning lies will bend it.
Reckless haste will break the world,
And into darkness send it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmulet9\",\"Tex:
Forged from the blood of countless wars,
its thirst has only begun.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueAmuletVictor1\":
A glimpse of victory
is all you need to win.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt1\",\"Text\:
They say a lifetime of wisdom is carried
in every skin the great beasts shed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt10\",\"Text: Nothing is as vivid as the rage of battle
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt10x\",\"Tex:
"A legion of forty soldiers attempted to break into Outpost Five and
steal Prototype #659. What do they know that we do not?"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt11\",\"Text: At knifepoint, a moment's hesitation means death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt11x\",\"Tex:
"I cannot fathom the mysteries of Prototype #16. It did nearly nothing until I
brought it to RESTRICTED. It makes no sense!"
- Researcher Graven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt12\",\"Text:
"Our genius will pave the way forward.
May all who are worthy be improved!"
- Inquisitor Maligaro
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt13\",\"Text:
In battle, virtue matters not. 
Only victory.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt14\",\"Text:
With her cold resolve
And burning sacrifice
The Eternal twins arose.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt15\",\"Text:
Our forefathers danced and drank and ate their fill
and did not honour the First Ones for their gifts.
So the First Ones filled the sky with fire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt16\",\"Text:
After the Great Fire, the land lay barren
and our forefathers grew weak.
Mother Gull took pity on them
and gave them grain and water.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt17\",\"Text:
But the grain grew twisted and the water turned dark
and those who partook of Mother Gull's gift
birthed monsters that fed 
on the flesh of one another.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt18\",\"Text:
"They say a draught of fine spirits will ward off
the elements and promote a longer, merrier life.
I have found this to be true on all counts." 
- Zerphi of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt19\",\"Text:
"The power of rebirth rivals that of immortality."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt2\",\"Text\:
Few men cast a longer shadow
 than the Great Meginord of the North.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt20\",\"Text:
A single step forward
Snap free from the prison
Reborn into freedom eternal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt21\",\"Text:
Vaal bloodpriests were among the earliest intellectuals on record. 
It was they who found that a newly freed soul would 
desperately cling to any other source of life.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt21x\",\"Tex:
"Curious. The test spike penetrated the subject's flesh, but the chest wound
was not as deep as expected. There is something here..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt22\",\"Text:
"Some blows must be evaded. Some blows must be endured.
The trick is to tell them apart."
- Daresso, the Sword King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt23\",\"Text:
You were always there, by my side,
whether we sat or played.
Our friendship was a joyful ride,
I wish you could have stayed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt24\",\"Text:
All creatures have the potential for greatness
or unequivocal failure.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt26\",\"Text:
With the patience of a prowling lion,
the Shade watched the Scholar.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt27\",\"Text:
Hold in your hand the darkness
and never will the light blind you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt28\",\"Text:
What started as a desire to feed
became a desire to learn...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt29\",\"Text:
For the Vaal, the relationship between slave and master
was as intimate and volatile as that of lovers.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt3\",\"Text\:
A large enough debt turns even a friend
into an enemy, and the Perandus family
had more debtors than anyone.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt31\",\"Text:
Death is your most important duty.
Face it, or curse your bloodline for all eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt32\",\"Text: Cold winds whirl at the crown of the world.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt33_\",\"Tex: Poison the land and they'll have nothing to defend.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt33x\",\"Tex:
"Recommend extreme caution on any prototypes that can lead to a chain reaction
of deaths. Lab Twelve has been lost to the flames." 
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt34\",\"Text: Those who offer up sacrifices to every deity entreat the full favour of none.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt35\",\"Text: Drink, my children, and be strengthened.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt38\",\"Text: Freedom is won only by those who are not free.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt39\",\"Text:
"This will help with the pain.
One for you... and one for me."
- Doctor 'Shaky Hands' Opden
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt4\",\"Text\:
Kaom's strength was rivaled only by
the great Meginord of the north.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt40\",\"Text: Teach a man to burn, and you'll be warm for the rest of his life.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt41\",\"Text:
The burden falls heaviest not on those that died,
but on those that did not.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt42a\",\"Tex: The tortured thinker is made heavier by the weight of his guilt.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt42b_\",\"Te: The cruel thinker finds glee in torture most precise.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt42c\",\"Tex: The cowardly thinker's greatest success is simply surviving.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt43_\",\"Tex: Rivers of power course through your veins.
