entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt44\",\"Text:
Mortal pleasures can hold back the memories,
but a hollow soul can never be healed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt45\",\"Text:
"A man confronted with sufficient adversity
may ascend to unprecedented heights
and triumph over his coddled rivals."
- Weylan the Ezomyte
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt46\",\"Text:
"Put your faith in me.
Our god demands it."
- High Templar Maxarius
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt6\",\"Text\:
The sun's fury, trapped
in pillars of blazing light,
Explodes from its cage.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt7\",\"Text\:
"A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and
judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat.
The head is where the Man is."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt7x\",\"Text:
"A type Delta test subject escaped with Prototype #18. He was last seen
ten times the height of a man and crashing straight through walls."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt8\",\"Text\:
"She begged the Earth to spare her Son;
Out of love the Earth agreed.
To the other Elements she did not speak
And out of spite They plotted."
- Berek and the Untamed
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBelt9\",\"Text\:
"You can invite them but you can never be
sure who will come knocking."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBeltDemigods1\":
The bindings of the victorious
wrap around the throats of the defeated.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDemigods\",:
The victorious know only leadership,
the rest only servitude.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex1\",\"Te:
Hyrri loosed a barrage of arrows,
tipped with a poisoned hatred
only oppression can ferment.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex11\",\"T:
We share one space,
speak one voice,
act through one body.
A flawless crystal.
Brittle.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex11x\",\":
"Test subject battered through the hatch with her bare hands,
forcing us to resort to threatening her children to restore containment."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex12\",\"T:
Feed a beast and it will not hunt.
Protect it and it will not fight.
Ferocity must be learned, not taught.
It is suffering that forges the greatest warriors.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex2\",\"Te: I'm hiding, yet everyone knows where I am.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex4\",\"Te: To catch an animal, think like an animal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex5\",\"Te:
Forget your kite shield. Just put the biggest man
 in the field between you and the archers.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex6\",\"Te:
Shedding away her regal past,
she forged a new destiny.
Sacrificing the ephemeral joys of man,
she embraced the eternal grasp of nature.
Seizing her one true wish,
she found peace at last.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex7\",\"Te:
"I carry neither food nor drink. I rely on the charity
of my fellow wayfarers. Dead men are generous men."
- Taruk of the Wildmen
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex8\",\"Te:
Do not hide your flaws, your cracks,
mend them, and display them proudly.
For it is these that set us apart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDex9\",\"Te:
Curse their vile Council,
They cast me aside as if I am some bastard child.
If they only knew the power I possess.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt1\",\:
"...The discomfort shown by the others is amusing, but none
can deny that my work has made quite the splash..."
- Maligaro's Journal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt10\",:
The First of the Sky was the Last of the First.
It was he who showed us that our limits are self-imposed,
that what we take for law may just be an illusion.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt11\",: There can be no defence against the celestial siblings entropy and time.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt11x\":
"The form of this replica came to me in a troubled dream.
I do not believe we should ever allow it to be used."
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt12\",:
He may have returned from the frozen southern reaches,
but that doesn't mean he ever truly escaped them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt13\",:
The Oriathans built their empire on naval mobility, which allowed
them to wage war wherever their enemy was weakest.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt14\",:
Within each of us exists a being of pure malice,
held back only by the lies we tell ourselves.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt15\",: Those that can never die have but one wish.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt2\",\:
When the throat roars,
As eyes weep,
When the hand grips hard
With trembling fingers,
When belly twists
Yet legs stand strong,
That is the work
Of the Defiant Heart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt3\",\:
Use the dead to stave off death,
An armour of bones and rot.
Hanging on with bated breath,
One lapse and all for naught.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt3x\",:
"Further research must be done on Prototype #282.
There is power here, if it can be tapped."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt4\",\:
"Every life is a story.
If you're not writing your own,
you'd better know who's writing it for you!"
- Victario, the People's Poet
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt5\",\: Thin is the line between mechanical genius and magic.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt6\",\:
Don't hesitate; bring death to all, conclusively and swiftly,
or they will give you the same treatment.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt7\",\: What mother wouldn't give her life for that of her children?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt8\",\:
Ask any tracker and they'll tell you:
the most dangerous animals
are the ones who don't bother to hide.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt9\",\: Look to the darkness for nourishment and you will never go hungry.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyDexInt9x\",:
"Eyes of black, three by three, staring ever darker into me..."
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt1\",\"Te:
Shavronne's apparel became ever more extravagant
as her body and soul became ever more corrupted.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt10\",\"T:
The quickest way to understand
your own strengths and weaknesses
is to walk in the skin of another.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt11\",\"T:
Renowned by those distinguished,
Exalted by the few.
He skulks in darkness, 
and watches from beneath the city.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt12\",\"T:
Whiff of cold, tiny spark, faintest flicker in the dark.
Embers swirl, ice takes form, sky exposed - Death's perfect storm.
Frost and thunder, flames shine bright, ruin walks the land tonight.
By your hand they dance and bend, wield them and brook no end.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt14\",\"T:
The Lords are chosen so carefully.
Only they may grace His flesh.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt15\",\"T:
As she was sentenced to death, Doedre was silent.
As she was tied to the stake, Doedre was silent.
As the flames licked away her life, Doedre was silent.
But Wraeclast had not heard the last of her.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt16\",\"T:
He took me by my hand, promised me power beyond compare.
But I did not do it for power.
I did it for love.
And I'd do it again in an instant.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt17\",\"T:
The First of the Night was the first explorer
It was she who first braved night's terrors
and found comfort in silence and solace.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt18\",\"T:
In their crimson nightmare, the Vaal are still sacrificing themselves to her glory and beauty. 
They stab their own hearts and cry out in ecstasy, only to rise again.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt19\",\"T:
Exceptional men and women of strong will can flicker a spark, 
but something much greater is needed to unleash the wildfire of true divine flames.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt2\",\"Te: He who sows an ember shall reap an inferno.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt20\",\"T: Imbue the body with stolen spirit, hold the leash tight.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt21\",\"T: Faith springs abundant at the edge of death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt3\",\"Te:
My Soul is your Strength
My Price is your Blood
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt4\",\"Te:
Despair hums, softly, deadly, in the bones of my enemies.
Eyes will burn, and souls wither, as they bask in my radiance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt5\",\"Te:
The night of a thousand ribbons
To remember the day of a thousand flames
When Sarn burned
And was born again
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt7\",\"Te:
The greatest mistakes cause suffering
long after they have been made
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt8\",\"Te:
When dead men rise and darkness falls
Only faith can be your walls
Walls of Light, not of brick
Twice as strong and twice as thick
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyInt9\",\"Te:
Reap what others have sown
Muster them from their graves
Parade them for your pleasure
Zealots in mortis enslaved
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr1\",\"Te:
The warrior who
fears will fall.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr10\",\"T:
The First of the Deep was the First of All.
It was He who conquered the waves,
who stood guard as land rose from sea.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr11\",\"T:
The Trickster God turned the very Day and Night against each other.
What hope have you?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr12\",\"T: The giant cares not for the ants.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr1x\",\"T:
"Useless for our purposes, but perhaps we can sell Prototype #5
to an archmage to fund other experiments."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr2\",\"Te: It is safer to be feared than to be loved.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr3\",\"Te:
Tears of blood, aching heart,
My dear Isildria must depart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr4\",\"Te:
Give me neither havens nor solace;
They are for the weak and frightened.
Instead, light the path to greatness,
So that I may begin my bright pursuit.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr5\",\"Te:
Some would question if the risk was worth it.
The rest were already dead.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr6\",\"Te:
"The Virtue Gems are a gift from the land, 
our land, and we will not let our gifts
be destroyed by savages."
- Marceus Lioneye
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr7\",\"Te: The turtle's shell one day becomes its tomb.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr8\",\"Te: The pirates of Pondium know that full pockets have a tendency to sink.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStr9\",\"Te:
"The Council have a great many secrets.
Some are better kept that way, Cospri."
- Mauritius, the Iron Heart
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex1\",\:
There is no safer place
Than the Belly of the Beast
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex2\",\:
"There's nothing like imminent death
to galvanize one's purpose in life."
- Malachai the Soulless.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex3\",\:
"When your back is against the wall,
And your opponent is bleeding you dry,
There is only one appropriate response:
Unbridled, overwhelming violence."
- Daresso, the Sword King
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex4\",\:
"The Consort of Chaos descended,
swiftly, brutally, artfully, she consumed the living,
leaving naught behind but a Rosemarie bloom,
to celebrate the massacre."
- Blass, explorer, hunter, adventurer
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex5\",\:
The truth lies inside every man, if you dig around. 
Many a confession was found in the bowels of Axiom.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex6\",\:
Swift and silent.
One strike, one corpse.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex7\",\: Simple is the life of the bear.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex8\",\:
The First of the Plains was the First of the Hunt
It was she who showed us that there is honour
in waiting in the shadows and picking your moment.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDex8x\",:
"Attempt #120: the prototype has finally achieved power similar to the original
without breaking all the bones of the test subject. A rousing success."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDexInt1\:
"When you have nothing to hide,
you have nothing to fear."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrDexInt2\:
Destined for sacrifice,
they were dressed in garments
that blurred the lines between this world
and the next.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt1\",\:
Although a great leader during the war,
Voll proved disastrous in times of peace.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt10\",:
A general may carry his men to greatness, 
or be dragged beneath the mire by their burden.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt11\",: A glacier of putrid meat, crushing mountains and valleys alike.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt13\",: The mind is a filter through which anarchy becomes order.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt14\",:
"This was the first step in some grand design, 
lost to the ages, now ours to decipher." 
- Dominus, High Templar
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt15\",:
Seek not to avoid the mortal pains of this world.
In flagellation, there lies freedom from temptation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt2\",\: Nothing stops the pain like a courageous rush into battle.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt2x\",:
"Prototype #7 achieved even greater injury responsiveness than expected,
though at considerable cost to the long-term survival rate of the user."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt3\",\:
When Solaris closes her burning eye
At the end of time,
the world will perish in ice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt4\",\:
. . . and the Light faded and hope waned
Zahndethus cast aside his faith
and embraced the darkness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt5\",\:
Only light may banish the shadows from this land
And the black lies wrapped around your heart
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt6\",\: The toughest armour is the trust of your people.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt7\",\:
Faith does not make us invulnerable.
It makes us immortal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt8\",\:
Fragile is the vessel that holds the soul.
Wrap it in cloth, seal it tight.
For once the seal is broken, the contents are lost forever.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt9\",\:
When it comes to finding a use for surplus,
a rich man has within himself
boundless creativity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBodyStrInt9x\",:
"Better... stronger... more vital... and then... failure. Always, failure.
What key fundamental secret are we missing?"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsAtlas1\",\: Nothing spreads as quickly as an idea.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDIY\",\"Te:
"Every day we choose safety or knowledge. 
Live and stagnate, or risk death for truth.
I would rather see the end of the Vaal
than help it tread water." 
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDemigods1\: Victory is on the march and nothing can stop it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDemigods2\: Those who burn for victory burn for eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex1\",\"T: Do not let them step on your feet. Keep them at bay.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex10\",\":
The Goat King knew not of war,
of the lands and laws he trampled.
The Goat King knew only joy
at turning life to ash.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex11\",\": The higher you soar, the further you must fall.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex13\",\":
A secret is a weapon your enemies do not have.
When the First of the Plains hunted, she moved in silence and acted quickly.
To do otherwise is to arm your foes.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex14\",\":
The High Priests ensured the loyalty of their slaves by habituating
them to narcotic stimulants with lethal withdrawals.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex15\",\":
The inferno surged past, devastating Stridevolf, but the Maraketh
warrior somehow remained. Soot-blackened and resolute, she
grinned. In that moment, the bandit king knew true despair.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex2\",\"T: The wyrm draws warmth from the fires of desire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex3\",\"T:
Alive but not unscathed, Victario fled
as slaughter blossomed at the gates.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex4\",\"T:
"Sharks thrash and swirl
To the pounding drum of their frenzied hearts
As they dance in the waters red."
-Lavianga, Guardian of the Karui Way
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex5\",\"T:
"Death can be outrun with these, but beware!
In running from death, you may forget to live."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 202
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex7\",\"T:
"Those who dance are considered insane
by those who cannot hear the music."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex8\",\"T: It takes a clear mind to outrun a storm.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex9\",\"T:
Move in with haste.
Strike quick, strike hard.
Vanish like smoke in the wind.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDex9x\",\":
"The test subject nearly escaped, but the poison gas
system in the hallway functioned as expected."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt1\",:
Blazing body, shining bold.
Dance beneath the orb of gold!
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt10\":
Relentlessness. Nothing more, nothing less.

<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt11\":
Every glorious conquest
stands astride innocent bones.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt12\":
A multitude of beings share a wretched existence
irrevocably bound together in perpetual torture.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt2\",:
"Bored gods won't give you any favours."
- Maraketh proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt4\",:
Those Theopolis fatcats put a price on our heads.
Let's see what they'll pay for their own.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt5\",:
Step into the void
and experience true freedom.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt5x\":
"Test subject was able to walk into the walls of his chamber after breaking a rabbit's neck.
He was not fast enough, however. Suggest we begin excavation to retrieve prototype."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt6\",: Even the dead serve the Lightless.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt7\",:
When the fires spilled out of the mountain, The First of the Night wove a net
and was carried into the night on its hot winds.
Though we cannot live without danger, we can learn to live with it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt8\",:
Facing their death,
the mind of a sacrifice
retreats into instinct and madness.

<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of the Ritual}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt8Roy:
Facing their death,
the mind of a sacrifice
retreats into instinct and madness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsDexInt9\",:
Only a fool seeks meaning
in a life so fleeting.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsExpedition:
In their hour of desperate need, the Knights of the Sun
called out for aid... and the Black Scythe answered.

Where others would retreat when vulnerable,
Olroth the Gallant fought deeper into battle.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt2\",\"T: All the world is my home.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt3\",\"T:
Shavronne raced to Brutus' side,
her last hope against the Karui tide.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt4\",\"T:
The dead man walks where
the living fear to tread.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt4x\",\":
"Outpost Twelve has been abandoned. On the bright side, I expect the plague of apparitions
to serve as ample defence for the relics we left behind."
- Administrator Qotra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt5\",\"T:
"They say that you should take life's troubles in your stride.
Some men have a longer stride than others."
- Gaius Sentari
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt6\",\"T:
To fight an enemy on their lands is a tactical mistake. 
Make those lands your own, and the mistake becomes theirs.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt7\",\"T:
The quick die young, the brilliant go mad,
and the powerful stand alone in a wasteland of their own creation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt8\",\"T:
Though the path we walk is the same,
each journey is different.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsInt8x\",\":
"Prototype #56 was deemed safe, but judging by Administrator Qotra's new hustle
and improved ability to micromanage us, I'm not so sure." 
- Researcher Graven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr1\",\"T:
The mocking wind, a shielding spell,
The haunting screams, a maddening hell.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr10\",\":
When the land rose above the sea, The First of the Deep did not move.
When the sky turned to fire, The First of the Deep did not perish.
We must remember our place, and play to our strengths.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr11\",\":
Centuries ago, there existed a unique grove imbued with ancestral fire.
As with all things, the Karui used its wood for war.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr12\",\":
In a void strewn with incandescent stardust,
the emissary of flame traverses interplanetary space
consuming the knowledge of fallen civilisations.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr2\",\"T: Don't flinch. It's a waste of good hitting time.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr3\",\"T:
Our home was swallowed beneath 
the great mountain for our complacency. 
Now we must prove our value to the Molten One 
by sating his hunger for life.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr6\",\"T:
We move to be closer to her, but the distance yet grows.

<default>{This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Uul-Netol}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr7\",\"T:
We leave a trail, that we may know
where never we will return.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr7x\",\":
"Researchers will please refrain from combining our prototypes with existing relics
of power. The temptation is obvious, but the results can be... unpredictable." 
- Administrator Qotra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStr9\",\"T: Like lightning, the Ezomyte cavalry need never strike twice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex1\",:
Stand and lead the righteous pride,
Fight till death, never hide.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex1x\":
"Twelve dead, and the seventh lab cannot be entered for several years.
Prototype #12 is a 'success,' if we can ever reach it."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex2\",:
"Sirrius flew on wings of light, faster than wind, faster
than thought. But try as he might to outrun the darkness,
it was there, at every turn, waiting for him."
- Azmerian legend
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex3\",:
"A lick of shadow may ease
the petty frictions of one's life."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex4\",:
The cursed ghosts march forever,
On their hopeless last endeavour.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex5\",:
Corruption sweeps across this land,
but our bloodline is clear.
It is our duty to keep it so.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex6\",:
A bird, too heavily laden, cannot take flight.
The First of the Sky teaches us to put aside our possessions
so that we may live more freely.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex7\",:
All that was loved, all that was hated -
naught remains but ash.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrDex8\",:
Pray that the flames find fascination,
for the true end follows when the great eye closes.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrInt1\",:
Tempest's power given form,
Flee before the walking storm.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrInt2\",:
Alberon walked among the accursed,
and they welcomed him.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrInt2x\":
"Starving test subject became completely incapable of exerting force.
However, after being fed, he began to poison everything he touched..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrInt3\",: Become one with the unstoppable flame.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrInt4\",:
To extend your life as long as possible
is to extend all the maladies that come with it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrInt5\",:
For the immortal, what is the difference
between an age and an instant?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBootsStrInt6\",: When the time comes to face evil, the faithful are never alone.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow1\",\"Text\":
"See without doubt, slay without hesitation."
- Marceus Lioneye of Sarn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow10\",\"Text\:
The eldritch storm descended upon us, and bruised lightning
rained down. Metal withered and flesh melted before its
arcane power. There was no escape, no shelter. Only despair.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow11\",\"Text\:
"Toasted or frozen
Or twitching in the light
I'm not fussy
And neither is Death."
- Koralus Doomfletch
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow12\",\"Text\: The hunt continues when the prey falls.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow13\",\"Text\:
"Exiled to the sea; what a joke. 
I'm more free than I've ever been."
- Captain Weylam "Rot-tooth" Roth of the Black Crest
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow14\",\"Text\:
The Eternals commanded an army that need not eat, sleep, or breathe
without the usual depravities of necromancy.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow14x\",\"Text:
"Admittedly lacking the finesse of the fabled original,
Prototype #4 achieved identical results through brute force alone."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow15\",\"Text\:
Night's frost becomes morning's dew
Darkness cleansed, pure and new.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow16\",\"Text\: We stand together. We strike together.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow17\",\"Text\: A hundred blind heads, each seeking the taste of prey on the air.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow18\",\"Text\:
Upon the red pyre we are born.

<default>{This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Xoph}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow19\",\"Text\: Upon the grey winds his love spreads.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow2\",\"Text\":
"The wild takes care of its own."
- Hyrri of the Karui
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow20\",\"Text\:
Through droughts, fires, floods and frost,
the ancient giants stand resolute,
while deep in the rich, dark earth,
their grasp stretches ever farther.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow21\",\"Text\:
Their last thoughts were not of their friends,
or their families, or their homes.
Their last thoughts were untethered from reality,
and bathed in fear and ferocity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow22\",\"Text\:
"There were no survivors. It had only been fired twice."
- Order of the Djinn inscription
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow23\",\"Text\:
To eat, to feast, to forget the horror of endless agonising existence
if but for a moment... only to disgorge and do it all again...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow24\",\"Text\:
"I loosed a volley of arrows into the heart of the man
who slew my beloved. There was no satisfaction, no
healing, no revenge. There was only... emptiness."
- Chieftainess Ahuana of the Ramako Tribe
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow3\",\"Text\":
The mournful music of the strings,
The creaking arch, the arrow sings.
A choking cry, a rattled breath,
The Reaper's Song, the Harp of Death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow4\",\"Text\":
"The rain of a thousand quills that whittle
present into past, life into death."
- Rigwald of the Ezomytes
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow4x\",\"Text\:
"How did you manage to lodge arrows in every single test subject
and researcher in Lab Three simultaneously?"
- Doctor Bircus
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow5\",\"Text\":
"The Spirit of War knows nothing of good and evil.
It knows only destruction."
- Sekhema Asenath
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow6\",\"Text\":
As a soldier you want to get close to enemy archers.
That is not the case when fighting the Maraketh.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow7\",\"Text\":
Mark us with mercy, then press on with care,
Execute us steadily, notch away at our despair.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow7x\",\"Text\:
"How did you manage to lodge arrows in every single test subject
and researcher in Lab Three simultaneously... again?"
- Doctor Bircus
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow8\",\"Text\":
Centuries of development in steel armoursmithing
turned the armies of the Eternal Empire
into very effective lightning rods.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow9\",\"Text\": It hunts; as silent as falling snow, as deadly as the tempest.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueBow9x\",\"Text\:
"Beware. Prototype #91 is haunted by a strange miasma,
an odour of evil. Nothing can shield the senses."
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest1\",\"Text:
"Political power is an illusion.
Popular power is fickle.
Financial power is real and loyal."
- Cadiro Perandus, Lord of the Coin
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest10\",\"Tex:
A captain's first love is his ship. 
They either die together,
or forever linger apart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest13\",\"Tex: From those who are gone, to those who remain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest14\",\"Tex: Whispers and promises, ancient and alluring.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest2\",\"Text:
"Treasure that which the Ancestors have gifted you.
For it can be gone between one breath and the next."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest3\",\"Text:
"A fool steps into the unknown.
An explorer finds his way back again."
- Malachai, Thaumaturge Laureate
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest4\",\"Text:
What is stronger, the stone or the wind?
Look to the east. Do you see a single stone still standing amongst the dunes?
- Sekhema Deshret
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest5\",\"Text:
An era so ingrained with decadence, greed and cruelty
that even the graves of murderers were gilded.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest6\",\"Text:
Little makes it across the dry plains 
to the foot of the mountain alive.
The mountain dwellers ensure nothing reaches the top.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest7\",\"Text:
The caustic fumes that rise from the caldera
kill nearly everything downwind eventually.
The Redblade, however, just go mad.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest8\",\"Text:
For generations, the gentle Pondium tides
sheltered the smugglers, murderers and thieves,
and let their resentment and population flourish.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChest9\",\"Text:
As if pulled by divine strings,
the powerful are drawn to the powerful,
breaking any morals and laws that might stand in the way.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChestBarrel1\",:
Just an ordinary barrel, used to store sensible objects. 
Not swarms of things.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChestGrandmaste:
The champions rest now, free from pain,
Their souls ascend to the sun.
Some parting gifts are all that remain,
Their eternal vigil is done.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueChestMap9\",\"T:
The objects Oba valued more than his life,
sealed from the corruption that ultimately took it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClassicMap1\",\:
Whispered memory,
A shimmer in the darkness.
Forgotten no more.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw1\",\"Text\:
The darkest clouds clashed and coupled,
giving birth to four lightning children of hate.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw10\",\"Text:
What drives us to kill, to carve and to shred?
What drives us to drink the seething souls of the dead?
What drives us to love and to hold, but still go amiss?
What drives us to leave this world for the Abyss?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw10x\",\"Tex:
"Test subject was able to survive the entire process simply by shouting epithets at
the researcher. Researcher's feelings were slightly injured." 
- Researcher Graven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw13\",\"Text:
Terror doesn't make you jump.
Terror makes you run.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw14\",\"Text:
Grip the frozen steel, feel it numb you.
Wield the cold touch of death like 
a splinter of your own shattered heart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw15\",\"Text:
With increasing mastery over death
comes an increasing desire for it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw16Royale\",:
She carries us and nurtures us
until we must feed upon each other.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw17\",\"Text:
She thinks and we act.
She acts and we think.
Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw18\",\"Text:
To discover how cruel nature can be,
you need only shake the wrong branch.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw19\",\"Text: The strong survive. The strongest thrive.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw2\",\"Text\:
Fear blisters the heart and thins the blood.
Fear squeezes lungs and sets the guts to fester.
Fear is the wound left untended.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw3\",\"Text\:
"For the life of the flesh will always be in the blood."
- Atalui, Vaal Priestess
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw4x_\",\"Tex:
"An absurdly vicious weapon in the hands of our test subjects. It seems to
channel the desperate will to live. Intriguing." 
- Researcher Olesya
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw5\",\"Text\:
It's cold and dark where the leviathan sleeps.
Colder and darker than death.
- Old Sailor's saying
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw6_\",\"Text:
"When the hyena howls thrice
death is sure to follow."
-Maraketh Wisdom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw7\",\"Text\:
Tread lightly, lest their vigil find you.
Speak softly, lest their reason fend you.
Cut gently, lest their spirit haunt you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw8\",\"Text\: To the Maraketh, death is as intimate as love.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueClaw9\",\"Text\:
There are two things to know about fighting:
When to swing like crazy, and when to run.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel1: The hotter something burns, the less is left at the end.

There is no price you can give eternal life
that some would not pay.
Nothing is immune to the Nightmare's twisted influence.
Power always comes with a price.

"You know what to do with this, don't you?" - Researcher Graven
"Kill test subjects for their vitality?" - Researcher Olesya
"That is not what he meant." - Researcher Arn
Walls built in a hurry fall in a hurry.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel2: Ill will is the greatest of burdens.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel3: In sickness, the insane becomes sane.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel4:
The Vaal used human sacrifice to power their empire.
They, too, eventually sought means to 
make their machines run more efficiently.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel5:
Atziri went to great lengths to ensure her immortality,
but nothing is eternal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel6:
In their final days, every crime was punishable by death.
Atziri's empire ran on blood, but the blood was running dry.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel7:
Even a millennium later, Atziri's presence
casts a shroud over Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel8:
"The Vaal left a thousand warnings behind.
We ignored every single one."
- Siosa, the Last Scholar
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueCorruptedJewel9:
Few living things survived the cleansing flames.
Those that did thrived... 
And changed...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger1\",\"Tex:
Divine intervention feels better
when you do it yourself.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger10\",\"Te: The brightest flames cast the darkest shadows.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger1000\",\": Nothing stabs colder than pure hatred.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger11\",\"Te:
A tap on the shoulder
A peck on the cheek
A sip of your wine
So red and so sleek
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger12\",\"Te:
"I'm a painter, and crimson is my chosen hue."
- Coralito, Brotherhood of Silence
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger12x\",\"T:
"Prototype #131 must never be allowed near anyone who bears a wound, no
matter how slight. Even a tiny cut makes it exponentially more dangerous."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger13\",\"Te:
Love only death
For she shall never let you go.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger16\",\"Te: Some things must die so that others can live.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger17\",\"Te:
The Maraketh fear very little, 
but they dare not whisper the name
of the demon that flies on Winter's gales.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger18\",\"Te:
Lava bled from the earth and,
after a time, cooled and hardened.
The world protecting its beating heart 
with a thick, black scab.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger19\",\"Te: There is nothing more brutal than a simple blade wielded with rage.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger19x\",\"T:
"Researchers will refrain from scaring each other by firing ice spears while holding
Prototype #141. Sooner or later, someone's going to lose an eye." 
- Administrator Qotra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger2\",\"Tex: A mighty beast, a lavish feast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger20\",\"Te:
We whack, we sack, we hack up the back,
We bore, we gore, because we're bored.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger21\",\"Te:
"That bronze girl sure knows how to cut someone down to size!"
- Bertrand the Plush
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger3\",\"Tex:
Unwieldy and garish became graceful
and deadly in Ungil's nimble hands.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger3x\",\"Te:
"Recommend further production of Prototype #122. It makes
an ideal weapon for our suppression troops and guards."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger4\",\"Tex:
A heart can be stabbed by thoughts,
If your mind is sharp enough.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger4x\",\"Te:
"There is something incredibly satisfying about impaling test
subjects with Ethereal Knives. Perhaps it is the sound -
the spell, the screams, or both."  - Researcher Olesya
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger5\",\"Tex:
Maligaro considered his work an Art,
and his subjects his canvas.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger6\",\"Tex:
A fang of hellfire, chip of frost,
Lightning flickers, blade embossed.
With dagger clenched, into the fray!
Or draw it out, and cast away.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger7\",\"Tex: Unnatural Origins, unnatural benefits, unnatural cost.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger8\",\"Tex:
Calling it poison would imply
that it was even edible.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDagger9\",\"Tex:
Nothing is pure.
Slice open the Innocent
And spill a thousand Sins.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentBelt1\",:
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentBow1\",\:
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.

Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.

Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.

Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.

Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentOneHandM:
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentOneHandS:
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentQuiver1\:
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentShield1\:
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentStaff1\":
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentTwoHandS:
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDescentWand1\",:
Into darkness, horror, madness...
So goes the descent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDexHelmet1\",\":
Fairgraves' trusty tricorne accompanied him far across
the seas, deep under the ground, and even beyond death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueDexHelmet2\",\":
Give of your heated passions.
Give of your cold resolve.
You will be repaid.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFishingRod1\",\:
Give a man a fish, and you can feed him for a day.
But give a fish a man, and you can feed it for a month.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFishingRod2\",\:
He cast far into the ocean
And tore out her heart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask1\",\"Text:
Knowledge is fermented in pain and loss
Distilled with reflection
To quench the thirst of those
who dream of enlightenment
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask10\",\"Tex:
Let blood sear in your veins, 
Let the pain push outwards and turn away your enemy's blows.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask11\",\"Tex: The great city of storms, washed away by Vinktar's thirst for power.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask12\",\"Tex: Rancid, rotten, and wicked are those that dare to taste my serum.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask13\",\"Tex:
To achieve godhood, they would cast off all that god has gifted us.
Mortality, compassion, even the sanctity of flesh.
 - High Templar Voll
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask14\",\"Tex: Between a rock and a rock.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask15x\",\"Te:
"Success! Prototype #54 has tapped into that sliver of divinity that exists within.
Faith fuels the flesh, and the flesh fuels the fire..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask16\",\"Tex:
"Proof that if you devote yourself to a god of death,
you may be spared from its wrath."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 408
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask18\",\"Tex:
Travelers of the deep wood speak of a witch
whose ale provides a different kind
of liquid courage.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask19\",\"Tex:
"Think of those that cursed us, judged us, 
and burned our sisters upon the pyre. 
Think of their names as you drink, 
and even their children will feel what we do to them today." 
-Vadinya, to her coven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask2\",\"Text:
Doedre Darktongue knew the Way of the Thaumaturge.
In order to receive, one must give... without hesitation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask20\",\"Tex:
All things must die.
Whether you burn out or explode is up to you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask21\",\"Tex:
And from the ashes he rose, like a black cloud.
The Sin of one became the Sin of many.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask22\",\"Tex:
The summer sun dries the soil and burns the leaves.
The autumn rain extinguishes the flames.
The spring bloom shades the wet earth.
Nature is an eternal tug of war.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask23\",\"Tex:
"What cruelty it is, that to be judged a success,
such great work must go uncredited." 
- Coralito, Brotherhood of Silence
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask24\",\"Tex: Dance like dust on the desert wind.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask25\",\"Tex:
Freedom is for the privileged, even in death.

<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of the Ghost}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask26\",\"Tex:
"What care have I for their pain? They're already dead."
- Atalui, Vaal Priestess
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask27\",\"Tex: A controlled burn is sometimes necessary for new life.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask28\",\"Tex: A tourniquet for the soul, squeezing ethereal into physical.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask29\",\"Tex:
Olroth the Gallant,
tireless and true,
he fights for me,
he fights for you!
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask3\",\"Text:
"Kaom fought and killed for his people.
Kaom bled for his people.
And so the people gave, the people bled,
So their King might go on."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask30\",\"Tex:
Uhtred and his priests drank of the skies
to empower runes... and themselves.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask31_\",\"Te:
Nothing endures. All things end.
Then, they begin again.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask32\",\"Tex:
Vorana trained her mercenaries
thus: strike true and survive.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask33\",\"Tex:
They were bred in a cosmic ocean of raw creation.
Feasting and drinking of the milk of the mother,
they fought to the death for every last drop.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask34\",\"Tex:
Ennui prevailed, until inspiration sparked
a mote of flame, kindled by fury
and all in his path were obliterated.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask4\",\"Text:
"When the Ancestors fill your cup,
It is only good manners to drink your fill."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask5\",\"Text:
"Death needs not your understanding. It needs only your loyalty."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask7\",\"Text:
"Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world.
Today I am wise, so I am changing myself."
-Rumi of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask7x\",\"Tex:
"The most terrifying split second of my life."
- Researcher Graven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask8\",\"Text:
A sip will freeze your lips,
A swig will chill your heart,
A glass will still your soul.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueFlask9\",\"Text:
A sprinkle of hunger, a spoonful of menace
and three generous cups of Might.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDemigods1:
Though the battle has been long,
Victory is at hand.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDex1\",\":
Of ancient giants, none remain,
Their only trace is timeless pain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDex2\",\":
Maligaro operated effortlessly,
with great speed and terrible consequences.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDex3\",\":
The fury of the forge determines
the ferocity of the metal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDex4\",\":
Land and sea did not dissuade,
nor did the Kelpie's maw;
the wild beast crossed half the world
to sate his hungry claw.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDex5\",\": Lay bare paths to pain you never knew you had.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDex6\",\":
Under its influence, shards of metal take on a life of their own, wriggling into flesh,
burrowing into organs, and exploding outwards in search of other victims.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDex7\",\": The target changes, but the job's always the same.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt1\":
A single lightning strike fells a man.
A single knife stroke fells an empire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt10\:
A burden shared is a burden made lighter.
The First of the Night teaches us that our burdens 
are not just ours to bear, but ours to use against oppressors.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt11\:
Great works take time.

<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Dominance}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt12\: A plan without a deadline stays a plan.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt13\: The power of lightning is a power best shared.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt14\: The Black Sekhema's trial had only just begun.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt15\:
Biology is but a machine, begetting effusion of energies;
death is but a curse, that can be given... or reversed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt17\:
"We have methods of interrogation the Inquisitors only dream of."
- Marcus, Brotherhood Liaison
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt18\: Fear can be instilled by the smallest entity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt19\:
A legion of lives claimed
by the shards of obliterated worlds.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt2\": Fly like a Storm Crow, crush like a Rhoa
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt20\:
The fundamental forces of our world are secrets
to be uncovered by the intelligent and the capable.
Like all secrets, they, too, can be stolen.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt3\":
The roar of the heavens
Strikes more than fear
Into the hearts of Man
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt4\":
The cards don't choose life and death
That's up to the player.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt5\":
"As the serpent shuns thought,
It shuns fear.
It strikes with the speed of wrath
And the skill of compulsion."
- Deshret, The Red Sekhema
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt6\":
What is fear but a snuffed torch
and death in the wind?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt7\":
"Decomposition takes hold too quickly!
No, if we are to keep the specimen in perfect shape,
we must begin the process before expiry."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt8\": What man does not wish for immortality?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesDexInt9\":
Reaching nature's limits, 
many sought power in the unnatural.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesExpeditio:
Those heroes that set foot on Wraeclast found
themselves changing, only subtly at first...

For forty-two nights, the Feller of Heroes challenged
the next greatest warrior to a one-on-one duel.
None could match his might.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt10\",\:
Xibaqua's treachery was met with divine fury.
One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh,
until all that remained was a droplet of pure light:
The first Vaal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt11\",\:
He reached for his home one last time, a shining jewel among the stars...
only to watch in horror as it ruptured and shattered under a tide of limbs.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt2\",\":
While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style,
she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt3\",\": Cool the head and cool the blade.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt4\",\":
"You shall hang, in blissful agony, on my every note."
- Kalisa, Prima Donna of Sarn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt4x\",\:
"Our superiors were getting anxious for results, and lowered security standards.
A single attempt of a spell with this unexpected power destroyed an entire floor."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt5\",\":
Death is beautiful. Let not the elements
mar it with their clumsy ways.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt7\",\":
Death does not remove you from our grasp.
Death only brings you closer.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt7x\",\:
"I feel altered when Administrator Qotra wears these gloves.
Somehow, I find that disturbing." 
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt8\",\":
"Nothing is more natural than competition.
One feasts, another starves.
One blossoms, another withers.
And one cannot catch the golden sunlight
without casting a bitter shadow."
- Cadiro Perandus
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt8x\",\:
"There seems to be some innate relationship between the forces of
chaos and cold. Perhaps we should consult an occultist."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesInt9\",\":
"One coy look. One blown kiss. One word spoken.
One night I wish I'd forget."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr1\",\":
Why cling to your sanity? It offers you nothing.
Surrender to me, and I will grant you everything.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr10\",\:
The first Karui born on the fringes of the Vaal empire
developed a blood fever born of corruption.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr11\",\:
Lost in a sea of limbs and screaming faces, they claw
for any fleeting pleasure which might dull the pain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr12\",\: Who can tell when whispers are truly from a god?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr2\",\":
Ride with pride,
strike with vengeance,
live with honour.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr3\",\":
"The heart is the herald.
It will tell me when it is best to strike."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr3x\",\:
"One of our researchers cut himself on Prototype #2,
and he has not stopped screaming for months..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr4\",\":
Doryani's ingenuity raised the Vaal Empire
to unprecedented heights. His curiosity
reduced it to ruins and bones.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr5\",\":
"I like my vassals at sword point,
but my enemies as close as the hilt."
- Emperor Chitus
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr7\",\":
With unending determination and resolve he destroyed first the gates, 
then the constructs guarding the tomb on the other side.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr8\",\":
The monstrous men of yore used bows too,
theirs were just bigger.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStr9\",\":
The stone that stays in the waves soon crumbles to sand.
The First of the Deep teaches us to watch the tides
and choose our moments to move wisely.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex1\":
A soft caress in dead of night,
that slips about the neck, so tight.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex10\:
A hungry beast wastes no energy. 
Every strike, no matter how small, must work towards victory.
The First of the Plains teaches us 
that the largest prey can still be whittled away.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex11\: Open the way to new and dangerous lands.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex12_: Is it better to find new lands - or to create them?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex13\:
The last gasp is not always one's final act.

<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex14\:
Try as you like to hide the
blood on your hands.
You'll still know the truth.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex15\:
There is no greater thrill than leaping into combat,
slashing and hewing with utmost abandon.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex2\": Wealth is not to be borne lightly.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex4\":
"The gems are strangely human at times.
They simply love to be held."
- Doryani, First Seer to the Queen
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex5\":
What is greed but trading a mountain of death
for a sliver of life?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex6\":
Your lies are our strength.
Your threats are our laughter.
Your hate is our infinity
The fire rises!
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex7\":
Those who witness the shimmering scales of the wyrm
know only fear for the rest of their lives.
Fortunately, the rest of their lives
can be measured in seconds.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex8\":
"A master artist takes his time when he's painting.
Unfortunately, my kind doesn't often have that luxury."
- Coralito, Brotherhood of Silence
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrDex9\":
"Ever watched a man crush another man's skull?
Hard to feel hope after that."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt10\: The secret of the elements lies within a square triangle.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt11\: The laws of the faith do not apply to its leader.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt12\:
A sacrifice of blood calls forth His vengeance.
Let the righteous become the Hand of God.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt2\":
What is freedom but a clean slate
in an unclean world?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt3\":
Far south, the winter crawls under the skin.
Below the snow, adrift wanderers sleep.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt4\":
"I ask not for understanding,
only for forgiveness
for what I am about to do.
There will be blood on these shackles yet."
- Anonymous carving, Axiom Prison.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt5\":
By my hand, the inert is given life.
By my hand, that which rots is reborn.
There is nothing that cannot be changed.
Nothing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt6\":
You do not cease to be when you die
any more than the caterpillar ceases to be when it cocoons.
Come, let me show you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt6x\:
"Prototype #73 is a near perfect opposite of the original. Perhaps our failures
are due to some unknown polarity we have yet to discover."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt7\":
When the inferno spread across the land,
it was the First of the Sky who singed his feathers
as he brought the flames to a standstill.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueGlovesStrInt9\":
"You covet the strength of your peers, mortal?
Perhaps it can be yours, if you are willing to make an offering of their blood..."
- Vaal Myth of the Third Snake
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHeistContract1\:
"If Jamanra has been resurrected the way so many other ancient heroes have returned,
then perhaps I can convince him to rise up and unite the Faridun once more!"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHeistContract2\:
"Some of my inventions don't live up to their names, but some work all
too well. Let's hope that the Unbreakable is the former, not the latter."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHeistContract3\:
"A part of me still believes I can convince Nashta to give up her rebellious ways and come home. That part
of me will forever be nine years of age, futilely chasing her as she runs off into the dunes yet again."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHeistContract4\:
"There can be no freedom
while hate still reigns."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHeistContract5\:
"If Admiral Darnaw is stupid enough to send orders to his fleet members 
and not expect us to steal them, then he deserves what's coming to him!"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHeistContract6\:
"The Vox speak in threats.
We will answer them with action."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmStrInt7\",\: Righteous men seek virtue like tame pups seek praise.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmStrInt8\",\: Wicked men chase power like stray dogs chase a rat.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDemigods1:
The champion's name echoes through time, 
drowning out the whispers of the defeated.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex10\",\: A moment of calm before the battle can end the war.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex11\",\:
Ancient worshippers of the Greatwolf were overtaken
by a ravenous hunger for all things mystical.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex3\",\": No metal slips as easily through the fingers as gold.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex4\",\":
There was no hero made out of Starkonja's death,
but merely a long sleep made eternal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex5\",\":
Nature respects the strong
And paints the snow red
With the blood of the weak
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex5x\",\:
"Test subject walked right through the poison gas defenses, and attempts to slow her
failed. Suppression troop six, the 'Furious Flagellants,' have been sent to intervene."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex6\",\":
A lad with no fear of the pest
Let rats fill his helmet in jest
When they picked his skull clean
Where his head should have been
Was naught but a vermin-filled nest!
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex7\",\": If you know where to strike, you need only strike once.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex8\",\":
Though we are individual, we share the same plight.
The First of the Sky teaches us that unity and selflessness,
not division and greed, is what will carry us upwards.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDex9\",\":
The villagers seared the blight with cold, but it only bloomed countless spears.

<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt1\":
It was a sliver of Malachai's soul
that animated the first Eternal Guardian.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt10\:
It is a fool who strikes the turtle's shell.
The First of the Plains teaches us to exploit weaknesses,
and where no weakness can be found, to create one.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt11\:
Sing with me one last duet,
the curtain closes nigh.
Join me in a quiet song,
Before we all must die.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt12\:
"The more the warrior understood Tangmazu's gift, the less the mask aided him.
His dreams were filled with divine laughter."
- Tenth Song of the Islands
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt13\:
Through vision coloured by burning rage and icy hate
peers a visitor from a realm of ill intent...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt15\: Obtaining information depends upon pretending one already has it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt16\:
Man retains sanity and strives toward civilisation
only under the blessed veil of ignorance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt2\": For none of us are as cruel as all of us.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt2x\:
"Prototype #412 seems to bear much in
common with Thought Extractor technology."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt3\":
"It is the Gull that delivers Man unto Ancestor.
The consumer of our flesh. The seeder of our
souls unto the earth. We give the Gull his life.
The Gull gives us our Way."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt4\":
"The ice seared his naked feet
As the lightning stilled his heart,
But it was the flames upon his lover's face
That roused him to vengeance."
- From 'The Three Dragons' by Victario of Sarn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt5\":
"A queen should be seen, admired, but never touched."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt6\":
A lightless world
a silent reign
two sightless eyes
feed on your pain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt7\":
Branded a heretic for your beliefs,
You stand alone against many.
May the truth that fuels their anger,
Carry your blade into their hearts.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetDexInt9\":
Men always fell for her honeyed eyes,
and broke when they hit the ground.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetExpeditio: The priests of the Kalguur worshipped knowledge, not gods.

Cadigan the Third ruled dispassionately
through the iron might of artifice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt10\",\:
An angry god is one thing, 
but you should really fear a god 
with an unpredictable sense of humour.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt11\",\:
You think we do not know.
We know all that you think.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt12\",\:
The impediments of flesh are weak.
The air we breathe knows no such boundaries.
I exhale, and you inhale,
and inexorably we inch towards oneness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt13\",\:
Countless men proclaimed themselves the masters of death,
and each one succumbed to it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt14\",\:
Where the body's limits begin,
the mind's limits end.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt15\",\:
Gleeful are the few
who bask in the blood of the many.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt16\",\:
A hunter uses everything at their disposal.
The First of the Night did not hold back her venom. 
She used it to weaken her enemies, 
and used her enemies to strengthen her many children.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt17\",\:
"Feel the pain of ancient wounds.
Feel the doom of dying souls."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt18\",\: See the land as it is.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt19a\",: See creation as it was, aflame and frantic.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt19b\",: See creation as it will be, frozen and silent.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt19c\",: See creation as it is, energetic and storming.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt20\",\: The spirit hungers for the flesh.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt21\",\:
Young Napuatzi was thrown into the pits, an unwilling sacrifice, 
but the offer of her blood was refused. 
She rose from the pit alive and anew.  
A Leader. A Conquerer. A Viper.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt22\",\: The Light drove the darkness from our lands and from our hearts.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt23\",\:
The villagers seared the blight with lightning, but it only forked into countless tendrils.

<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt24\",\: A dance as old as time.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt25\",\:
Where that searing dawn fell, silence reigned.
We sought the shadows, but none remained.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt26\",\:
Bold and beautiful, a castaway
Hemmed and hawed, for her to stay
Oh, what I'd give for one more day
For she's the one that got away
-Franklin
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt4\",\": The malice in her gaze froze blood and shattered bone.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt5\",\": You are the powerless master of fire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt6\",\":
Many still hold the belief that the fossilised bones
of Vaal sacrifices have magical properties.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt7\",\":
Turning, gazing, blinking,
behold the eyes of void.
Burning, razing, drinking,
your mind is destroyed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt8\",\":
"The sharper the pain, the sharper the mind. 
A curious paradox."	
- Shavronne of Umbra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetInt9\",\":
A scar of the flesh you'll never forget,
A scar of the mind you'll never remember.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr1\",\":
Centuries of servitude, a day
of glory, an eternity of death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr10\",\:
We may fight, and we may die, but in these
moments of blood and battle, we truly live.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr11\",\: An eye for an eye makes the whole world dead.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr3\",\":
When you have slain all of your enemies,
what is left to fear?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr3x\",\:
"While Prototype #3 does imbue its wearer with strength to match the original,
the first researcher to don it burst into flames when he walked into sunlight..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr5\",\": He burns us to keep us from harm.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr6\",\":
"The Emperor's trusted surgeons are not the only ones who 
practice the dark arts. Some of us are just more discreet."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr7\",\":
The villagers seared the blight with fire, but it only spread like dancing flames.

<default>{This item can be anointed by Cassia}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStr9\",\":
A cacophony of battle cries
Reverberate through time and space
Inflicting pain beyond measure
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex10\:
As the fiery remnants of our outpost were subsumed into the caldera,
a thunderous voice echoed across the barren landscape,
"Your fragility is your folly. May others rise where you have fallen."
- El'Abin, Bloodeater
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex2\":
Swift as thought are the actions of Man 
when borne on wings of divine providence.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex3\": May you never hear it toll.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex4\":
"What lies beneath your feet?!"
"Sacred ground, watered with tears of blood!"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex5\":
All that was left of the Iron King was his bleached skull.
Yet it was all the Iron King needed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex6\":
The beasts we fear the most
are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex7\":
When you're on the run,
look only to yourself for survival.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex8\": Expand one single ambition to crystal clarity... and beyond.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrDex9\":
The single well-placed arrow that changes the world
must be preceded by ten thousand practice shots.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt1\":
"The craven mind is sharp with self interest.
The honourable mind is much easier to manipulate."
 - Malachai the Soulless
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt10\:
Your memories are a bridge to the past.
Let no one cross.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt11\:
The eyes of the living hold a glimmer of hope.
Don't waste it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt12\:
When the rains come, we cower beneath shelter.
The First of the Deep teaches us
that we should seek no shelter but ourselves.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt14\:
From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born.
From the carnage of Xibaqua, we were born.
It is our duty to return to the gods what was once theirs.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt15\:
You will know if your subjects follow you from fear
or respect when you have your first moment of weakness.
If it's the former, they will tear you into pieces like rabid dogs.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt16\: The judge determines worthiness by comparison to the paragon: himself.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt17\: Divinity is not the only path to enlightenment.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt18\: The Azmeri must never touch the Tears of Maji, lest Viridi weep.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt18x:
"I believed I understood Prototype #112 quite fully, until a test subject
with Azmeri ancestry donned it. I will be haunted by the results
for the rest of my life."  - Researcher Graven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt19\:
The line that divides hope and fear,
life and death, crowd and mob,
is as thin as a whisper.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt2\":
In the battle for honour, Geofri won.
Not so, the battle for survival.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt20\:
"Her sisters eternally fought for that shining apex in the skies,
but Viridi instead found strength in humility."
- Azmerian Creation Myth
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt21\:
Primordial rage slumbers, waiting for the call
of the stars to return and swallow the world.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt3\": Where top is bottom and weak is strong.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt4\":
The seeds of greatness are planted in darkness,
Watered by suffering,
Tended by desperation,
And bloom steel flowers of victory.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt4x\:
"Prototype #722 might look like a helmet, but I believe it to be something else
entirely. The visions it shows the wearer... are beyond mortal endurance..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt6\":
Tukohama, Tawhoa and Kitava went to the lake to fish.
Tawhoa weaved a net to catch the fish,
Tukohama built a fire to cook the fish,
and Kitava swallowed the entire lake, fish and all, with a single gulp.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt7\":
A strong pair of legs may carry you far,
but a silver tongue and a few brutes
can take you to the edge of the world.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt8\":
Greatest is the Brine King's domain,
and every day it grows a little greater,
not through force, but patience.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetStrInt9\":
"To touch it is to be overwhelmed with the need to carve your name into history.
A face no one remembers, yet once you have seen it, you will never forget."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 48
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetWreath1\":
To stand triumphant you must serve
no master other than your own ambition.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueHelmetWreath1v2:
The second trial brought most to their knees.
But not you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueIntHelmet1\",\":
Lift it lightly, don it slow.
The spikes point out and in, you know.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueIntHelmet2\",\":
Asenath's mind was as quick and nimble
as the fingers that drew her bowstring.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueIntHelmet3\",\":
"It takes true strength to hold power,
and my grip grows tighter by the day."
 - Emperor Chitus
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel1\",\"Text:
In the end, time comes for all of us.
It just comes for some much sooner.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel100\",\"Te:
At night, as a young Daresso shared his bed with a woman whose name he could not recall,
his thoughts remained in the one place he called his own: The Grand Arena.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel101\",\"Te:
The infamous Weylam Roth was never afraid
to push the boundaries of Templar authority,
and was never deterred when the Templar pushed back.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel102\",\"Te:
Izaro gave rise to Chitus.
Chitus gave rise to Voll.
None could know how it would end.
None could stop it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel103\",\"Te:
Exposure led to the deaths of many slaves.
And it was the duty of slaves to bury the dead in the frozen ground.
A growing circle of misery and death 
that the elite were all too happy to sustain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel104\",\"Te:
The Cataclysm was but the first act in a play of horrors.
The dead lingered, and the living began to rot.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel105\",\"Te:
"Rage, malice, hunger - some traits are more easily carried across the barrier of death."
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel106\",\"Te:
Of the elements at the thaumaturgist's disposal, lightning remained the least understood.
The simple passage of energy from one to another could result in profound power, or rapid death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel107\",\"Te:
Sarn's crematorium, built amidst the city's slums, 
coated the nearby shanties in a film of ash.
The dwellers grew ill, sputtering and coughing,
and in this way the crematorium guaranteed it would have many customers.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel107b\",\"T:
"Would you leave an orchard of apples to rot unharvested?
A cemetery is no different." 
-Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel108\",\"Te:
The Eternal Empire gave few freedoms to the Ezomytes, but fostered their talents as archers. 
At auction, an Ezomyte slave's value was only as good as their aim.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel11\",\"Tex:
"The swallow flew fast and took many turns,
spilling a seed where no plant had grown before. 
This seed grew and grew until the desert became fertile and abundant. 
Your mind is like this seed." 
- Maraketh Proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel110\",\"Te:
In the years that followed the twisted sky,
cold winds cloaked Wraeclast in snow.
The pure-white blanket masked a black heart
that lay dormant deep beneath the earth.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel111\",\"Te:
The skilled know how to learn.
The talented know who to learn from.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel111x\",\"T:
"Twelve test subjects were expended in the production of Prototype #800.
Was it worth the expense? Only time will tell."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel112\",\"Te: Enough mice can kill a wolf.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel113\",\"Te: Hurt as you would be hurt.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel114\",\"Te:
Candles with the brightest light
Bring life to death and day to night.
But lovely as the glow may seem,
Their light is fleeting, as a dream...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel115\",\"Te:
One by one, they stood their ground against a creature 
they had no hope of understanding, let alone defeating,
and one by one, they became a part of it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel116\",\"Te:
We are born raw and untested, and we are shaped by life.

<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel117\",\"Te:
Though the body rots, the spirit lives on.

<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel118\",\"Te:
Any thought, no matter how fleeting, changes the thinker.

<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Transcendence}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel119\",\"Te:
We are as much shaped by what we do
as what is done to us.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel120\",\"Te:
Take comfort knowing that, even in death,
we may serve our Queen and fuel her empire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel121\",\"Te:
A keen mind sees what others do not,
