makes connections where others do not, 
and is dangerous in a way that others are not.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel122\",\"Te:
Kaom watched the torches patrol the top of the Watch. 
He observed the lay of the beach, its barricades and rocks, 
and his men in their canoes, ready to lay their lives down for him.
But when his foot hit the sand, he thought only of the fight.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel123\",\"Te:
Standing behind iron bars,
Daresso thought of his adoring fans cheering his name, 
his wife's warm embrace waiting for him, 
and of the celebrations that would soon be thrown in his name.
But when the arena gate lifted, he thought only of the fight.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel124\",\"Te:
Voll stood at the gates of Sarn, and a nation stood behind him. 
He thought of the righteousness of his cause, 
and of the glory he would bring to the empire he would soon lead. 
But as Chitus and his gemlings advanced, he thought only of the fight.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel125\",\"Te:
"I don't know how I know, 
I just know that I know."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel127\",\"Te:
In the weeks that followed the Cataclysm,
the dead began to rot and fester.
The air fouled with such concentration,
that passing birds drowned in flight.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel128\",\"Te: They believed themselves the pinnacle of civilisation, but that height toppled their empire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel129\",\"Te: They believed themselves the greatest warriors, but that savagery turned upon their own.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel130\",\"Te: They believed themselves the most ordered, but that tradition turned their forests to salt.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel131\",\"Te: They believed themselves the utmost faithful, but that conviction became oppression.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel132\",\"Te: They believed themselves better than the past, but that confidence brought about nightmare.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel133\",\"Te:
The enslaved Ezomyte clans were not permitted to own weapons.
For years, they trained in secret, watching and waiting for the
perfect moment to reveal the true depth of the Empire's folly.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel134\",\"Te: Forsake what you might have had. Command power beyond your potential.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel135\",\"Te: Lose that which you never had. Gain power you could not have grasped.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel136\",\"Te: Though we cannot touch; one thought, one wish, through centuries alone in darkness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel137\",\"Te:
Savour the bitter, cherish the sweet,
For there may never be another chance to eat.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel138\",\"Te:
"Try as I might, I could not escape it.
When I closed my eyes, I saw only death.
Each breath tainted with the scent of seared and smouldering flesh,
And each sound tangled with pleas for mercy."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel139\",\"Te:
You can take the girl out of the woods, 
but you can't take the woods out of the girl.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel13_\",\"Te: Even the strongest of steel can be made to bend.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel14\",\"Tex:
When you get down to it, we're all really just
an unprepared meal for something or someone.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel140\",\"Te:
Pain is a fine motivator,
But if you seek the truth,
Fear of pain unknown has no parallel.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel141\",\"Te:
As the dead battered Highgate's barricades,
The Black Sekhema accepted her fate,
And stood her ground.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel142\",\"Te:
Maids used to threaten to send misbehaving children of
nobility to the pits beneath the Grand Arena.
For the children of slaves, it was more than just a threat.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel143\",\"Te:
Once you begin to rely on your weapons, 
You ensure you can't live without them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel144\",\"Te:
It was a great honour to fight at the front. 
The few that survived the initial charge were guaranteed fame and fortune.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel145\",\"Te: You need not go looking for a second opinion.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel146\",\"Te: If you're going to act like you're better than everyone else, make sure you are.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel147\",\"Te: Only a madman would ignore a god's instructions.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel148\",\"Te:
The sky, the land, the people burned.
What little still stood soon faced wild, battering storms.
Winter arrived suddenly and stayed for a generation.
Civilisation was not simply halted, but reversed, erased.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel15\",\"Tex:
The strongest Karui tribes left the longest impressions on the land.
Their symbols served as guidance many generations
after their creators had been buried deep beneath the earth.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel150\",\"Te:
Quenched, the blade hardens, becomes brittle.
The edge will not last forever,
But when it breaks, its service will continue.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel151\",\"Te:
Her apprentice spends hours working the steel,
and the end result is melted for scrap.
Each one made better than the last.
Each one made more quickly.
She knows the path well.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel152\",\"Te: Maximum power fueled by science gone mad.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel153\",\"Te: Indiscriminate destruction fueled by science gone mad.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel154\",\"Te: The Hated Slave seeks dominion over his own kind.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel155\",\"Te: The Sovereign of the Well seeks dominion over the light.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel156\",\"Te: The Blackblooded seeks dominion over darkness itself.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel157\",\"Te: The Liege of the Lightless seeks dominion over the surface dwellers.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel158\",\"Te:
"We awoke to a sudden jungle rupturing the valleys of our home.
Grasping limbs coiled around us, into us. We sank into each other,
then rose into the living sky. My family screams alongside me still."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel159\",\"Te:
"We awoke to a sudden dawn cresting through the mountains.
Each peak rose into searing fire, a massive roiling tide.
A great eye gazed upon us, and we became known—utterly."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel16\",\"Tex:
When you create life from nothing, 
sometimes things get a little stuck in between.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel160\",\"Te:
The minds of those studied utterly by the Cleansing Fire
continue to think and dream and beg for silence...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel161_\",\"T:
The bodies of those wholly subsumed by the Tangle
continue to merge and mutate and cry out for release...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel162\",\"Te:
Gripping the stolen Spear of Solerai in hand,
the bandit king of Stridevolf watched his enclave burn.
As foretold, the weapon was powerful beyond compare,
but using it had cost him absolutely everything.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel163_\",\"T:
She was the last of countless progeny bred to test the limits of limitless power.
In the cosmic prison of her birth, her siblings fought each other to the death
for supremacy. She alone reached her limit... and broke through.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel164\",\"Te:
This world is not good enough for her,
so I will make a better one. Nothing
matters but the pursuit of perfection.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel165\",\"Te: A wellspring of vitality bubbling from within.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel166\",\"Te: A mountain fortress safe from the storm.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel167\",\"Te: A mass of flesh writhing with savage fury.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel171\",\"Te:
Logic wanes in shining faith, and in rationalism, ardour dims
Thus, the cynic and the zealot are divided
But can they not be one and the same?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel172\",\"Te:
How simple a power, on which empires turn,
when one man stands firm and says, "I refuse."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel173\",\"Te:
The true secret of the elements
is that all are one and the same.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel174\",\"Te:
Within a firestorm, the Thane commands the flames
Emblazoned by glory and the song of the First Ones
For the master of fire fears nothing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel175\",\"Te:
In darkest night, 'neath waxen moon
A witch snatches a boy from his room.
He wards off her hexes
The witch he perplexes
And so becomes part of her stew.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel176\",\"Te:
Fellshrine stood as a holy bastion opposite the
Chamber of Sins, and all that it represented.
For one to rise, the other must fall.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel177\",\"Te:
The spirits of our ancestors guided us from the Archipelago to the continent.
Inextricably, the purity of our souls is linked to the ones who came before us.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel178\",\"Te:
At the core of the warrior's spirit,
a fierce determination burns,
igniting their capacity to endure.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel18\",\"Tex:
When you throw iron weapons against an iron wall
you only make the wall grow thicker.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel1b\",\"Tex:
In the end, time comes for all of us.
For some, it comes much sooner.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel2\",\"Text:
"True Thaumaturgy can only be learned 
by the brilliant or the mad."
- Shavronne of Umbra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel20\",\"Tex: It's hard to stay still when you're engulfed in flames.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel20x\",\"Te:
"Does this jewel accomplish nothing? If only we could somehow
master cold and turn it to our own ends..." 
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel22\",\"Tex:
And lo, Nick said unto his disciples:
"It May Be Crazy Broken"
And his disciples replied
"Meh"
And made it anyway.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel24\",\"Tex:
The first green shoots of Spring are the most resilient,
and the most vulnerable.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel24x\",\"Te: "Distribute Prototype #723 to the guards. Perhaps their survival rate will increase."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel25\",\"Tex:
The difference between the master and his apprentice
is what they see when they look at the same block of wood.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel26\",\"Tex:
"If one is an annoyance
then a hundred is a threat."
- Ancient Karui Proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel28\",\"Tex: Each life taken makes the next a little easier.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel29\",\"Tex:
"Take your time, make all your plans. 
Then tell me which plan
pulls my axe from your ribs."
- Barkhul, the Butcher
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel3\",\"Text:
If you do not learn from a won battle
then you have already lost the war.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel30\",\"Tex: When your thoughts flow like a river, why build a dam?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel32_\",\"Te:
"Curiously, as I deepen my understanding of Thaumaturgy,
I find I better understand the land we inhabit
and everything in it."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel33\",\"Tex: Some people live on the suffering of others.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel34\",\"Tex: Working smart and working hard aren't mutually exclusive.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel35\",\"Tex:
Picking a lock takes an immense amount of skill and practice.
Breaking it with a hammer takes about three seconds.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel36\",\"Tex:
"Greatly outnumbered, Deshret dressed her personal guard 
in identical garb. When the Empire rode north, Deshret and 
her guard took turns revealing themselves, creating the illusion 
of speed beyond the capabilities of even the Virtue Gems."
- History of the Maraketh
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel37\",\"Tex: There is no force without movement.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel4\",\"Text: A gentle hand rarely leaves a mark on the world.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel41\",\"Tex: A sharp eye can be more deadly than a sharp blade.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel42\",\"Tex: A steady hand can hold back an army.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel43\",\"Tex: A quick step can advance great plans.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel44x\",\"Te: "The effect is subtle, but potentially lethal..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel45\",\"Tex: What you earn is almost as important as what you take.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel46_\",\"Te: Victory is as simple as being the last one standing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel47\",\"Tex: The best dancers often make the best fighters.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel48\",\"Tex:
Winter provides us with her own weapons,
hanging from the eaves of our homes.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel49\",\"Tex:
Leaders are not born in times of peace.
Leaders are born in ruins and flames.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel5\",\"Text:
The shield crab does not leave his shell unless it is forced to, 
and even then, it knows to keep its distance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel50\",\"Tex: "I've yet to see prayer stop an arrow."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel51\",\"Tex:
The Azmeri ascetics learnt the power
of going without the body's ordinary cravings.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel52\",\"Tex:
Once you understand how your body truly works
you can't help but treat it better.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel53\",\"Tex:
"Movement expends energy, but perhaps a little of that energy
can be recaptured and... reappropriated."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel54\",\"Tex: For the ambitious, flesh is a limitation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel55\",\"Tex: True strength can be found anywhere, and in anything.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel56\",\"Tex:
The prisoners of the empire raised their shackled hands.
Begging to be delivered from Corruption.
The rebellion smote their chains,
And gave them the freedom to choose corruption for themselves.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel57\",\"Tex:
Ondar not only betrayed his emperor,
He betrayed his friend.
And in his dying moments, Chitus ensured,
That Ondar felt the full weight of his guilt.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel58\",\"Tex:
With a fire burning brash in his golden eye,
Marceus fired his arrow into the pitch-dark sky,
And seared the hope of surprise,
From Kaom's skulking horde.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel59\",\"Tex:
The Sekhema rode to the mountain,
With her tribe, devoted and strong.
And sewed shut the mouth of nightmare,
So that it would not consume her world.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel6\",\"Text:
The carpenter who picks up a blade is not mad.
He's ambitious.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel60\",\"Tex:
Maligaro understood that devotion to science,
Means devotion to trial and error.
For Maligaro's errors, death was slow,
And very painful.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel61\",\"Tex:
There's no motivation for genius
quite like desperation.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel61x\",\"Te: "Prototype #298 must be contained in a non-conductive glass box at all times."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel62\",\"Tex:
When Voll took the throne,
He swore to care for the empire with eyes open.
And so he looked to the salvation of his people,
Blind to the damnation in his hands.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel63\",\"Tex:
From north to south the sea of fire swept,
Rolling waves of gorging flame,
Growing taller and hungrier,
With every land they consumed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel64\",\"Tex:
As a boy, Rigwald was taught to hunt,
Through the first snows of winter,
When beasts have gorged their fill,
And see nothing but the long slumber ahead.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel65\",\"Tex:
The Purity Rebels fought with heart and soul,
To free their empire from corruption.
And the fires of war did merely serve,
To temper the steel of their spirits.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel66\",\"Tex:
The once-glorious emperor spent his final days
imprisoned in his greatest creation;
a tool to filter out the unworthy
that pushed a monster to power.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel67\",\"Tex:
A mage from the coast rode up on a broken nag, legs burnt to his bones.
Before he collapsed, he uttered:
"I watched the world we know end yesterday."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel68\",\"Tex:
Chitus began to aggressively expand his empire
into neighbouring nations at great human cost. 
But for absolute power, there is no price 
that a Perandus won't pay.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel69\",\"Tex:
Lioneye's men stood at the walls,
eyeing the savages that walked the beach below.
With a single word,
a thousand bodies, and ten thousand arrows,
would litter the sands.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel7\",\"Text:
The Darktongue clan has long let their undead feed at the table
with their slaves, and occasionally on them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel70\",\"Tex:
Long after the Karui passed through,
the whispers of those who stood their ground
at Lioneye's Watch could be heard amongst the rubble.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel71\",\"Tex: Why waste the good stuff on something that's going to blow up?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel71x\",\"Te: "A curious jewel. Like so many others, a shining little paradox."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel72\",\"Tex:
Anyone can catch a lumbering beast.
Try catching a bird before it has even landed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel73\",\"Tex:
The Ezomytes have a saying:
Take everything and waste nothing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel74\",\"Tex: Saboteurs, like chefs, have their own secret recipes.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel74x\",\"Te:
"Researchers will refrain from giving test subjects virtue gems which produce traps.
We are still finding explosives in the vents months later." 
- Administrator Qotra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel75\",\"Tex: Thoughts that shimmer like light across the rain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel76\",\"Tex: Skin like steel tempered by bright flames.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel77\",\"Tex: Fists that strike like a falling tree.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel78\",\"Tex: The smaller the teeth, the sharper the bite.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel79\",\"Tex:
All revere the earth they walk,
For it wields strength beyond compare,
Holds knowledge more than thought,
Stands long after all else falls.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel80\",\"Tex:
They roamed, they fed, they grew,
Killing as they went,
Conquer though they may,
Their hearts will never be content.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel81\",\"Tex:
"A stone is not a stone.
It is but one part of a fortress."
- Ezomyte proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel82\",\"Tex:
"Do not cause the land to stir,
It holds secrets better unknown."
- Azmerian proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel82x\",\"Te:
"The summoned golems immediately battered through the chamber wall
and killed several guards, but their fury only lasted a short time."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel83\",\"Tex:
"Kings fall, empires crumble, mortals perish.
All turn to earth and sand."
- Maraketh proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel86\",\"Tex:
We coagulate; a crimson shell
that suffocates the unworthy.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel88_\",\"Te:
We take root in the dirt
and strangle those who tread upon it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel9\",\"Text: A helping hand has long reach.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel90\",\"Tex:
We swell and flood
and drown the undeserving beneath our might.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel91\",\"Tex:
Malachai ran roughshod over every ethical boundary in pursuit of creating the ideal gemling.
For him, there was no doubt that the end would justify the means.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel92\",\"Tex:
After years of subterfuge, sabotage, and sacrifice,
Sarn had become a powder keg just waiting to explode.
Finally, Victario lit the match.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel93\",\"Tex:
Even as the tide turned, and victory swiftly became impossible,
the legionnaires of Lioneye's Watch stood their ground and fought on,
every last man dying a brutal, but honourable death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel94\",\"Tex:
Cadiro watched young Chitus play in the frostbitten grass, care-free, happy,
and unburdened by the responsibility the Perandus scion would soon endure.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel95\",\"Tex:
As Malachai stepped into the Highgate mines,
cold winds billowed from the mountain above.
One final, feeble attempt to save what was meant to be eternal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel96\",\"Tex:
News of Kaom's victory in the south spread quickly.
Those in support of the coming rebellion bided their time.
The rest fled like rats from a fire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel97\",\"Tex:
The winter that followed the Cataclysm was especially harsh.
Wraeclast's few survivors fought to the death for the last scraps of bread.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel98\",\"Tex:
Emperor Chitus could offer you a gift with one hand,
and drive a blade into your back with the other.
His blend of brutality and charisma cultured a potent 
mixture of fear and admiration among the masses.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewel99\",\"Tex:
The Maraketh knew that a mountain path
free of vegetation was cut by regular avalanches,
and so the advancing Eternals were unwittingly drawn into a deathtrap.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewelLabyrinth1:
The greatest victories happen
before the battle has begun.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewelLabyrinth2:
Language is a tool that can be used to build walls 
or tear them down.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewelLabyrinth3: Even an iron fist can be handled with grace.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueJewelLabyrinth4:
Learn as much as you can, 
and surround yourself with people who know the rest.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap1\",\"Text\":
"Should I depart this mortal coil,
so shall all of my treasures."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap10\",\"Text\:
They flew, and leapt, and clambered over,
They crawled, and swam, and slithered under.
Still its ancient secrets await unclaimed
And of this hidden temple, only legends remain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap11\",\"Text\:
For this beauty,
beauty without strength,
chokes out life.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap13\",\"Text\:
So the raiders danced,
leading their foe ever west,
towards certain death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap14\",\"Text\: A cool map, for a cool guy.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap15\",\"Text\: We all began life in darkness, we shall all end it there.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap16\",\"Text\:
The grandest and greatest ever to fight,
Divine the champions stand tall.
But match their power, best their might,
And even the immortal may fall.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap2\",\"Text\":
Whispers from a world apart
Speak my name beyond the tomb;
Bound within the Maelström's heart,
Will they grant me strength or doom?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap21\",\"Text\:
The winters of my youth were cold and harsh.
We had nothing, yet to my mother's credit, I wanted for so little.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap22\",\"Text\:
What had seemed sacred and infallible
so quickly became flawed out of necessity.
Created from compromises. Vulnerable to mortal whims.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap23\",\"Text\:
Without our strict rule, man's destructive side would take hold.
Our beautiful public spaces, our services for the ill and the needy,
all of it would crumble.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap24\",\"Text\:
It was in my oath that I found peace.
In echoing marble halls I found my voice.
Before the congregation I found purpose.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap25\",\"Text\:
Though my life is gone, my purpose is not.
My will remains, emboldened and empowered
by the righteousness of my cause.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap25x\",\"Text:
"Did nobody think to report that we had acquired some sort of free-floating
Memory? Cease testing and lock this away immediately!" 
- Administrator Qotra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap26\",\"Text\:
On the outskirts of Utzaal, at the Temple of Chaos,
the Trialmaster awaits your challenge.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap2_13\",\"Tex:
To the east, 
it cannot be seen.
To the west, 
it cannot be touched.
To the south, 
it cannot be remembered.
And to the north, 
it cannot be contained.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap2_14\",\"Tex:
Howls and laughter
They hide in the day
They smell you, they watch you
They track their new prey
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap2_15\",\"Tex:
Forget kings and emperors;
He who holds the coin holds all the power.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap3\",\"Text\":
For his sins he was hunted in his sleep,
judgement wrought of twisted nightmare.
The Coward bound his dreams to stone, awaiting
another to walk the path of true atonement.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap3_16\",\"Tex:
Please take out your blades,
your whips, and your spikes.
Class is now in session.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap3_17\",\"Tex:
Some dead have long envied the living.
When given the chance, they take from us what they can.
So we offer our suffrage.
In return, they give only suffering.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap3_21\",\"Tex:
In the shadow of war,
all are eclipsed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap3_22\",\"Tex: We are ever the makers of our own undoing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap3_23x\",\"Te:
"Whatever these maps are, it is clear they are dangerous. Send in only
test subjects, no guards or researchers." 
- Administrator Qotra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap4\",\"Text\":
Curious, she shook it then,
And tiny screams emerged.
Curiouser, she shook again,
And an eerie silence purred.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap5\",\"Text\":
Laughs of all the twisted
Echo through these halls of gold.
In this cold forgotten void
They wander, forever uncontrolled.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap5x\",\"Text\:
"Suppression troop two, the 'Martyrs for Science,' were able to seal
the portals before Outpost Four was overrun. Only three men survived."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap7\",\"Text\":
The Treasures of the Tides wait
in agony at the End of the World.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueMap9\",\"Text\":
"Here the soil is more deadly than any swing of the axe."
- Oba of the Karui, Conqueror of Corruption.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe1\",\: It is too easy for the soul to escape from an open heart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe10\",:
Better to act without thought
than to think without action.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe1x\",:
"Nothing feels so smooth in the hand as Prototype #66.
Results like these may justify everything we do here."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe2\",\:
Born of love, forged in blood
He burned as a torch in the blackest night
She shone as ice in the winter sun
Proudly, fiercely
At their mother's side, forever.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe3\",\:
The eagle knows nothing
but the scream and the strike.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe4\",\: Kill us with kindness, cut us with care.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe5\",\: "More blood... hack open flesh... must drink..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe6\",\:
Relentless fury
Sunder my every foe
Fuel my boiling blood
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe7\",\:
The fastest way to a man's heart
is through his sternum.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe8\",\:
Beneath the cold light of the moon,
the wing moves faster than the eye.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandAxe9\",\:
Tear the flesh from the bone. 
Turn the bone to dust.
Scatter the dust to the wind.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandClaw11\":
Izaro saw himself not as a man,
but as a divine saviour trapped in a man's body.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandClaw12\":
"A man cowers behind his walls.
A woman carries her fortress with her.
In heart, in mind, in hand."
- Sekhema Deshret
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandClaw12x\:
"Additional test subjects approved. Determine exactly how many wounds
need to be endured to activate Prototype #612's energies."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace1\",:
"I know how to say 'faster' and 'attack'
in Karui, Marak and Ezo."
- Voll of Thebrus
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace10\":
A merciful murderer swept through the streets of Sarn
Robbing breath from the weak and worthless.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace10x\:
"Three test subjects confirmed Prototype #495 creates an additional
debilitating effect from poisons. This could be very useful."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace11\":
They hoped that, trapped in its prison,
the creature would age and perish.
But time would not touch the fiend.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace2\",:
Old Bartek still stands, but is courteously
bowing to the might of time.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace3\",: Look the storm in the eye and you will have its respect.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace4\",:
"You'll have my riches when you pry them
from my cold, dead hands!"
"That's how I prefer it."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace5\",:
To neither ebb nor flow,
but weather the rising tide,
outlast, unshifting and unshifted,
until the waters recede and we stand together.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace6\",:
Sure, there's many a hard man out there.
But this'll soften them up.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace7\",:
"The painful memories are the easiest to recall."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace8\",:
I suffer, I long, with thirst to slake.
Though countless corpses lie in wake.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandMace9\",:
There is nothing, flesh, spirit, or stone
Free from our hunger for dominion.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword1\": As battle calms, blood turns to rust.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword10\:
As a maiden I was bound; as a crone was I scorned
Promised power rarely found, delivered fury fairly thorned.
Not enough?...Fine. Now I am become both and another
To take your hand and cradle your talents, not smother
The consummate flames. So hush, dear, say not a word. 
Bequeathed, betrayed...beloved. At last, I am the third.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword11\: Master yourself before you seek to master others.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword12\:
"She's pretty, aye. So pretty you'll
want to be with her long after you're dead."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword13\:
"May the Blessed Lakishu watch our backs and our wives."
- Legionnaire Battle Blessing
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword14\:
"With this, I will weave the threads of fate 
into a noose for our 'glorious' emperor."
- Chitus Perandus
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword15\:
Fear not death. Turn to him, face him.
And smile as he sinks his teeth
into the throats of our oppressors.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword16\:
The blade thrums with wild energy
Eager for vengeance against all who walk free.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword16x:
"Test subjects were unable to strike even a motionless target.
However, when a trained guard tried it..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword17\:
"Painful suicide in the hands of a fool, 
Creative death in the hands of a master."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 2992
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword18\:
A sword he brought, his foes to maim and rend,
from places dark behind forbidden doors,
but night by night he woke with frighten'd roars
from ghoulish dreams, too strange to comprehend.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword18x:
"The night-gaunts, they fly, soaring about in darkness beyond the ken of mankind.
I hear the silent whispers of their wings as they descend, for me, for me..." 
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword19\:
Even from the back rows,
the whistling steel was mesmerising.
They watched the dance in the arena dust, silent as the dead.
A spell only broken by the spilling of blood.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword2\":
In the rift between future and past,
life passes quickly.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword20\:
Quickly cooled the steel,
but never could it forget
the heat of the forge.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword21\:
Breathe deep, my child.
Let the frigid air engulf your soul.
Embrace the eternal cold, 
And it will embrace you back.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword23\:
They grow fat and ripe in slumber.
To be fed upon when he wakes.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword24\:
"Impossibly heavy, yet the ancient edge is as keen as any modern blade's.
A reminder that, in the end, when we lie in the bellies of worms,
it is what we make that makes us."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 47
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword26\:
"Your name is Demon Slayer? Really? Good name for rotgut, that."
She said: I prefer "The Goddess Of Swords". Much more dignified. And accurate.
"Demon Slayer The Cheap And Nasty it is then. Burns going down, burns coming up?"
She said: Every single time, Charan. And still...you'll bathe me, and you'll drink my love. Until you can't.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword28\:
By wind and wing they are carried,
Their fates not theirs to control,
Yet the fates of others dragged in their wake.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword29\:
Through war we found peace. Through death we found advancement.
Our ancestors did not know where their actions would take them.
Are we any better?

<default>{This item can be transformed on the Altar of Sacrifice along with Vial of Fate}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword3\":
Though the Vaal revered peace, it would have
been suicide for any culture to rouse them to war.
- Icius Perandus, Scholar to the Empire.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword30\:
Doryani promises immortality, yet we build great structures, 
carve magnificent works into stone, so a part of us lives onward.
A sign of faithlessness through action.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword31\:
On the mirrored edge of infinity,
one man sinks forever into darkness,
one man rises into light.
But which one am I?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword34\:
Its forging marked the melding of man
and Titan against the rising darkness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword4\":
Her purpose seems done; the oath is fulfilled.
Rust dulls her smirk with the last demon killed.
The embers grow dim and yet hope burns her lips:
"An old flame renewed can define our eclipse!"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword5\":
"A raging Solaris seared and contorted the orb's surface.
A despairing Lunaris filled the scars with her tears.
Yet Viridi remained, trapped within, forever more."
 - Azmerian Creation Myth
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword6\":
"Hyaon the 'Red Wolf'
Howling mad
Cloaked in blood
A banner to his legion
A terror to his foes."
- Garivaldi, Chronicler to the Empire
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword7\":
Maligaro was transformed by Raulo's love.
Thaumaturgy allowed Maligaro to return the favour.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword8\":
Being lost is a trick of the mind.
A man always has two directions available to him.
Forward and through.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword9\":
She dances a dance beneath the shade,
The twilight shroud her only blade,
Who now hears her feathersteps flowing?
Beneath the stars, the moondrops glowing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSword9x\:
"Once we armoured the test subject heavily enough to test Prototype #502, he proceeded
to fight his way out. I don't know what we expected." 
- Researcher Graven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueOneHandSwordDem:
Stories of heroism by the victor persist,
for no one survives to contest them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver1\",\"Tex:
Molten feathers, veiled spark,
Hissing arrows from the dark.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver10\",\"Te:
The fortunate inscribe their legacy
in the pages of history books.
The rest of us must leave our mark with our blood
or the blood of others.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver11\",\"Te:
Beaten in contest, he would try once more
Guided by magic, Magjar took aim at a dove
Saemus' gift would influence the score
Guided by darkness, Magjar spilled the blood of his love
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver12\",\"Te:
If two great leaders like Lioneye and Kaom
had been on the same side of the battle,
nothing would remain unconquered.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver15x\",\"T:
"The Midnight Tinkerer's aid was invaluable during our brief alliance,
but when we failed to make any progress on resurrection, he continued his search elsewhere..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver16\",\"Te: Claws open, brace for a bite. Stinger raised, dodge or die.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver18\",\"Te: The dance of metal and flesh never ends.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver19\",\"Te: What do you see when you look inward?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver2\",\"Tex:
Seeing only foot soldiers, the Sarn Knights cast aside
their heavy shields... and paid dearly for their mistake.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver3\",\"Tex:
"Why waste such a fine arrow on just one man?"
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver4\",\"Tex:
"It's a rare man that has eyes in the back of his head."
- Kiravi, Vaal Archer
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver5\",\"Tex:
Mist of breath
Icing to lips and throat
As the warm ones choke and fall
Upon the frozen wasteland.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver6\",\"Tex:
A Karui woman's place was not the
battlefield, but the hearth.
Hyrri changed all of that.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver7\",\"Tex:
In this chaotic world
The rewards of the Soul
Outlast the rewards of the Flesh.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver7x\",\"Te:
"The theft of another's vitality is short-lived, but sweet.
It calls to me, bidding me abandon all other pursuits."
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver8\",\"Tex: Hit them hard. Hit them once.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueQuiver9\",\"Tex:
Fear not the dark, the song of night,
Hear not the arch, the falling cry.
My giving sun, fight no more,
Rest alone, my grand nightfall.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRapier1\",\"Tex:
She paints her offer in wicked hues
An off-white grin, an elegant bruise.
To the nascent scourge she sings the ruse:
"With me in hand, what else need you use?"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRapier2\",\"Tex:
Many a collector of rarities discovered to his dismay
that the intelligent spirit in this sword
does not like to share its master's attention
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRapier3\",\"Tex: Galla had an answer to everything.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRapier4\",\"Tex:
It doesn't matter how well the young swordsman trains.
All form and finesse are forgotten when blood first hits the ground.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRapier5\",\"Tex:
A single breeze blows
A hundred blades dance
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRapier6\",\"Tex: What has no siblings but is always a twin?
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRapier6x\",\"Te:
"This is one riddle I can't solve." 
- Researcher Graven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRelic1\",\"Text:
Centuries of peace brought immense wealth to Keth,
but many worried that it had also left the people soft.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRelic2\",\"Text:
By fire and ice, perhaps the end of the world.
They did not fall on their knees and lament.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRelic3\",\"Text:
All rejoiced when Solerai and Lundara shattered the grey sky,
but with the cold banished, sandier climes began to creep in...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRelic4\",\"Text:
As they looked toward the future, yet held close the past,
the tale-women began to see the tapestry of Time.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRelic5\",\"Text:
The path forward is unknown,
but someone must lead.
Let it be the best of us.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRelic6\",\"Text: In the coldest depths of the Winter of the World, overrun by darkness and fighting to the last, life itself clung to existence by the barest remaining thread.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueReliquaryKeyChe:
In every era, in every age, Fate conspires to
unite heroes from across Wraeclast. That is
the secret of history: Fate and Order are one.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing10\",\"Text:
The portrait reflected his pain,
a pain that she could never see.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing14\",\"Text:
"Our warehouses are bursting. Our vaults are full.
But our minds are still hungry."
- Medici Perandus, Prefect to the Treasury
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing15\",\"Text: Let winter come. It will only make my fire burn brighter.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing16\",\"Text:
Ming slew Tranquillity
Took Chaos for his wife
And on Her immortal finger
He placed his Heart
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing17\",\"Text:
The Empress gave Romira two sons
Born of his brother's seed
Romira threw her a banquet
A perfidious meal indeed.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing18\",\"Text:
"From Frost's ice-bound pass
Berek taunted and jeered
Until furious Flame scaled the mountain
Berek escaped through the thaw
And Frost's tortured moans."
- Berek and the Untamed
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing19\",\"Text:
"Berek hid from Storm's lightning wrath
In the embrace of oblivious Frost
Repelled by ice, blinded by blizzards
Storm raged in vain
While Berek slept."
- Berek and the Untamed
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing2\",\"Text\:
A token from the sea
A sign for Kaom
to lead his Karui to Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing20\",\"Text:
"With Flame licking at his heels
Berek berated the clouds
Until vengeful Storm spewed forth his rains
And Berek held on tight
As Fire screamed and steamed
And fled."
- Berek and the Untamed
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing21\",\"Text:
"Moon after moon did Berek make fools
Of the great and Untamed Three
Until malice for a Brother
Slew the hatred of the Other
And Berek did hunt
Alone and free."
- Berek and the Untamed
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing22\",\"Text:
On one hand, you have a choice.
On the other, you have its twin.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing23\",\"Text: The darker the eye, the more diligent the watched.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing23x\",\"Tex: "So close, yet frustratingly distinct. Something more is going on here..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing24\",\"Text: Fire makes the perfect blossom in the endless night.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing25\",\"Text:
When the wind blows, 
Know which way to bend
and watch the others break.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing25x\",\"Tex:
"As much as Prototype #20 hints at some deep alternate physics, we cannot afford
to expend any more test subjects. Experiments halted."
- Administrator Qotra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing27\",\"Text:
"To us mere mortals, time is slippery. 
I'm just evening things out." 
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing28\",\"Text: Rage is a big part of courage.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing29\",\"Text:
A gift from Valako,
appointing Kiloava as the Herald of War.
A title Kaom claimed when he ended Kiloava's bloodline.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing3\",\"Text\: Danger is the price of wealth.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing30\",\"Text:
A gift from Tasalio, God of Water,
to the chieftain Rakiata.
Kaom took Rakiata's head and hand
so that his warriors' axes might rise and fall like the waves.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing30x\",\"Tex:
"Likely our closest to the original, yet Prototype #22 still falls short.
Are these objects actually somehow resisting our efforts?"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing31\",\"Text:
A gift from Ngamahu,
a sign to the Karui to spread like fire.
Given to Akoya, but inherited by Kaom with the swing of his axe.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing32\",\"Text:
In a blaze of glory,
An anomaly defying all odds
The "unkillable" beast met the divine
And Ventor met his latest trophy.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing33\",\"Text:
When the axe finally fell, Seryl shared his pain,
and the last thought that flickered through his
fading mind was her broken, shattered scream.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing34\",\"Text:
Forged by three brothers
so that they may recognize each other
across any distance of time or travel.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing35\",\"Text:
Each time, it is granted to the most senior captain of the fleet,
and each time, the ring soon washes ashore once more, 
still wrapped around a severed finger.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing36\",\"Text:
To ascend to leadership, the child of a Redblade warlord
must pull the band from the still-hot
ashes of their father.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing37\",\"Text:
When a fallen leader's body is taken to the funeral peak,
those who seek power must ascend together.
One returns with the seal. 
The rest do not return at all.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing38\",\"Text: Leave the world in flames behind you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing38x_\",\"Te:
"The flames raced through Lab Five with incredible speed, but were extinguished
just as quickly. This could have been much worse." 
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing39\",\"Text:
A man who changes his loyalties often,
soon finds he has none.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing4\",\"Text\:
Where her mouth should have been
there was only a whirling, black void.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing40\",\"Text:
"This thing is not a pet. It is a parasite that feeds on the very will of its host.
Like any part of nightmare, it has found a way to make its price... acceptable."
- Malachai the Soulless
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing41\",\"Text:
Within the heart of every man and woman
lies the soul of a ferocious beast.
If you cannot tame it, embrace it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing42\",\"Text:
The Thaumaturgical masters of the Eternal Empire,
as unpredictable and varied as they were,
all understood one thing:
Free thinking leads to free action.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing43\",\"Text: They will rise and fall in fire and blood.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing44\",\"Text:
They wrap around you
until your blood turns as cold as theirs.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing45\",\"Text:
"I don't always have a flame handy
when a fresh delinquent walks through our gates."
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing46\",\"Text:
A man can spend his whole life fishing
before he learns it is not fish that he seeks.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing48\",\"Text: Be careful where you put your finger.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing49\",\"Text: Be not stirred by the Void.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing4x\",\"Text:
"Prototype #8 makes it difficult to think negatively, but two fatalities
resulted when a lead researcher used an epithet in its presence."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing5\",\"Text\:
Doryani stumbled into a realm of madness
And awoke its Master.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing51\",\"Text:
When your skin sloughs, and your blood cooks,
you'll wish the lightning strike had killed you.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing52\",\"Text:
So great was the thaumaturgy of a bloodpriest's mark,
that sacrifices soon welcomed their death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing53b\",\"Tex:
Where once had stood a village, lay naught but splinters.
Some had once been her home. 
Some had once been her creations.
Some had once been her family.

<default>{This item can be combined with a Mountain and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing53c\",\"Tex:
The river, once fertile and fresh, 
and flowing briskly to the sea,
now stood, stained, at a standstill.
Dammed by the coagulating dead.

<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Mountain ring at a Vendor.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing53d\",\"Tex:
The narrow path turned to rough rocks that led towards the sky.
One last obstacle in a life-long journey
to find a land they could call home.

<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing53e\",\"Tex:
Cold winds blasted what little grew on the icy surface.
The gifts of the land lay hidden deeper,
and only patience and persistence would free them.

<default>{This item can be combined with a Mountain and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing53f\",\"Tex:
Sheltered beneath thick ice,
the river ferried fat fish towards the sea.
But the First King knew the river's secret,
and the fish were not the only ones who grew fat.

<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Mountain ring at a Vendor.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing53g\",\"Tex:
He surveyed his lands, green and vital,
watched with pride as his slaves quarried fine stone for his fortress,
and thanked the heavens for his many blessings.
But this pilgrimage to the peak was to be his last.

<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing53h\",\"Tex:
The fields were silent but for the plucking of fruits,
the rustling of leaves, and the breaking of stone.
No slave dared to speak or look the passing king in the eye.
No one... except Aul.

<default>{This item can be combined with a Mountain and Valley ring at a Vendor.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing53i\",\"Tex:
With no stone for rebuilding, each storm took its toll on the village.
Huts eventually collapsed, their occupants injured or dead.
Bodies were left by the river, to appease the gods.
But the dead would not remain there.

<default>{This item can be combined with a Meadow and Mountain ring at a Vendor.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing55\",\"Text:
"Fusing the parasite with another ring has manifested unpredictable effects.
I theorise the sacrificial vessel's level of anguish is a key variable."
- Arzaak, Syndicate Researcher
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing56\",\"Text:
I condemned an innocent man to the pyres, but to admit this mistake is to condemn myself.
My only choice is to strive harder.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing57\",\"Text:
My subordinates circled me eternally, attuned to the slightest weakness,
ready to tear me apart for their own gains.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing58\",\"Text:
I sacrificed a life of love for one of responsibility, so that she,
and others like her, might be kept safe.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing59\",\"Text:
I was a happy child, before the cruel truth was revealed to me.
I fight so that the children may remain ignorant.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing6\",\"Text\:
Existence is infinite
A weave of the living and dead
Beyond the understanding
Of the many mortal threads
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing60\",\"Text:
I feel the moral weight of what I must do to protect Wraeclast.
I accept my guilt without shame. It is my gift to humanity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing61\",\"Text:
There is a way to survive the bite of an ice snake,
but few have the resolve to attempt it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing62\",\"Text:
Those members of the Brotherhood who employ the venom of 
Trarthan ice snakes must take great care with the volatile substance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing64\",\"Text: The body stands, but the spirit soars.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing65\",\"Text: The machines do not hate. They merely serve one who does.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing66\",\"Text: Lightning lives in an endless circle.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing67\",\"Text: Somebody does have to get hurt.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing68\",\"Text: All roads lead to that destined doom.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing69\",\"Text:
Beyond the veil of death, there burns a fire
by whose light night is borne.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing7\",\"Text\:
The ring I stole,
My finger they took,
A shrouded mind,
Cut their curses short,
As I drained their spirit
And stole their soul.
A blessing is often a curse.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing70\",\"Text:
Accept the infection, let it take hold.
Then carry it far and wide.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing71\",\"Text:
The priest that carried Yaomac's sigil was
granted one boon by each serpentine head.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing72\",\"Text:
Those that escaped the annihilating light
sank eternally into crushing darkness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing73\",\"Text:
Only when the mind is empty of ambition
can the cold truth of existence take hold.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing74\",\"Text:
Too much of something is bad enough;
too much of nothing is just as tough.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing75\",\"Text:
Enraged by the incompetence of mortals
The demon-lord opens a gateway
Unleashing a litany of pain upon the world.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing76\",\"Text:
Innocence rose to godhood not on inspired faith,
but on the vilification and hatred of another.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing77_\",\"Tex:
"Slay my twin and I will inherit her wisdom.
Slay me and her life will be prolonged by my demise.
Our souls are eternally bound by the sacrifices we have made."
- High Priest Atazek
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRing9\",\"Text\:
By its light, Lori led her young charges to safety
and bound up their wounds.
Her sword arm was iron, yet her heart gentle
and proof against hate.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRingDemigods1\":
The victor stands tall with hand held high,
unwavering, unblinking, unstoppable.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueRingVictors\",\:
The road to victory is paved
with the bones of the defeated.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueScepter17\",\"T: Breathe deep, and give yourself over to eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre1\",\"Te:
Knowledge brings power, and with power you can
grab truth by the throat and shape it as you wish.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre10\",\"T:
"All are welcome in Hinekora's eternal home." 
- Karui Proverb
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre11\",\"T:
Thousands gazed upon the doors of the great labyrinth,
at an Eternal Champion in steel and gold, 
The first to challenge its treacherous traps. 
To mark the occasion, Izaro had the Champion's remains gilded.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre12\",\"T:
When God forged the rules of reality,
he stated that some forces cannot co-exist.
He then made man with an unequivocal
desire to disobey.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre13\",\"T:
In time, all becomes nothing.
We just expedite the process.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre14\",\"T:
Fight not the cold
Forsake hope
Be still.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre14x\",\":
"Attempt #2520: Been slaving away at this one for longer than I can remember.
Convinced this assignment is retribution from my superior..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre16_\",\": The worst of Axiom were imprisoned by more than iron.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre17\",\"T:
After the fires swept down from the sky and swallowed the city,
all that lingered, as if locked in time,
was a memory of that which was gone, a whisper of deeds undone.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre18\",\"T:
When the world spins out of control,
the safest place to be is in the centre.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre19\",\"T:
There the weary multitude of man-kind 
shall turn in their masses into the wide fire, 
where the destroying flame embraces the living, 
some will go up, some down, filled with misery.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre19x\",\":
"Lord of Bone, Lord of Flesh, yet all that we can
master turns to ash." 
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre2\",\"Te:
Left in her tomb by the lynch mob,
the flame inside still blazed bright after her death,
and so did hers.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre20\",\"T: The greatest of guardians make the greatest of sacrifices.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre21\",\"T:
The vastness of the cosmos holds energies beyond comprehension,
should one have the fortitude to grasp them.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre21x\",\":
"We could rival the gods with this power, if only we had the mitigating mechanisms
to make it work. A jewel, a talisman, an armour... or the Font..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre22\",\"T: A secret few among the Templars grant absolution by bearing the guilt of others.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre23\",\"T: Lead the army of the damned from the front.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre24\",\"T: Their three serpentine heads found unity in balance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre3\",\"Te: With death as my ally, all the world is within my grasp.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre4\",\"Te:
"We Ezomytes made promises that this
Eternal God would have us break."
- Thane Rigwald
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre5\",\"Te:
Beneath the blue,
The stillness permits
The drowned dead
To regret their choices.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre6\",\"Te:
My Iron heart will beat when yours is rust.
I take your Strength, your power, your lust.
By Iron Will alone I set my mind in motion.
Through endless storms of fervent devotion.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre7\",\"Te:
The result of the catalytic reaction would be either immortality for all,
or death for all. It was a risk Doryani was willing to take.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre8\",\"Te:
Feed on the light of the living,
Bring darkness to all I see,
Until we are one in shadow.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSceptre9\",\"Te:
"A sprinkle of liquid encouragement is often required 
to garnish the perfect confession." 
- Brutus, Warden of Axiom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel1\",\"T:
Destruction incarnate leaves a bitter aftertaste
as one soul is imbued with remnants of another,
and the earth is salted by rivers of blood.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel11\",\":
Mechanisms gone awry, circuitry in flux.
This experiment became something truly perverse.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel12\",\": Torture something enough, and you just might force a reaction.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel2\",\"T:
Alone among the powers of artifice, there is one against
which the horrors of Wraeclast have never adapted.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel3_\",\": She stands grim, wreathed in flame, awaiting the crusader's call.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel3b\",\":
Knowing the human body to harbour infinite potential,
she endowed her subjects with the most potent forces at her disposal,
striving invariably for improvement.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel3c\",\": Some artists wait a lifetime for inspiration. He waited for five.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel3d\",\": Even after she harvested their tongues, they were still able to scream.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel3e\",\":
This grotesque conglomerate is truly an abomination to behold.
You feel a strange sense of déjà vu when you gaze upon its hideous visage...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel3f\",\":
A fiery horror from a distant plane of existence,
it feasts upon the charred corpses subsumed by lava pits.
Don't fall in...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel3h\",\":
He feeds on the nightmares of the Atlas' denizens.
If you fall asleep in the Atlas, he'll be waiting...
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel4\",\"T:
In the wake of tyranny,
The battlefields have been left barren.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel6\",\"T: Under clouds of black beset by crimson lightning, we sailed stormy seas of poison and disease. Only one light shone in that darkness; only one Flame to keep hope alive.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel7\",\"T: A life without risk is no life at all.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel8\",\"T: On judgement day, only those who are worthy will survive.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSentinel9\",\"T:
Otherworldly incantations echo across the battlefield,
And the warrior readies his blade.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDemigods\: The light of victory burns eternally.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex1\",\": Cold, miserable and alone... but alive.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex2\",\":
"With piety and justice."
- Perandus family motto
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex3\",\":
"As long as I see death in my mirror, so will Wraeclast."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex4\",\": An eye for an eye. A curse for a curse.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex5\",\":
Crimson burn'd the star of sadness,
All was woe that seem'd but gladness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex6\",\":
The horrors we've encountered are nothing
compared to the horrors we haven't.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex7\",\": Embrace the snow or be buried.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex8\",\":
Light as a board,
Stiff as a feather.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDex8x\",\:
"For personal defence, Prototype #444 is fantastic. It is one hundred percent
effective seventy five percent of the time... once." 
- Lead Researcher Ksaret
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDexInt1\":
One wrong step triggers destruction.
Agony slowly dominates the will to live.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDexInt2\":
"Look around you. What do you see? 
Corruption, perversion, sin?
No. It is progress. 
You simply lack the means to see it." 
- Inquisitor Maligaro
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDexInt3\":
Izaro's insistence on using lava
resulted in some surprising material discoveries.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDexInt5\":
"Great minds wish to reveal all the secrets of time and space.
But it does not matter. Creation, the act of Matter Metamorphosis, 
is the only secret worth discovering." 
- Zeel, Vaal Tinkerer
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDexInt6\":
Something within the machine never stops moving,
but Oriathan scholars dare not open it to find out why.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDexInt7\": The lightning fears not the flame.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldDexInt8\": Horrific experiments with corrupted flesh require careful management.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt1\",\":
The Vaal emptied their slaves of beating hearts,
and left a mountain of twitching dead.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt10\",\: Without night, there can be no day.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt12\",\: Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt13\",\:
The empire is both the tree and the fruit.
It provides safe harbour as ideas grow within,
and when the time is right, the apple is picked. 
The idea, and our ideals, take root.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt14\",\:
Though we live and act as individuals,
in truth, we are tethered together. 
The barriers that divide us need not be broken 
for our spirits to become entangled.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt15\",\: Fear not the fury of the storm.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt16\",\:
You shall be weighed and measured. You shall be judged...
and perhaps you shall be found worthy.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt2\",\":
You carried me through life,
The least I can do is carry you through death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt3\",\":
The last thing Arimagius heard was the
jester's mocking bells in the distance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt4\",\":
Open your eyes and you will see the cracks in your enemy's walls.
Open your mind and you will see the cracks in your enemy's plans.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt5\",\": The lords of the sea bow to no one.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt6\",\":
Those who are skilled in combat do not become angered.
Those who are skilled at winning do not become afraid. 
Thus the wise win before they fight, 
while the ignorant fight to win.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt7\",\":
Thaumaturgy has no limit.
It is our fragile reality that imposes boundaries.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldInt8\",\":
She looked upon her reflection
and trembled, and shook,
until she was not what she saw.

<default>{This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Esh}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr1\",\":
Marceus' unblemished shield is a testament
to his arrogance... and his fate.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr10\",\:
Tukohama couldn't lose a fight in his fortress,
So he carried his fortress to the fight.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr10x\",:
"As one of our few creations that did not cost any fatalities,
Prototype #10 bore unexpectedly positive results."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr11\",\:
"It's not Karui, Azmeri or even Vaal in origin,
but one thing is certain. It is very, very old."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 46
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr12\",\:
Lunaris crossed silently, shining and full, 
Softly night left her, alone and forlorn.
Solaris rose to meet her, feeling her pull.
'Neath the midday sun, the night was reborn.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr13\",\:
"The newcomers warn of doom and death beyond mortal ken.
I ask, why should we fear the fire when we serve the Lord of Light?"
- Maxarius, the first High Templar
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr2\",\":
A mighty bulwark, curved and strong
A dauntless wall, against the throng
All lance and arrow, knocked aside
For rout of foe, for turn of tide.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr3\",\":
Fire dances with those who doubt
Licks the skin and flesh from the fearful
Where there is no fear
There is no flame
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr5\",\":
The problem with working fresh trolltimber:
by the time you've carved out one end, 
the other has sprouted fresh roots!
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr7\",\": A true predator does not chase; It waits.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr8\",\":
We are within her reach,
and when the time is right,
she will reach into us.

<default>{This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Uul-Netol}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStr9\",\":
Our hearts cry out
but are silenced by our flesh
and so we give up our flesh.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrDex1\":
By tourney's end, Daresso bled and shivered.
Yet even accursed treachery failed to steal the champion's victory.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrDex3\":
The thicker the shell,
the greater the beast that hunts it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrDex4\":
Silent, silent night,
Quench the holy light.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrDex6\":
Never let the audience know your true form. Misdirect them,
beguile them. Strike when they least expect it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrDex7\":
Judge not the weak, for
they empower the strong.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrDex8\": Every clash leaves one more scar.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt1\": A swift mind solves problems before they occur.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt100: Druids of the Grelwood never fight alone.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt11\:
Eternal soldiers fight for glory or death.
The Solaris Vanguard know only glory.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt12\:
An Emperor must conquer his own darkness
before he can act as a beacon of light.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt13\:
Chitus' success stemmed from his cunning, taking calculated
risks so that greater dangers could be averted.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt15\:
The Banished Architect sought to employ all the
darkest secrets of the Vaal... at the same time.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt2\": When blood is paid, the weak think twice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt4\":
Born from the marriage of ice and sky,
the aurora evokes both awe and power.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt5\":
My bearer shall be guarded by flame,
for I am the phoenix, forever radiant in glory.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt6\":
"Let the evil ones deliver their fiery darts.
This time I've put my faith in steel."
 - Commander Santoni of the Damned Brotherhood
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt7\":
What is below is like what is above,
and what is above is like what is below,
to accomplish the miracles of one thing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt8\": Be not blinded by the light.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt9\": A man's life is the greatest gift he can give.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueShieldStrInt9x\:
"Close to the original, and perhaps even more useful. However,
close is not what we are looking for. Keep trying." 
- Administrator Qotra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueSpear1000\",\"T: As the flow of battle demanded, she became a sudden storm or a vanishing wind.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff1\",\"Text:
Burn to cinders, scar and maim,
Rule a world, bathed in flame.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff10\",\"Tex: That which was broken may yet break.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff1000\",\"T: A thousand years of dark skies and unending cold.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff11\",\"Tex:
The best way to gain the element of surprise,
is to let your enemy learn your plans,
and execute them - twice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff12\",\"Tex:
Guard your darkest thoughts well, for they are
the cracks through which the Nightmare crawls.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff13\",\"Tex:
"God's creations always begin and end
with flames and ice.
We should count ourselves lucky when we see neither."
- Archbishop Geofri
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff14\",\"Tex:
When the storm comes,
the safest place to be is the centre.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff15\",\"Tex:
"They spent a lifetime in the service of God, 
only to spend eternity in the service of me." 
- Kadavrus, Surgeon to the Umbra
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff16\",\"Tex:
"Since one with knowledge of machines
might be able to bring the labyrinth to a standstill, 
Izaro had us place many boobytrapped decoys.
But I know which switch brings the monster down."
- Xirgil, Trapbuilder's final words.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff17\",\"Tex:
"The world is not simply black and white,
it is not divided into good and evil.
But black and white, good and evil, do exist,
and we must know how to recognize them."
- Archbishop Geofri
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff17x\",\"Te:
"Lab Two suffered significant structural damage in the process of creating
Prototype #77. It is, however, the closest we've come to perfection."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff18\",\"Tex:
You have been found guilty.
Let the fires cleanse you of your sins.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff2\",\"Text:
Shed by the winged beast of night,
A scaly frost-encrusted thorn.
All who feel its wintry light
Shiver in pain at the frozen dawn.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff21\",\"Tex:
"Creation is the act of making the intangible tangible.
To work backwards, to make the tangible intangible,
is to step into the mind of a god."
- Doryani, Queen's Thaumaturgist
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff22\",\"Tex:
Blurred is the boundary
between creator and destroyer.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff23\",\"Tex: Death is but the start of your servitude.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff24\",\"Tex:
There was never a simpler time.
Just simpler motivations.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff25\",\"Tex: The pyre is never wasted on just one heretic.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff27\",\"Tex:
To stand at the confluence of the elements,
the master must achieve perfect balance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff28\",\"Tex: Bow before her... or suffer the most gruelling death imaginable.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff3\",\"Text:
Forged to rule the waves and tide
Destined to serve the monkey's paw
Strong as a tower of iron
Deft as the needle doubt
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff30\",\"Tex:
There is no force more destructive in the heavens
than the scintillating light of utter clarity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff31\",\"Tex:
Life... Death...
The whim of the cosmos.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff32\",\"Tex:
For their mortal allies, the last Titans forged a mighty staff,
one that could safely hold the first unearthed virtue gem.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff4\",\"Text:
You've no reason for fear when you're a root in a fen
- Old Ezomyte saying.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff4x\",\"Tex:
"Attempt #306: The power I can sense in this ancient branch
still eludes me. Perhaps if I attach some string and a hook..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff5\",\"Text:
The whispers of the dead
Carry wisdom for the living,
If you are willing to give your life
To listen.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff6_\",\"Tex:
"To shake a hand is to double your power."
- Jaetai, Queen's Advisor
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff7\",\"Text:
The right to rule demands mental acuity,
a strong arm,
And a tenacious sense of justice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff8\",\"Text: One for each corner of the great Vinktar Square.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff9\",\"Text: Touch not the thorn, for only blood and pain await.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStaff9x\",\"Tex:
"Physical forces and flames seem to share some innate bond.
What logic lies beneath the veil of reality?"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStrDexHelmet1\":
We wander to pass time.
We travel to fulfill.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStrHelmet2\",\":
Hrimnor's presence was as cold as ice,
but his heart burned for vengeance.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStrongboxEtched:
During the first rain of each year, rich and poor alike
chased the Beetle through the flooding streets of Keth,
and its bounty was shared equally by all.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStrongboxEzomyt: The cycle of vengeance never ends... even in death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStrongboxVaal\":
His Trials will end when Time does...
and then, they will begin again.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueStrongboxVentor:
Prospero smiles upon you, fair traveller.
Step close, take a chance, and try fortune's fare!
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTalisman1\",\"T:
In the light of Solaris, the shadows cower and hide.
But every night they gather and grow,
and all but the strong and the stupid
seek shelter from their grasp until daybreak.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTalisman2\",\"T:
Long ago, the ocean was a puddle where a golden fish dwelt,
who lit the ocean from within and kept the water fresh.
When the sky burned, the fish dived deep,
never to return, and the waters turned sour.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTalisman3\",\"T:
Just as the rat cowers before the dog
and the dog cowers before Man,
so too should we cower before the First Ones
and pray we never learn of what comes next.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTalisman4\",\"T:
I once thought the First Ones were just
stories made to scare children.
But I've seen what they can do. I've felt it.
And now I must live with that terrible knowledge.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTalisman5\",\"T:
I am but a vessel for a greater force.
It acts through me. Speaks through me.
Decides what lives and dies through me.
And will change the world through me.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAce2\",\:
Accept your fate, or lie, pretend.
Death collects you in the end.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe1\",\:
One by one, Kaom slaughtered the weakest tribe
leaders until the others leapt to join his cause.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe10\",: When a craving cannot be sated, any source will do.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe12\",:
