At last she holds us,
and so we turn to dust.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe13\",:
Hinekora bound Kitava to a rock 
that Kitava could not lift with all his might.
Kitava vowed that when he broke free, 
he would devour every soul in Hinekora's domain.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe14\",:
"The Karui savages claim the weapon was forged by their fire god.
I'm rather inclined to believe them."
- Fairgraves, Renowned Explorer
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe15\",:
A sharp and heavy beat,
discorded, out of tune,
when you hear it on the wind,
you know death will follow soon.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe16\",:
War is a thriving infection.
It numbs the heart and eats away at the soul
until only emptiness remains.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe3\",\:
Swinging through the air, it sings
of sundered, severed, missing things.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe4\",\:
To cease the flow of blood is to
choke the rain in the very clouds.
Both life and land feel the thirst.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe5\",\:
Bargg Wurmkin once severed the heads
of seven men in a single cleave.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe6\",\: Fire and Anarchy are the most reliable agents of change.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe6x\",:
"The remarkable imbalance of Prototype #848 leads to uncommon
power or speed when striking."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe7\",\:
"I do not believe in disguising my disappointment."
- Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe8\",\:
Let it grow and gather inside them,
Let it flow through their veins.
Don't waste a drop.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe8x\",:
"Why is Prototype #67 never in the vault it should be?
Either we're keeping faulty logs, or..." 
- Researcher Graven
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandAxe9\",\:
A King and his people are linked together
like a soul and a beating heart.
Both can be severed by a same edge, 
then forged anew.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace1\",:
"The crack of bone, the spray of blood.
Is there sweeter music?"
- Hrimnor of the Ezomytes.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace10\":
"Though ingenious instruments have been found,
it seems surgery before thaumaturgy
was not so delicate."
- Icius Perandus, Antiquities Collection, Item 3546
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace10x\: "The best place for this prototype would be in the hands of our enemies."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace11\": The mind may have no limits, but the skull sure does.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace12\":
The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.
Whether in one day or in ten thousand years,
eventually the rock will crumble,
and the Brine King's domain will grow.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace2\",:
"One quick tap is all the persuasion you'll need."
- Archbishop Geofri of Phrecia Cathedral
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace3\",:
Lumbering as a sea lion, clumsy as a berry-drunk pigeon. That was Erqi.
It mattered little. When Erqi's maul fell true, so did its target.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace4\",: Cursed is the star whence it came.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace5\",: The faithful may continue to serve, even after death.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace6\",: Command like a king and nothing will stand in your way.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace6x\":
"Prototype #599 offers an incredible defensive power, but at a cost.
What underlying physics are at play here, I wonder?"
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace7\",:
"The finest prosperity grows from the direst
carnage. Such is the nature of progress."
- Doryani of the Vaal
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandMace8\",:
His flesh had long turned to dust,
but his vengeance lived on
in every scrap of iron he touched.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword1\":
"Today, clansmen, my sword is my voice!"
- Rigwald, at the Battle of Glarryn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword10\:
The cuts on my hands are a small price to pay
for the opportunity to drive my steel
beyond the flesh and into the demon's soul.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword11\:
Faintly gleaming in the moonlit night,
Kondo's Pride was primed to fight.
Driven by an inner fire,
bloodlust, spite and ill desire.
He swiftly moved to strike them all,
wreaking havoc like a steel squall.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword12\: The end is written into the beginning.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword13\:
A weapon born of nothingness,
can only create more nothingness.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword14\: Witness the emergence of a new cosmic power.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword2\":
Stoic visage, icy heart.
Life of sorrow, lived apart.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword3\":
His final sensation was of the executioner's blade.
It was not cold, instead warm and reassuring,
murmuring a promise of better times ahead.
Smiling, he returned death's embrace.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword4\":
The nobles wanted to take her throne.
She let the peasants take their wealth.
The peasants wanted to take her wealth.
She let the soldiers take their heads.
The soldiers wanted to take her head.
She sat on her throne and wept.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword5\":
Heavy as guilt.
Beautiful as temptation.
Painful as betrayal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword6\":
Give yourself to the flames and your name
will burn in the minds of men forever.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword6x\:
"Ice and flame antagonized in the essence of a prototype.
What once burned now chills the soul."
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword7\":
Soon, the pleas for mercy were muted.
Only one voice remained.
Laughing.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword8\":
So the seed of hate was born,
Evil forged and Hope forsworn.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueTwoHandSword9\":
Take your partners by the hand,
Keep your steps in time.
Swing together, spin apart,
And dance with death sublime.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueVaalReliquary\":
Ambition followed progress,
Vanity followed passion,
Hubris followed intellect...
And silence followed all.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand1\",\"Text\:
Cast into darkness
And trapped for a thousand years,
The lonely moon weeps
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand10\",\"Text:
The Goat King drank the smoke and ate the flames
as his ruin spread across the land.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand11\",\"Text:
We forge order from the world around us
Wielding anarchy and destruction as our tools of genesis.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand12\",\"Text:
You can never truly tame the tempest.
You can barely even leash it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand13\",\"Text:
Every decade, Lunaris devours Solaris
Each time, Solaris emerges from Lunaris, born anew.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand14\",\"Text:
"We do not command fire.
Ngamahu lends it, and Hinekora returns it."
- Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand15\",\"Text:
We remember the stillness.
Then the great fall.
The pain of separation.
We return once more.

<default>{This item can be transformed with a Blessing of Tul}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand16\",\"Text:
We fracture and splinter.
We pierce our sides.
But in the great freeze we are forged anew.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand16x\",\"Tex:
"Are we mad for attempting to build an engine out of this?
Looping cycles, power and pain..." 
- Researcher Arn
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand17\",\"Text: Without light, there can be no shadow.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand18\",\"Text: In every piece of prose, lies a tiny spark of magic.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand19\",\"Text:
All at once, a calmness would encompass them,
and all at once, it would be torn away,
unveiling forms no sound mind could grasp.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand2\",\"Text\:
A chilling hush, a scraping sound
Of things no more entombed in ground.
A shambling horde is on its way
To crush the very light of day.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand20\",\"Text: Crush your enemies with your essence, so that you may drink of theirs.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand2x\",\"Text:
"Simply incredible. I caught an escaping test subject myself with
swarms of burning skulls. Delightful!"
- Researcher Olesya
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand3\",\"Text\:
"The trick is to give nothingness,
and to receive everything in return."
- Inquisitor Maligaro
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand4\",\"Text\:
From the smallest seeds
To the tallest redwoods,
Life endures in Wraeclast.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand5\",\"Text\: And the thunder rumbled on and on.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand6\",\"Text\:
"Stone still, amidst the reeds,
breath fogging in the iron cold air. 
he sits, he waits, he watches.
A piscatorial vigil, sat by the river,
his cathedral, his patience his unanswered prayer."
- Jojoba Mansell, bard, angler, adventurer
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand7\",\"Text\:
Apep's poison entraps, encircles,
and engulfs the leaking mind of Man.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand8\",\"Text\: If it's worth doing once, it's worth doing twice.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWand9x\",\"Text:
"Energy redirected is energy imbalanced.
Prototype #78 serves as a prime example."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone1\",\:
Those who could flee did so.
The rest fought bravely,
and died horrifically.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone11a\":
"The village was locked within its walls,
protected from those who could do them harm,
protected from those who could save them."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone11b\":
"Believing them to have discovered new lands,
they planted their flag in the dirt and called it their own.
A gesture not taken with a great deal of pleasure
by those who already dwelt there."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone11c\":
"The first explorers took to the hills to discover the lay of the land,
and watched with wonder as the land undulated, crashed and twisted."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone11d\":
"Atop the highest peaks, the sunlight pierced but did not warm.
The air choked and did not nourish.
And those that made the trek realised the folly of their desire for greatness."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone11e\":
"Where once a mountain stood there was now but fields and dust.
One by one, the stones were moved and placed with intention,
the consequences borne by the destination and the origin."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone11f\":
"The Shade walked the land with no end in sight,
no purpose in mind,
but the one it invented to pass the time."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone11g\":
"There were seasons in this strange new place, but not of sun and snow.
Seasons of stone that rose and fell like waves.
Seasons of structure and growth and madness and chaos.
Seasons of birth and decay that seemed untethered to cause."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone11h\":
"For a time, it was thought this place could seed an empire
greater than any in history.
The lands could be tamed, and commanded, they thought.
But control, like all things in that place, was an illusion."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone2\",\:
They came, full of vim and vigour, to take what was not theirs.
They crashed and clamoured like waves against rocks,
and were swept back out to sea.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone3\",\:
The King's Eye returned from the west.
Fertile pastures lay just beyond sight.
Just a little farther, he said.
It was always just a little farther.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone4\",\: Nothing is more alluring than mystery.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone5\",\:
There exists in every man and woman
a desire to push boundaries, to break new ground,
to make great discoveries,
no matter the personal cost.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone6\",\:
Conflict begets only suffering.
For some, that is by design.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UniqueWatchstone7_\",:
Does the belly swell, or the belt shrink?
To those caught between, there is no difference,
and something must soon give.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"UrukLineageSupport\",:
The volcano roared, but there was no thunder, only the boom
of Uruk's hammer. Wraeclast had forgotten the old alliance,
but by the Molten One's will, the fires would rage again.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VaalLimbReplacements\:
"Behold! A marvel of innovation! Pay no mind the cost of flesh..."
- Guatelitzi, Architect of Flesh
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VaultsResearch\",\"Te:
The world will seek to crush you and yours.
A Sekhema must have relentless will.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VilentaLineageSupport:
Day and night, she hammered away, obsessed with proving it
could be done; a vast ring of artifice under the earth, pushing
energy to speeds never before seen - all to prove Qotra wrong.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ViniasToken\",\"Text\: You can change your name, but you cannot change your history.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VisceraCauldronFlavou: Flesh can be as clay to the properly motivated artist.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VolatilePower\",\"Tex: Unlimited power is apt to corrupt the minds of those who possess it.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VoranasCrestFlavourTe:
The Black Scythe Mercenary Company was an
extension of Vorana. No storied history, no
centuries of service... and yet, legendary.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VoranasSiegeSupport\":
"Your laws of war are asinine. I shall prevail!
I'll crush every pawn you put before me.
Face me, coward! Play by my rules."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VruunHeadFlavourText\:
"Where Its dread gaze fell,
ruination followed..."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VruunsInevitabilitySu:
"If you think you've won, it's only because you don't
understand their strategy. Each Vruun you kill only
teaches the next one how to endure against you."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"VruunsWarhornSupport\:
Vruun tore through Tul's preserved, shattering their
bodies with reckless malice. "The will of the Lords!"
he roared over his decimation. "All broods must serve."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"WarpingBerserkerRuneF:
Vorana the Irrepressible never once recruited. The Black
Scythe Mercenaries were entirely composed of men and
women who had seen her relentless will to fight - and
thought to themselves, "I would follow her anywhere."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"WarpingDecayRuneFlavo:
For generations, the people had feared the power of
the Witch of the Dark Lake. Aldur set out to invite her
to the Royal Court... He ended up marrying her instead.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"WarpingDestructionRun:
Thrud cared for neither diplomacy nor treaty. To end
the ravaging of distant corners of Middengard, Aldur
challenged him to a duel. With runes, Aldur fought him
to a stalemate. Now power... that, Thrud could respect.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"WarpingMarksmanRuneFl:
To win over the Wildking, Aldur spent a winter on the
hunt with Kolr and his men. He did not land a single
arrow on any stag, yet Kolr agreed to unify. It was not
an arrow that mattered. It was the determined attempt.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"WarpingSoulRuneFlavou:
Before they joined the expedition, the Druids of the
Circle offered sanctuary to all. Criminals, dissidents,
and the unwanted could walk a path to redemption.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Watchstone\",\"Text\":
The memories and emotions of countless victims of the Elder,
locked in stone for eternity.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"WatchstoneMaven\",\"T: Only the souls trapped within can bear witness to the Maven's dark proclivities, and they dare not speak up.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"WealthAndPower\",\"Te: <size:31>{The greatness of a man is not in how much wealth or power he acquires, but in his integrity and his ability to positively affect those around him.}
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Whakano1\",\"Text\",0:
"When you stop viewing someone as a fellow human being,
there's little you won't do to forward your agenda.
That is what we're dealing with."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"Whakano2\",\"Text\",0:
"Selfishness and hate fuel these kidnappings. 
It's time we find who is leading them."
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"WildshardsLineageSupp:
She holds in her hand a shattered crystal, a vision of her desire: to
see her sister's silver palace obliterated, to see it cast across the
heavens. One cross word, and the sky will rain down her fury.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"XibaquaLineageSupport:
Born of the gods, his treachery was met with divine fury.
One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh, until all that
remained was a droplet of pure light: the first Vaal.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ZarokhRefrainLineageS:
Reliving the same day for all time, Zarokh raged against
the moments that made up his prison. There would be
no redemption, for he had broken his only barya.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ZarokhRevoltLineageSu:
Zarokh's ire built over the centuries as he planned his escape.
The Afarud would find what he sought, and then... the
Weeping Black would break the chains of his prison.
entitySources.[\"FlavourText\",\"ZerphiLineageSupport_:
"It was the quality of his heinous acts that set him apart, not
the quantity... all of the physical trauma inflicted occurred
while the victim was still alive. Perhaps this was the key."

entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AbandonedCityMap\",:
Abandoned Cities have very few living inhabitants. 

Monsters in the area are replaced by Undead. These undead have 50% chance to drop non-equipment items instead of equipment.

Abandoned Cities have 25% increased Chests in the area.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AbyssCrack\",\"Defi:
Abyssal Fissures are a group of areas which contain Abysses. 

These Abysses are always of a single faction, with the final area leading to that faction's boss. Abyssal monsters become stronger and more frequent further along the Fissure.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AbyssalDepths\",\"D:
Abyssal Depths are an underground dungeon sometimes found when completing the final Abyss in the area.

The Abyssal Depths contains many Abyssal monsters and all Rare monsters will have an Abyssal Modifier.
At the end of the Abyssal Depths is a more powerful Rare with both a Lichborn Modifier and an Abyssal Modifier. Defeating this Rare will unlock valuable chests nearby.

The chests at the end of the Abyssal Depths can also drop pieces of Preserved Bone, but also can rarely drop additional exclusive Omens and Lineage Supports.

At higher levels the Abyssal Depths can lead to powerful Boss Fights.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AbyssalEye\",\"Defi: Abyssal Eyes are artifacts recovered from Abyssals which function as a type of Augment.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AbyssalModifiers\",:
Abyssal Monsters spawned from Abysses steal modifiers from monsters killed near their pit, these modifiers can be upgraded to Abyssal Modifiers.

Abyssal Modifiers rarely have a chance to become a more powerful Lichborn Modifier.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AbyssalWasting\",\": Abyssal Wasting reduces Life Regeneration Rate by 50% for 6 seconds
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Abyssalify\",\"Defi:
Desecrating an item adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier. If modifiers are full then a random modifier is also removed. These modifiers can be revealed at the Well of Souls.

Items with Desecrated Modifiers cannot be Desecrated again.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AccountBound\",\"De: Account Bound items cannot be traded to other players, but can be shared between other characters on your account.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Accuracy\",\"Defini:
Accuracy is used to hit a target with an Attack, and is checked against the targets Evasion to determine that chance. 

Player Attacks incur an Accuracy penalty based on distance from the origin of the damage to the target, with no penalty for targets within 2 metres and up to 90% less Accuracy for targets further than 9 metres away.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Acrobatics\",\"Defi:
Can Evade all Hits
75% less Evasion Rating
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Adaptation\",\"Defi:
Adaptations are gained by taking Elemental Damage from Hits and cause you to take less damage of that Type from subsequent Hits.

Unless otherwise specified, you can have 3 Adaptations at a time, and Adaptations do not have a duration.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AddedAttackCastTime: This additional use time is fixed and will not be modified by skill use speed stats.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AdditionalRareMonst:
Additional Rare Monsters can spawn in Rare Monster Packs with larger pack sizes.

Each Rare Monster in the Pack provides one modifier to the Pack's Minions.

Additional Rare Monsters in Essence Packs also carry Essences.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Affinity\",\"Defini:
Affinity is a buff granted by the Trinity skill. There are three types of Affinity: Fire, Cold and Lightning. You can have a maximum of 100 of each type of Affinity.

You lose 10 Affinity per second of specific types if you haven't gained Affinity of that type in the past 8 seconds.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Afflictions\",\"Def:
Afflictions are negative effects that are applied to the Trial of the Sekhemas; making them harder to run.
Afflictions will be applied for entering certain rooms in the Trial or from encountering certain Maraketh Shrines.
Afflictions can be either Minor or Major, providing varying negative effects to your Trial.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Aftershock\",\"Defi: Aftershocks are bursts of area damage that occur after the initial impact of the skill causing them. If not otherwise specified, the Aftershock will deal the same damage as the initial impact, in the same area. Only Attack damage can cause Aftershocks.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Aggravate\",\"Defin:
Bleeding that has been Aggravated always treats the target as moving, which causes it to deal 100% extra damage.

Once a Bleeding Debuff has been Aggravated, it will remain Aggravated until its duration expires.

Each Bleeding Debuff can be Aggravated, or not, independently — one Bleeding Debuff being Aggravated does not mean other Bleeding Debuffs on the target are also Aggravated, and Aggravating some or all of them will have no effect on new Bleeding Debuffs applied afterwards. However, effects which Aggravate Bleeding on a target do so to all Bleeding Debuffs currently on that target unless otherwise specified.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AggravateIgnite\",\:
Ignite that has been Aggravated deals 100% extra damage.

Once an Ignite has been Aggravated, it will remain Aggravated until its duration expires.

Just like Bleeding, each Ignite Debuff can be Aggravated, or not, independently of others on the target.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AilmentApplication\:
Modifiers to Ailment Application apply to:
Bleeding, Poison and Shock chance
Flammability, Freeze and Electrocution Buildup.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AilmentSpread\",\"D:
Spreading an ailment inflicts a new, matching ailment on another target, from the same source. The new ailment can potentially spread further, but never back to the same target twice.

Ailments can never spread to, or from, the entity that originally inflicted them.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AilmentThreshold\",: A higher Elemental Ailment Threshold makes it less likely that being Hit by Elemental Damage will apply the relevant Ailment, as well as lowering the amount of Freeze and Electrocute buildup recieved. A lower Elemental Ailment Threshold makes it more likely, and increases buildup of Freeze and Electrocute recieved. By default a player's Ailment Threshold is equal to half their Life.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Ailments\",\"Defini: Ailments are a family of common Debuffs associated with specific damage types. The list of Ailments is: Bleeding, Ignite, Chill, Freeze, Shock, Electrocute, and Poison.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AldursLegacy\",\"De: Aldur's Legacies are Augments which have taken the power of a Ezomyte Unique or Kalguuran Unique. You may not have more than one Augment of this type socketed at a time.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Allies\",\"Definiti:
Your allies include other players, Minions, and any other entity that fights alongside you and has its own stats. 

You do not count as your own Ally.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AlternateStrengthBo:
Gain no inherent bonus from Strength
1% increased Energy Shield per 2 Strength
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Ammunition\",\"Defi: Using a Crossbow Ammunition Skill replaces your Crossbow's basic Attack with the skill indicated. The Ammunition Skill itself does not fire the Ammunition, only load it into your Crossbow. Most Crossbow Ammunition Skills that directly Hit enemies have Knockback.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Anaemia\",\"Definit: Anaemia is a Debuff that allows more than 10 Corrupted Blood debuffs to be applied to a target. The Magnitude of Anaemia determines how many additional Corrupted Blood stacks to be applied.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AncestralBond\",\"D:
Your Totem Limit is doubled
No cost or Charge requirement for placing Totems
Totems reserve 75 Spirit each
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AncestralBoost\",\": An Ancestrally Boosted Slam has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect, and an Ancestrally Boosted Strike will target 2 additional Enemies. Triggered Skills cannot be Ancestrally Boosted. Ancestrally Boosted Attacks count as being Empowered.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AncestralBoostSpell: An Ancestrally Boosted Spell has 30% more damage and 25% increased area of effect. Triggered Skills cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Ancient\",\"Definit: These are Augments which have powerful singular effects, but are more limited. You may not have more than one Augment of this type socketed at a time.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AncientBlooms\",\"D:
Ancient Blooms are Remnants that grant the following bonuses when collected:
Vivid Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your Charms
Primal Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your Mana Flasks
Wild Blooms grant 5 Charges to all of your Life Flasks
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AoESkill\",\"Defini:

Areas of Effect that originate from a target hit by a Skill will add that target's size to their radius.

It lasts for 4 seconds by default.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Archon\",\"Definiti:
Archons are a type of Buff that significantly augment your prowess with a certain type of Skills, such as Elemental Spells or Plant Skills.

By default, each Archon Buff lasts 10 seconds.

You cannot gain any Archon Buff while you already have one, or during a recovery period after you lose one, which lasts 20 seconds by default.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Armour\",\"Definiti:
Armour reduces Damage taken from Hits. By default, Armour only applies to Physical Damage.

Damage reduction from Armour is proportional to the amount of Damage, and is more effective at reducing smaller hits.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ArmourBreak\",\"Def:
Some Skills, Items, Support Gems and other effects can Break Armour, which lowers a target's Armour by a specified amount. If this brings the target's Armour value to 0, their Armour is Fully Broken for 12 seconds, or 4 seconds for players. On top of not benefitting from Armour, non-player targets with Fully Broken Armour take 20% increased Physical damage from Hits.

Players Break 3 times Armour against Normal Monsters and 2 times Armour against Magic Monsters.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ArmourOverbreak\",\: Enemies with Armour Broken below 0 have negative Armour. This means they take more Physical damage from Hits. Armour broken below 0 is capped by the enemy's base Armour.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ArmourPenalties\",\:
Depending on the type of Armour equipped, Players will have a less Movement Speed penalty applied depending on what Attribute the Armour requires. These penalties only apply to equipped Body Armours and Shields.
For Body Armour, pure Strength has a 5% penalty, hybrid Strength and Dexterity or Intelligence has a 4% penalty and pure Dexterity or Intelligence has a 3% penalty.
For Shields, pure Strength has a 3% penalty, hybrid Strength and Dexterity or Intelligence has a 1.5% penalty and pure Dexterity or Intelligence has no penalty.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ArmouredShield\",\": Armoured Shields are any Shields that grant the player Armour — that is, any type of Shield other than Bucklers.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ArtificersOrb\",\"D: Adds an Augment Socket to a Martial Weapon or Armour
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AscendancyPoints\",:
Ascendancy Passive Skill Points can be allocated in your Ascendancy Skill Tree once you have chosen your Ascendancy. Your Ascendancy class is unlocked by completing any Ascension Trial. In order to change your Ascendancy, you must complete an Ascension Trial to the furthest extent you have successfully already done so, and then interact with the Ascendancy Altar while you have no Ascendancy Passive Skill Points currently assigned. Trialmaster and Balbala will offer the ability to refund passive points while in rooms with Ascendancy Altars to facilitate this.

You can obtain 4 sets of 2 Ascendancy Points for a total of 8 in the following ways:
Set 1 - Completing floor 1 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos with at least 7 Trials
Set 2 - Completing floor 2 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos
Set 3 - Completing floor 3 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the Trials of Chaos with at least 10 Trials
Set 4 - Completing floor 4 of the Trial of the Sekhemas or completing the secret challenge behind the locked door in the Trials of Chaos
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AtlasDifficulty\",\:
Difficulty causes monsters to have increased damage and life, as well as improving the items they drop.

Certain Bosses with increased difficulty will gain new abilities and begin to drop exclusive items, and have a reduced number of Respawn Attempts.

Difficulty above 4 has no additional effect.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Attack\",\"Definiti:
Attacks are skills that directly damage enemies, usually using your equipped Martial Weapon. Spells are not Attacks.

The base damage, attack speed and critical hit chance of an attack are determined using your Martial Weapon's stats unless the skill says otherwise.

Attacks do not necessarily deal Physical damage — they can deal any damage type.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Attributes\",\"Defi:
Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence are the 3 primary attributes. The most important use of Attributes is to meet requirements to use Equipment and Gems.

Each Attribute provides a different inherent bonus.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AudienceWithTheKing: An Audience with the King is an item that is an exclusive drop from the Ritual mechanic. This item allows you to access the Crux of Nothingness via the Realmgate.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Augment\",\"Definit:
Augments are items which can be placed into Augment sockets, usually on Equipment items. Once socketed, they can be replaced by other Augments, but cannot be removed by normal means. 

The types of Equipment which an Augment can be placed into and the corresponding benefit provided are listed on the item.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Aura\",\"Definition: Auras apply Buffs to Allies within a radius, or Debuffs to enemies within a radius of the source of the Aura.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AvatarOfFire\",\"De:
75% of Damage Converted to Fire Damage
Deal no Non-Fire Damage
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Axe\",\"Definition\:
Axes are Melee weapons that can be One-Handed or Two-Handed. Axes require Strength and Dexterity to equip. 

Axe Attacks commonly involve throwing your axe and/or inflicting Bleeding.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AzmeriSpirit\",\"De:
Azmeri Spirits are the spirits of various Azmeri Animal Guardians.

Azmeri Spirits appear as wisps that flee as you approach them. Normal or Magic Monsters the Spirit comes into contact with become Spirit-Influenced, while Rare or Unique monsters will be Possessed.

Spirit-Influenced or Possessed monsters are stronger and more rewarding. Possession's bonuses are more effective for each monster the Spirit has Influenced.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AzmeriSpiritPrimal\:
Primal Spirits are a type of Azmeri Spirit.

Monsters Influenced or Possessed by Primal Spirits deal increased damage, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters Possessed by Primal Spirits drop Intelligence items.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AzmeriSpiritVivid\":
Vivid Spirits are a type of Azmeri Spirit.

Monsters Influenced or Possessed by Vivid Spirits gain increased Skill Speed, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters Possessed by Vivid Spirits drop Dexterity items.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"AzmeriSpiritWild\",:
Wild Spirits are a type of Azmeri Spirit.

Monsters Influenced or Possessed by Wild Spirits gain increased Toughness, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type.

Monsters Possessed by Wild Spirits drop Strength items.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Ballista\",\"Defini: Ballistas are a type of Totem that use Projectile Attacks.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Banner\",\"Definiti:
Banner Skills generate Glory when you attack a Monster while it is activated. Glory generated corresponds to the Power of the Monster hit. Once at full Glory, the Banner can be placed to create powerful Buffing Areas.
Normally you have a limit of a single Banner placed at one time.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BaseSkillAttackTime: This refers to the base amount of time to perform an Attack Skill, accounting only for the Attacks per Second value of the relevant Weapon and the percentage of Base Attack Speed listed on the Attack gem.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BaseType\",\"Defini:
An item's Base Type refers to the specific variety of item it is, and grants it inherent properties such as damage on Martial Weapons, defensive bonuses on Armour, or Life recovery on Life Flasks. It is also often responsible for the Level and/or Attribute Requirements to equip an item.

For example:
• Wrapped Quarterstaff and Long Quarterstaff are both Quarterstaff Base Types
• Stocky Mitts and Linen Wraps are both Gloves Base Types
• Lesser Mana Flask and Greater Mana Flask are both Mana Flask Base Types
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BasicJewel\",\"Defi:
Basic Jewels do not affect nodes in a radius.
Basic Jewels are Rubies, Emeralds, Sapphires and Diamonds.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BasicMap\",\"Defini:
Basic Maps are any maps with no special interaction with areas or access requirements.

Notably, not Unique Maps, Deadly Map Boss Maps, Precursor Towers, Expedition Areas or Quest Areas.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BasicStrongbox\",\": Basic Strongboxes are specifically named "Strongbox" and drop random items.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Bear\",\"Definition:
Shapeshifting into a Bear grants access to devastating Slams and Fire Attacks fuelled by smouldering Rage.

While in Bear form, you gain:
• +10 to Armour per level
• 30% of Armour also applies to Elemental Damage
• an Endurance Charge for every 15 Rage you spend
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BetterCurrencyMinim: Added random Modifiers are at least this level or higher, except if a specific Modifier type would be excluded entirely from being able to roll. Currency with a Minimum Modifier Level cannot be used on items with an item level below the Minimum Modifier Level.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BindingChains\",\"D: Binding Chains is a stacking Debuff that Slows character movement speed by 8% for each stack applied.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Biome\",\"Definitio:
Biomes are found throughout Endgame Maps.

Grass, Forest, Swamp, Desert, Mountain and Water Biomes are all commonly found.

Cities and special biomes are less likely to be encountered.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Bleeding\",\"Defini:
Bleeding is an Ailment that deals Physical damage over time, and lasts 5 seconds by default. Damage from Bleeding bypasses Energy Shield

Bleeding deals an extra 100% damage while the target is moving, or if the Bleeding is Aggravated.

Physical damage from Hits Contributes to Bleeding Magnitude.

Damage does not Contribute to Bleeding chance, so it cannot be inflicted without an explicit source of Bleeding chance.

The base Magnitude of Bleeding is Physical damage per second equal to 15% of the Pre-mitigation Physical damage of the Hit that inflicted it. This magnitude is not further affected by any modifiers to the damage you deal. 

Modifiers and Debuffs that affect the enemy's ability to mitigate damage (such as Shock) can affect the damage the enemy takes from Bleeding, but any such modifiers that specifically apply to Hit damage (such as Armour Break) do not affect Bleeding damage.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Blind\",\"Definitio: Being Blinded causes 20% less Accuracy Rating and Evasion Rating, and lasts for 4 seconds unless otherwise specified.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Block\",\"Definitio:
Blocking completely prevents the damage of an incoming Hit.

You will still take any Stun from the Blocked hit. You can't Block while Stunned or Frozen. 

Some Skills used by Bosses cannot be blocked. These are indicated by a red glow and audio cue during the windup of the Skill.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BloodLoss\",\"Defin: All Physical damage over time taken by a target (including Bleeding) is accumulated as Blood Loss.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BloodMagic\",\"Defi:
You have no Mana
Skill Mana Costs Converted to Life Costs
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BloodlettingRune\",:
<<ExpedRuneBloodletting>><rgb(219,217,206)>{Bloodletting Rune}

<rgb(135,134,253)>{Cannot have Life Leeched from}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Inflicts Corrupted Blood on Hit}
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Bloodstained\",\"De:
While Bleeding enemies build up Bloodstained, gaining the Bloodstained Debuff after Bleeding for a total of 6 seconds. Bloodstained builds up 100% faster if the Bleeding enemy is moving or the Bleeding is Aggravated.

Certain skills allow you to view the Bloodstained Debuff on enemies and can consume the Debuff for powerful effects.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BlueFlamesOfChayula: Blue Flames of Chayula Leech 20% of your maximum Mana to you when collected.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BondRune\",\"Defini:
<<ExpedRuneBond>><rgb(219,217,206)>{Bond Rune}
<font:'fontin'>{<italic>{<rgb(110,87,66)>{Monsters gain:}}}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Rare Monsters may transfer a Mod on death}
<font:'fontin'>{<italic>{<rgb(110,87,66)>{Remnant gains:}}}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Increased chance to spawn Rare Monsters}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Rare Monsters have more Monster Modifiers}
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BonusMapEvent\",\"D: Ancient Modifiers are fragments of Precursor power, adding many varied bonus effects to areas throughout the Precursor Fortress and beyond.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BooleanDamageRoll\":
Hits from a weapon or skill with this property will not roll a random value between the minimum or maximum damage value, but instead will always roll either the minimum value or the maximum value, with a 50% chance for each.

Each Damage Type has its damage value rolled separately, so if the hit deals multiple types of damage, some types may roll the maximum while others roll minimum.

If the damage rolls are Lucky, that will still apply, make this roll twice and picking the maximum if either roll had that result, only picking minimum damage if both rolls selected minimum. Unlucky damage rolls will prefer minimum damage in the same way.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Boons\",\"Definitio:
Boons are positive effects that are applied to the Trial of the Sekhemas; making them easier to run.
Boons can be gained from certain Maraketh Shrines or from buying them from the Trial Merchant using Sacred Water.
Boons can be either Minor or Major, providing varying benefits to your Trial.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Bow\",\"Definition\:
Bows are Two-Handed ranged weapons that require Dexterity to equip. Equipping a Bow allows you to also equip a Quiver in the off hand slot. 

Bows can Attack from long range and with high mobility using a variety of skills, but generally deal less damage than other two-handed weapon types.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BreachHiveAddModifi:
A skill created by Ailith that creates a zone which adds a Modifier to Rare Breach Monsters which enter it.

A Rare Monster can only have one Modifier added.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BreachHiveAdditiona: A skill created by Ailith that adds an additional Pack with a Rare Monster to each wave.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BreachHiveMonsterPo: A skill created by Ailith that increases the Effectiveness of Monsters in Breach Hive encounters.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BreachHiveMonsterUp:
A skill created by Ailith that creates a zone which upgrades the Rarity of Breach Monsters which enter it.

Monsters can only have their Rarity upgraded once, and can not be upgraded beyond Rare.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BreachHiveSacrifice: A skill created by Ailith that sacrifices half her life to grant players 1000% more Damage and immunity to Damage for 10 seconds.
A skill created by Ailith that sacrifices half her life to grant players 100% increased Item Rarity in Breach Hives.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BreachWombgift\",\":
Wombgifts are found within Breaches and are grown on The Genesis Tree.

The 4 types of Wombgifts are:
* Lavish Wombgift
* Ornate Wombgift
* Banded Wombgift
* Signet Wombgift
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Brittle\",\"Definit: Hits have up to +6% Critical Hit Chance against Brittle enemies, based on the Cold damage of the Hit which inflicted Brittle, for 4 seconds.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BrokenFace\",\"Defi:
Each "Boss Encounter" icon on the World Screen is a face which can be broken by beating the encounter.

"Rare Monster Encounter" icons do not provide any bonus when broken.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BrokenStance\",\"De:
Broken Stance is a Debuff inflicted by Hits, which stores 10% of the Pre-mitigation Physical Hit damage of the Hit that inflicts it as its Magnitude.

The inflicter's subsequent Hits against the target will gain additional unscaleable added Physical Damage equal to that magnitude.

Enemies with Broken Stance cannot be Dazed again.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Buckler\",\"Definit: Bucklers are a special type of Shield that do not grant any Armour and can Parry enemy skills instead of being raised to Block.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Buff\",\"Definition:
Buffs are effects that boost a player or monster's stats for a duration or while a condition is met.

Unless otherwise stated, Buffs of the same type do not stack — only the copy with the strongest effect applies.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BuffEffect\",\"Defi: Modifiers to the Effect of Buffs or Debuffs usually come from the target it affects and are multiplicative with modifiers to the Magnitudes of the Buff or Debuff, which come from its creator.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"BuffMagnitude\",\"D:
The Magnitudes of a Buff or Debuff are the values of the stats it applies to the target. A Buff or Debuff with higher magnitudes is more powerful.

Modifiers to the Magnitude of Buffs or Debuffs come from whoever applies it and are multiplicative with modifiers to the Effect the Buff or Debuff has on the target.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Bulwark\",\"Definit:
Dodge Roll cannot Avoid Damage
Take 30% less Damage from Hits while Dodge Rolling
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Burning\",\"Definit: Enemies taking Fire damage over time are Burning. Usually this occurs because the enemy is Ignited.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Cascadable\",\"Defi:
Warcries, and Non-Channelling Spells that affect an area around you or a targeted location, are Cascadable.

Certain effects can cause Cascadable Skills to Cascade, making them also affect other locations, or to Echo, affecting the same targeted location again after a delay.

A Cascadable Spell that Repeats will not Cascade or Echo while Repeating.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CasterWeapon\",\"De: Caster Weapons are Sceptres, Staves and Wands.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Catalyst\",\"Defini: Catalysts are Currency items that are exclusive drops from the Breach mechanic. Catalysts add Quality that affect certain modifiers on items. There are two categories of Catalyst, one that affects Jewellery and one that affects Jewels.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CelestialRune\",\"D:
<<ExpedRuneCelestial>><rgb(219,217,206)>{Celestial Rune}
<font:'fontin'>{<italic>{<rgb(110,87,66)>{Monsters gain:}}}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Chance for a Fire Explosion on Death}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Chance for a Cold Explosion on Death}
<rgb(135,134,253)>{Chance for a Lightning Explosion on Death}
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Chain\",\"Definitio:
Effects that Chain are redirected to another target after colliding with an enemy.
Projectiles Splitting, Piercing or Forking take priority over Chaining.
Projectiles have a base chaining distance of 6 metres whereas other effects have a chaining distance of 4 metres. Enemies cannot be targeted more than once in the same Chain.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ChanceToBlock\",\"D: Chance to Block only includes modifiers that are explicitly chance-based. Guaranteed Block (such as raising your Shield) does not affect your Chance to Block.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Channelling\",\"Def: Channelling Skills can be held down to gain power or continue using the Skill for a longer period of time.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Chaos\",\"Definitio:
Chaos damage is one of the five Damage Types. It is reduced by Chaos Resistance. 
Chaos damage is the least common damage type, and removes twice as much Energy Shield as the damage value when taken.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ChaosInoculation\",:
Maximum Life is 1
Immune to Chaos Damage and Bleeding
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ChaosSurge\",\"Defi: Chaos Surge behaves identically to Elemental Surges, but causes a Chaos blast.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ChargeCycle\",\"Def:
Gain Power Charges instead of Frenzy Charges
Gain Frenzy Charges instead of Endurance Charges
Gain Endurance Charges instead of Power Charges
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Charges\",\"Definit:
Charges can be gained from a number of Skills, passives, and other effects. They do not grant any inherent benefits, but can be consumed to fuel many skills and other effects. Charges last for 15 seconds by default, refreshing whenever you gain another charge of the same type.

There are three types of Charges — Endurance, Frenzy and Power. By default players can have up to 3 of each type of Charge at once.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Charm\",\"Definitio:
Charms are protective trinkets you can equip that automatically trigger a defensive effect when a specific condition is met. Similar to Flasks, Charms require charges to trigger. Charm charges can be regained by killing monsters, granting charges equal to half of the monster's Power. Checkpoints and Wells completely recharge Charms when activated.

The maximum number of Charm slots is capped at 3.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Checkpoint\",\"Defi:
Checkpoints are a form of saving your progress through Wraeclast and will often appear before Boss fights and at points of interest. Reaching a Checkpoint will refill your Life, Mana, Flasks and Charms.

On death, you can choose to revive either in Town or at the last Checkpoint you reached. For this purpose, Waypoints also function as Checkpoints.

You can also teleport between Checkpoints within an area, or from a Checkpoint to the Waypoint.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CheckpointMaps\",\": Once all Checkpoints have been activated and the Map is completed, all remaining unfinished map content will be revealed on the minimap.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Chill\",\"Definitio:
Chill is an Ailment that Slows the afflicted target, and lasts 2 seconds on players or 8 seconds on non-players by default. Chill Magnitude depends on the Chilling damage dealt relative to the target's Elemental Ailment Threshold, with a minimum of 30% and a default maximum of 50%.

Cold damage from Hits can Chill by default, and does not require a chance to inflict Chill. However, Chills smaller than 30% will be ignored, so small Hits can fail to Chill.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ChilledGround\",\"D: Chilled Ground Chills those standing in it, and lasts 6 seconds by default.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Chronobuff\",\"Defi: Sands of Time grants 60% increased Skill Speed, scaling down to 1% over 10 seconds, at which point it will then scale back up to 60%. It also grants 1% increased Area of Effect, scaling up to 60% over 10 seconds, at which point it will then scale back down to 1%.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Citadel\",\"Definit:
There are three types of Citadels, each located in different cities throughout Wraeclast. 

Copper Citadels in Faridun Cities, Iron Citadels in Ezomyte Cities and Stone Citadels in Vaal Cities.

Complete one of each type of Citadel and collect their Crisis Fragments to gain access to The Burning Monolith.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Claw\",\"Definition:
Claws are One-Handed Melee weapons that require Dexterity to equip. Claws can be Dual Wielded with another Claw, but cannot be combined with other equipped items in the off hand.

Claw Attacks are commonly fast and cause Bleeding.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Cleansed\",\"Defini:
The Corruption in this area has been Cleansed, which may add an additional modifier to the area.

Cleansed areas also contain monsters twisted by the disruption of power in the area.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CloseRange\",\"Defi: Close Range is anywhere within 2 metres of your character. Normally, Melee Attacks you make are in Close Range.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CoalescedCorruption: Monsters slain close together have a chance to merge together and manifest powerful Monsters.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Cold\",\"Definition: Cold damage is one of the five Damage Types. It is reduced by Cold Resistance. Cold hits apply Chill and build up Freeze, but cannot build up Heavy Stun.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Combo\",\"Definitio:
Combo is a counter on some Skills that can be required to use the Skill or grant extra effects. Skills gain Combo when you Strike Enemies. Combo will fall off after a short time without this happening.

Combo can only be built while using the same weapon as the Combo Skill is bound to, and will be lost if you Swap Weapons.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Command\",\"Definit: Some Minions can be Commanded to perform certain actions. This requires you to use the corresponding Command skill, which will cause one of your Minions to carry out the Command.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Companion\",\"Defin: Companions are a type of Reviving Minion that are more complex and powerful than typical Minions. By default you can only have one Companion of any type summoned at a time.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CompoundIgnite\",\":
When Igniting a target which has already been Ignited by the same use of this Skill, the existing Ignite is removed to boost the new Ignite, multiplying its Magnitude by the total number of Ignites compounded this way.

Ignites cannot Compound when reflected, or when applied by Oil Ground that has been Ignited. They will neither remove existing Ignite, nor get any boost to Ignite Magnitude.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Concentration\",\"D: Enemies have less Cooldown Recovery Rate the lower their Concentration, scaling down to 50% less Cooldown Recovery Rate when Concentration is 0%.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Conditional\",\"Def: Skills which are Conditional require some sort of condition to be met before they can be used. Combo is an example of this, but almost anything can be a condition, such as having to have killed a certain number of enemies Recently or having to have moved a certain distance.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Conduit\",\"Definit: If you would gain a Charge, Allies in your Presence gain that Charge instead.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CongealedMist\",\"D: A mysterious Augment that shifts and shimmers. Is that whispering you hear?
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ConnectedGem\",\"De:
Two gems are considered Connected if one is socketed into the other, or if both are socketed into a third gem.

A Support Gem socketed in a Meta Skill  is still Connected to that Meta Skill and to all other Skills socketed in that Meta Skill, even if it cannot Support some of those skills.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ConsecratedGround\": You and Allies standing on your Consecrated Ground Regenerate 5% of their maximum Life per second, and Curses have 50% reduced effect on them.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Consume\",\"Definit:
Multiple effects on enemies can be Consumed. Only one Consumption benefit can occur at once, and Consumption effects from Skills will take priority over those from other sources.

Consuming a Debuff on an enemy causes the enemy to be immune to that Debuff for 1 seconds.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsAbyss\",\"D:
An Abyss is a pit which leads deep underground with multiple fissures branching from it. Any monsters spawned near an Abyss will be weakened by it.
Defeating these weakened monsters will cause the fissures to close.
Once the fissures have closed all the way to the pit, the pit will activate and spawn a large number of Abyssal monsters. Defeating these monsters will close the pit. 

Each closed pit has a chance to spawn an Abyssal Trove which can grant pieces of Preserved Bone to craft onto your Items. The final Abyss in the area has a chance to instead open an underground dungeon called an Abyssal Depths.

There are three separate groups of Abyssal Monsters: the Lightless, the Blackblooded and the Legion of the Pit, each area generally contains one of these groups.
The rarity of the monsters spawned depends on the rarity of the slain weakened monsters and the emerging Abyssal will steal some or all of the modifiers from them.
Any of the modifiers stolen by Rare Abyssal can be upgraded to Abyssal Modifiers.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsBreach\",\":
Breaches allow invaders from another world to access ours.

Unstable Breaches are a small tear in the fabric that will open for a short time. Kill Breach monsters to keep them open longer.
Once enough monsters have been killed, the Breach will stabalise, calling stronger monsters through the portal at the centre.
Kill these monsters in the centre will complete the Unstable Breach, closing the tear.

A Breach Hive is a tear that has already grown out of control. You will need the help of Ailith to close these.
With a blessing from Chayula, burn your way to the centre of the Hive and help Ailith start the process of destorying the centre.
As Ailith destroys the Hive, Breach monsters will pour in to try and kill her. Defend Ailith until she has completely destroyed the centre of the hive to remove it from existence.
If Ailith dies during this, the Hive will remain.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsCorruption\:
Contains Corruption, which may add an additional modifier to the area.

Corrupted Areas cause slain monsters to Coalesce Corruption to manifest powerful monsters.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsDelirium\",:
Maps containing a Delirium Mirror can have the mirror walked through to unleash the rolling Delirium fog ring across the current area. 
You must stay within this fog as it expands to maintain the Delirium or it will disappear.

Magic monsters are able to gain Delirium specific Modifiers while inside the fog.

Rare or Unique monsters in the fog may manifest Delirium Demons. Manifested Delirium Demons inhabit the monster's body to occasionally use Skills of their own.

Fractured Mirrors may be found within Delirium Fog, summoning extra monsters while Fracturing Mirror Shards are found at set depths, with more varied rewards.

Defeating Map Bosses has a chance to summon a Grand Mirror on a nearby map.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsExpedition\:
Expeditions are Ancient Kalguuran burial sites, with Verisium Remnants and dangers buried beneath the ground.

Set up a chain of explosives and unearth the treasures, but beware of the dangers that hide in wait. Verisium Remnants apply their Modifiers to Monsters and Chests that are excavated with the same explosive that destroys the Remnant and all subsequent unearthed Monsters and Chests.

Using Logbooks on the Atlas can reveal Grand Expeditions which are larger versions of regular Expeditions and can contain special types of Remnants.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsExpedition2:
Verisium Remnants are fragments of the stars themselves, called down by Kalguurans to harness their power.

Verisium Remnants allow you to craft a variety of rewards. Each Remnant has a number of slots available for runes to be inscribed, and when you first find it, it will have one rune already inscribed.

Based on the inscribed rune, you'll be able to select a reward and, based on the runes required for the recipe, you will have to fight waves of Verisium infused monsters to complete the encounter and receive your reward.

These Inscriptions can be used to create Runeshapes within Verisium Remnants.

Runes are the result of the Kalguurans study of these Inscriptions and the power of Runeshapes.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsHideout\",\:
Contains a Hideout that can be fully cleared to unlock the Hideout for personal use.

All monsters in the area are at least Magic.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsIncursion\":
Activating Vaal Beacons Energises Crystals allowing access to Atziri's Temple.

Within the Vaal Ruins a Vaal architect's console may be activated to allow the manipulation of the Temple before activating a temporal portal to travel back in time to 400 BIC, during the reign of Queen Atziri.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsMapBoss\",\: Empowering a Map Boss upgrades it to a Powerful Map Boss
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsRitual\",\":
Ritual Altars are sacrificial sites that absorb the monsters slain within their ritual circles. After an amount of monsters have been slain, the Ritual can be activated.
Activating the Ritual will resurrect the slain monsters, requiring you slay them once more. 

Defeating these revived monsters earns you Tribute, a resource that you can trade for various Favours from the Ritual Altar. 
The list of Favours tradable for Tribute can be rerolled, costing Tribute.
Favours can be deferred, paying a part of their cost but having them appear again later.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsUniqueMap\":
Contains a Unique Map layout which may contain specialised rewards.

Unique Maps cannot gain additional content, Essences, Shrines, or Strongboxes.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"ContainsWanderingTr: Contains a Wandering Trader who may offer you powerful rewards.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Contributes\",\"Def:
By default, specific Ailments are calculated based on only specific damage types, such as only the Fire damage of a Hit mattering when inflicting Ignite.

Allowing another damage type to contribute to an Ailment means that all damage of the relevant types is summed when performing calculations for that Ailment.

For Ailments that use Hit damage to determine Ailment chance or buildup, this means that the damage type becomes capable of inflicting that Ailment. For Ailments that only use Hit damage to determine Ailment Magnitude (i.e. Bleeding and Poison), you still need a way to apply those Ailments (e.g. a source of Bleeding or Poison chance).
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Conversion\",\"Defi:
Damage can be converted from one type to another. This causes it to deal the new damage type, scale with modifiers to the new damage type, and no longer scale with modifiers to the old damage type.

For example, Fire damage converted to Lightning now scales with Lightning damage modifiers and causes Shock, but no longer scales with Fire damage modifiers or causes Ignite.

Conversion is a two step process. Conversion inherent to Skills occurs first, then Conversion from all other sources. Damage over time cannot be converted.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CooldownRecovery\",:
Cooldown Recovery Rate modifies the speed at which your Skill cooldowns are restored. For example, with 100% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate your Skill cooldowns will effectively be halved.

Cooldown Recovery Rate does not affect anything other than Skill cooldowns.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CopperCitadel\",\"D:
The Copper Citadel is an endgame area which can be accessed with a Tier 15 or above Waystone. The boss of this area will drop a Faded Crisis Fragment.

Increases to Waystone Drop Chance gives a chance for additional Crisis Fragments to drop.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Corpse\",\"Definiti: Corpses are left behind by slain Enemies and can be used or consumed by a number of different Skills or effects, though Corpses of Unique monsters cannot be destroyed or consumed. Generally, slain Allies do not leave usable Corpses.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Corrupted\",\"Defin:
Certain items can be found Corrupted or made Corrupted using a Vaal Orb, changing their properties unpredictably.
Most methods of item crafting and modification cannot be used on Corrupted items. There is no penalty for using Corrupted items.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CorruptedBlood\",\":
Corrupted Blood is a Debuff that deals Physical damage over time.
Up to 10 Corrupted Blood debuffs can be inflicted on each target.

Corrupted Blood is not Bleeding and is not affected by any stats related to Bleeding.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CorruptedBoss\",\"D: Each Corrupted Nexus is guarded by a powerful Corrupted Boss. Defeat the Corrupted Boss to cleanse the Nexus.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CorruptedMonster\",:
Corrupted Monsters have an additional Corrupted Modifier.

These modifiers may increase the difficulty and reward of the Monster, or may make it easier to defeat.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CorruptedNexus\",\": A Corrupted Nexus is the source of immense corruption, guarded by a powerful Corrupted Boss.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CovetousShrine\",\": Seeking Shrines grant increased Rarity of Items Found.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Crafted\",\"Definit:
Some methods of item crafting guarantee that a specific Modifier will be crafted onto the item. An item can only have one Crafted Modifier, but they otherwise behave identically to other Modifiers.

Crafted Modifiers are displayed in a lighter blue colour than regular Modifiers.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CrimsonAssault\",\":
Bleeding you inflict is Aggravated
Base Bleeding Duration is 1 second
50% more Magnitude of Bleeding you inflict
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Critical\",\"Defini:
Critical Hits deal +100% extra damage (i.e. twice as much damage) by default. Critical Damage Bonuses can further modify this value.

Attacks usually use your weapon's base Critical Hit Chance, while Spells and some other skills have their base Critical Hit Chance listed on the skill. 

Most modifiers to Critical Hit Chance are percentage based. For example, gaining 100% increased Critical Hit Chance on a base Critical Hit Chance of 7% would result in a final Critical Hit Chance of 14%.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CriticalDamageBonus: Multiplies the damage dealt by Critical Hits. Default value is +100% (i.e. twice as much damage).
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CriticalWeakness\",: Critical Weakness causes hits against affected targets to have +0.5% to Critical Hit Chance, and can stack up to 20 times. If not otherwise specified, each stack lasts for 4 seconds.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Crossbow\",\"Defini:
Crossbows are Two-Handed ranged weapons that require Strength and Dexterity to equip. Crossbow basic Attacks can be modified with Ammunition Skills.

Multiple Projectiles fired from a single Crossbow skill can all hit the same target, and single-Projectile skills fire additional Projectiles in sequence rather than in a spread.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Crushed\",\"Definit: Crushed lowers Physical Damage Reduction by 15%. This can result in Physical Damage Reduction being negative, causing more damage to be taken.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CrushingBlow\",\"De: Crushing Blows cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CullingStrike\",\"D: Culling Strikes kill Normal enemies if their life is at 35% or below. Magic enemies are instead killed at 20%, Rare at 10% and Unique at 5%. These thresholds are checked before the damage of the Hit is applied.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CurrencyMaximumItem: You cannot use this currency on items above this level.
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"Curse\",\"Definitio:
Curses significantly Debuff affected targets. By default a target can have one Curse on them at a time.

Higher Rarity enemies are less affected by Curses:

15% less Curse effect on Magic monsters
30% less Curse effect on Rare monsters
50% less Curse effect on Unique monsters
entitySources.[\"KeywordPopups\",\"CyclonicRune\",\"De:
