entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_ac: The irrepressible spirit of the wilds burns within you, roaring to be let loose.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_al: Hope is a mistake. Pain is the only truth.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_an:
A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_au: A properly disciplined mind gives rise to structured thought.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_av: "In my dreams I see a great warrior, his skin scorched black, his fists aflame."
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_bl: Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_bu: In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_ch: Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_co: To me, brave companions! Feel my radiance flow through you!
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_cr: Each nick and cut brings death one step closer.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_da: You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_el:
What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?
Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_et: Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_fi:
Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_gh: I will wear your ghost, and you will die twice: against me, and for me.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_gi: The Titans did not vanish from this world. Their might lives on - in you.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_gl: Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_he: Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_ho: The body is a weapon waiting to be mastered.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_ig: All animals share common ancestors. You carry them within you still.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_ir: Why should I dodge blows that I do not fear?
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_lo: Strength begets respect. There is no simpler law.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_mi: While the mind endures, so too will the body.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_ne: I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_oa: The fewer there are, the less you have to share.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_pa:
Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_re: Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.
The notes may change, but the song remains the same.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_tw: Bonds forged in battle surpass ties of blood.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_un:
Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_va:
My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance
only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_wh: Your grandchildren will awaken screaming in memory of what I utter today.
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_wi:
The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves.
With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...
entitySources.[\"PassiveSkills\",\"passive_keystone_ze: Tear my flesh and splinter my bones. You will never break my spirit.

entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Blight&ArcaneSurge\": Grants a temporary buff after spending enough mana with Blight. The buff grants Blight more spell damage, and mana regeneration for sustaining casting.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Blight&ControlledDes: Grants more spell damage but reduces critical strike chance. However, Blight cannot critically hit meaning Controlled Destruction gives more spell damage with no drawbacks.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Blight&Efficacy\",\": Increases the damage over time and spell damage of Blight. The increased skill effect duration also increases the duration of Blight's debuff on enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Blight&IncreasedArea: Increases the area of effect of Blight allowing it to affect a greater number of targets at once.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Blight&IncreasedDura: Increases the duration of Blight's slow effect and chaos damage over time debuff on enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Blight&SwiftAfflicti: Decreases the total duration of Blight's debuff effect but compensates for this by increasing damage over time dealt by Blight.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Blight&VoidManipulat: Grants more chaos damage but lowers the elemental damage of Blight. Blight only deals chaos damage so Void Manipulation gives more damage at no drawback.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CausticArrow&LMP\",\:
Increases the amount of arrows Caustic Arrow fires, allowing it to cover a larger area by creating multiple patches of caustic ground at once.

At later levels, obtain the Greater Multiple Projectiles Support gem to affect enemies in a larger area.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CausticArrow&MirageA: When Caustic Arrow hits an enemy, an apparition is created above you that fires a copy of Caustic Arrow at enemies, at a reduced rate and with less damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CausticArrow&Pierce\: Allows projectiles from Caustic Arrow to travel through more enemies, creating multiple patches of caustic ground, dealing damage to more enemies simultaneously.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CausticArrow&Poison\: Gives a high chance for Caustic Arrow to inflict the poison ailment on hit. Poison deals chaos damage over time so it benefits from a lot of the same stats that Caustic Arrow's caustic ground does.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CausticArrow&SwiftAf: Decreases the duration of Caustic Arrow's ground effect, but compensates for this by increasing damage over time dealt.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CausticArrow&Vicious: Greatly increases both the physical damage from hits and chaos damage over time component of Caustic Arrow.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CausticArrow&VoidMan: Grants more chaos damage but lowers the elemental damage of Caustic Arrow. The Caustic ground effect only deals chaos damage, so Void Manipulation gives more damage at no drawback.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CausticArrow&Witheri: Grants extra chaos damage based on your physical damage. It also has a chance to inflict the Withered debuff which causes enemies to take 6% increased chaos damage per Wither stack (up to 15).
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Cleave&ChanceToBleed: Increases the chance of inflicting the bleed ailment on enemies with Cleave. Bleeding deals physical damage over time, with more damage dealt to moving targets. This support also adds a small amount of flat physical damage to Cleave.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Cleave&ConcentratedE: Reduces the area of effect while significantly increasing the area damage Cleave does. This makes it an excellent choice for difficult individual monsters.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Cleave&IncreasedArea: Increases the area of effect of Cleave allowing it to hit a greater number of targets at once.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Cleave&Maim\",\"Desc: Grants Cleave a chance to Maim enemies on hit. Maimed enemies have reduced movement speed and take increased physical damage. This support also gives more physical damage with Cleave.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Cleave&MeleePhysical: Grants more melee physical damage for Cleave. This support also increases the amount of damage inflicted bleeds and poisons do.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Cleave&Multistrike\": Causes Cleave to repeat an additional two times, as well as providing a large bonus to attack speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CobraLash&AddedChaos:
Add flat chaos damage to Cobra Lash, increasing the damage it deals when it hits enemies.

Increasing chaos damage of your hits also increases the damage of your poison, as strong hits with lots of chaos and physical damage also means stronger poisons.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CobraLash&DeadlyAilm:
Cause Cobra Lash to deal a great amount more poison damage, at the cost of slightly reduced hit damage.
This is valuable for applying strong poisons on enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CobraLash&LMP\",\"De:
Increase the number of Cobra Lash projectiles thrown, hitting multiple targets over a wider area. Each projectile will bounce between targets to hit large groups of enemies.

Obtain the Greater Multiple Projectiles Support gem at later levels to throw more projectiles and hit larger groups of enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CobraLash&Poison\",\: Increase Cobra Lash's chance to poison enemies and cause it to deal more poison damage. This is valuable for applying multiple deadly poisons on enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CobraLash&UnboundAil: Unbound Ailments causes Cobra Lash poison to deal more damage and to last longer on enemies. This is valuable for stacking lots of poison on strong enemies, like bosses.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"CobraLash&VileToxins: Vile Toxins increases the damage of Cobra Lash poison, and causes more damage when Cobra Lash hits poisoned enemies.This is valuable for stacking strong poisons and dealing more damage against powerful enemies, like bosses.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"DoubleStrike&Ancestr: Allows Double Strike to target two additional nearby enemies. Pairing this support with the Melee Splash support will result in large areas of overlapping damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"DoubleStrike&ChanceT: Increases the chance of inflicting the bleed ailment on enemies with Double Strike. Bleeding deals physical damage over time, with more damage dealt to moving targets. This support also adds a small amount of flat physical damage to Double Strike.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"DoubleStrike&Fortify: Applies a buff that reduces incoming damage from all hits, whilst also providing an increase to melee physical damage with Double Strike.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"DoubleStrike&MeleePh: Grants more melee physical damage for Double Strike. This support also increases the amount of damage inflicted bleeds and poisons do.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"DoubleStrike&MeleeSp: Allows your Double Strike hits to deal splash damage to nearby targets. Pairing this support with the Ancestral Call support will result in large areas of overlapping damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"DoubleStrike&Multist: Causes Double Strike to repeat an additional two times, as well as providing a large bonus to attack speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"EtheralKnives&Contro: Grants more spell damage to Ethereal Knives but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"EtheralKnives&Faster: Increases the cast speed of Ethereal Knives, allowing it to be used more frequently.

Increasing the projectile speed of Ethereal Knives increases how far the projectiles can travel. When paired with the Pierce support, Faster Projectiles will allow your projectiles to travel deeply through packs of mobs.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"EtheralKnives&Physic: Converts 50% of Ethereal Knives' physical damage to lightning damage, as well as providing extra lightning damage based on your physical damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"EtheralKnives&Pierce: Allows projectiles from Ethereal Knives to travel through extra numbers of enemies, ensuring that more enemies in a pack will be hit by the projectiles.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"EtheralKnives&SpellE: Repeats Ethereal Knives an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"ExplosiveTrap&Charge: Grants a chance to gain frenzy and power charges when your Explosive Trap is triggered by enemies. It also grants increased trap throwing speed per frenzy charge and increased critical strike multiplier per power charge.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"ExplosiveTrap&Cluste: Allows you to throw 2 additional Explosive Traps at once.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"ExplosiveTrap&Contro: Grants more spell damage to Explosive Trap but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"ExplosiveTrap&Elemen: Removes the ability for Explosive Trap to inflict elemental ailments, such as ignite, on enemies. However, it significantly increases the amount of elemental damage Explosive Trap does. Converting all physical damage from Explosive Trap to elemental damage maximizes the benefit this support provides.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"ExplosiveTrap&Physic: Converts 50% of Explosive Trap's physical damage to lightning damage, as well as providing extra lightning damage based on your physical damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"ExplosiveTrap&TrapMi: Grants more damage to your Explosive Trap. It also adds a small penalty to trap throwing speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&BurningDama: Greatly increases the damage over time dealt by ignites inflicted from Fireball.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&Combustion\: Gives Fireball more fire damage, additional chance to ignite enemies and reduces the fire resistance of ignited enemies. This makes it a great all-round support for any fire based skill.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&ControlledD: Grants more spell damage to Fireball but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&DeadlyAilme: Reduces the hit damage of Fireball in exchange for more ailment damage. This makes it particularly strong for Fireball characters that want to focus on scaling the damage over time of ignites.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&FirePenetra: Reduces enemy resistance to fire damage, making them take more fire damage from Fireball.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&IgniteProli: Increases the chance to inflict ignites on enemies with Fireball, whilst also enabling ignites to spread to nearby enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&LMP\",\"Des:
Increases the amount of projectiles Fireball casts, allowing it to hit more targets at once.

At later levels, obtain the Greater Multiple Projectiles Support gem to hit enemies in a larger area.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&SpellEcho\": Repeats Fireball an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Fireball&SwiftAfflic: Decreases the total duration of ignites on enemies but increases the damage that ignites deal, allowing your ignites to burn faster and stronger.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FreezingPulse&AddedC: Increases the amount of flat cold damage your Freezing Pulse does.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FreezingPulse&ColdPe: Reduces enemy resistance to cold damage, making them take more cold damage from Freezing Pulse.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FreezingPulse&Contro: Grants more spell damage to Freezing Pulse but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FreezingPulse&Faster: Increases Freezing Pulse's projectile speed, increasing the maximum distance that the projectiles travel. This allows Freezing Pulse to hit targets further away.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FreezingPulse&LMP\",:
Increases the amount of projectiles Freezing Pulse casts, allowing it to hit more targets at once.

At later levels, obtain the Greater Multiple Projectiles Support gem to hit enemies in a larger area.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FreezingPulse&SpellE: Repeats Freezing Pulse an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FreezingPulse&Volley: Increases the number of projectiles Freezing Pulse casts. Projectiles are in parallel to each other allowing a greater number of targets to be hit at once.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FrostBlades&Ancestra: Allows Frost Blades to target two additional nearby enemies. With at least three enemies nearby this can result in triple the amount of blade projectiles.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FrostBlades&ColdPene: Reduces enemy resistance to cold damage, making them take more cold damage from Frost Blades.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FrostBlades&Elementa: Multiplies the elemental damage done by Frost Blades. Converting all physical damage from Frost Blades to elemental damage maximizes the benefit this support provides.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FrostBlades&IceBite\:
Adds additional cold damage to Frost Blades, increasing freeze chance, and granting a chance to gain a Frenzy Charge on killing a frozen enemy.

Frenzy Charges increase a player's attack speed, cast speed and damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FrostBlades&MeleePhy: Grants more melee physical damage for Frost Blades. Because 60% of physical damage is converted to cold damage, this support will also increase the cold damage done by Frost Blades.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FrostBlades&Multistr: Causes Frost Blades to repeat an additional two times, as well as providing a large bonus to attack speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"FrostBlades&SlowerPr: Reduces the maximum range of Frost Blades projectiles, while also granting more damage with the blade projectiles.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostblink&BoneChill: Bonechill makes Frostblink's chill effect more potent, slowing enemies further to keep you safe. Enemies chilled by Frostblink also take more Cold Damage, making this valuable for your main skill if it deals cold damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostblink&Increased: Increase the size of Frostblink's cold explosion and chilled ground. This is valuable for damaging multiple enemies and leaving them slowed, unable to pursue you.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostbolt&AddedColdD: Increases the amount of flat cold damage your Frostbolt does.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostbolt&ColdPenetr: Reduces enemy resistance to cold damage, making them take more cold damage from Frostbolt.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostbolt&Controlled: Grants more spell damage to Frostbolt but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage not contingent on critical strikes.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostbolt&FasterCast: Increases the cast speed of Frost Bolt, allowing the projectiles to be cast more frequently.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostbolt&Hypothermi: Provides an increase to chill and freeze chance with Frostbolt, as well as providing more damage against chilled enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostbolt&SpellEcho\: Repeats Frostbolt an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Frostbolt&SpellTotem: Allows you to summon a totem that uses Frostbolt, freeing up your character to perform other actions. Can become exceeding powerful once your character gains abilities to summon multiple totems.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GalvanicArrow&Barrag:
Let loose a flurry of arrows with the Barrage support gem. With each Galvanic Arrow fired, lightning will burst from your bow.This will stop your arrows from firing in a cone, and instead make them fire in sequence.

This gem is invaluable for unleashing a flurry of attacks on strong enemies, like bosses.
Be careful using it in dangerous dangerous situations. You cannot move while firing, so you cannot escape dangerous enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GalvanicArrow&Elemen:
Increase Galvanic Arrow's elemental damage, hitting enemies harder for more damage.
This gem will not increase the physical damage dealt by Galvanic Arrow, but it will increase the lightning damage it deals. 

This gem is very good when paired with the Physical to Lightning support gem, as it will increase the full lightning damage dealt by Galvanic Arrow.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GalvanicArrow&Faster: Increase the size of Galvanic Arrow's lightning burst, and the speed of its arrows before they dissipate. This gem is invaluable for making your lightning burst bigger and your arrows fire further, hitting more enemies with each shot.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GalvanicArrow&Lightn:
Allow Galvanic Arrow's lightning damage to penetrate lightning resistance on enemies. This allows for more consistent damage against lightning-resistant enemies, such as Bosses, Rares, and Magic enemies.

This will not allow Galvanic Arrow's physical damage to penetrate resistance, as physical damage is unaffected by lightning resistance.
Monsters show if they are resistant to damage in their mods. Hover over monsters to see their mods.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GalvanicArrow&Mirage:
Summon a Mirage Archer above your head when Galvanic Arrow hits an enemy. This Mirage Archer will fire Galvanic Arrows at nearby enemies until it disappears.

This gem has many uses. Use it to attack enemies while you're moving, to attack enemies you're not facing, or to deal more damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GalvanicArrow&Physto:
This gem makes all of Galvanic Arrows physical damage turn to lightning damage. This causes Galvanic Arrow deal full lightning damage, instead of 50% lightning and 50% physical damage.

This gem makes it much easier to increase your damage. If you get any skills that increase your lighting or elemental damage, it will increase the full lightning damage dealt by Galvanic Arrow.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GlacialHammer&Ancest: Allows Glacial Hammer to target two additional nearby enemies. Pairing this support with the Melee Splash support will result in large areas of overlapping damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GlacialHammer&ColdPe: Cold Penetration reduces enemy resistance to cold damage, making them take more cold damage from Glacial Hammer.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"GlacialHammer&Hypoth: Increases Glacial Hammer's damage and freeze chance against enemies that are chilled. Also increases the slow effect of chills applied by your Glacial Hammer.

entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"KineticBolt&AddedCol: Add cold damage to Kinetic Bolt and its projectiles. A simple but valuable way to quickly kill enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"KineticBolt&AddedLig: Add lightning damage to Kinetic Bolt and its projectiles. A simple but valuable way to quickly kill enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"KineticBolt&Barrage\:
Fire a flurry of Kinetic Bolts in quick succession, damaging enemies consistently over a wide area. 

You cannot stop or move while firing. This gem improves damage but be careful not to get stuck taking damage while monsters attack you.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"KineticBolt&Elementa:
Increase the elemental damage dealt by Kinetic Bolt and its projectiles.

Kinetic Bolt doesn't inherently deal elemental damage. Added elemental damage can come from equipment (or from Added Lightning and Added Cold support gems). This gem can increase that damage to more quickly kill enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"KineticBolt&Inspirat:
Reduce the mana cost of using Kinetic Bolt. Also increase Kinetic Bolt's elemental damage and chance to critically strike with each attack.

entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"LightingTendrils&Add: Increases the amount of flat lightning damage your Lightning Tendrils does.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"LightingTendrils&Con: Grants more spell damage to Lightning Tendrils but reduces critical strike chance. The more spell damage provided by this support allows a direct and stable increase in damage, not contingent on critical strikes.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"LightingTendrils&Ele: Removes the ability for Lightning Tendrils to inflict elemental ailments, such as shock, on enemies. However, it significantly boosts Lightning Tendril's elemental damage.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"LightingTendrils&Lig: Reduces enemy resistance to lightning damage, making them take more lightning damage from Lightning Tendrils.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"LightningTendrils&Co: Reduces the area of effect of Lightning Tendrils but significantly increases the area damage Lightning Tendrils does. This makes it an excellent choice for difficult individual monsters.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"LightningTendrils&In: Increases the area of effect of Lightning Tendrils allowing it to hit a greater number of targets at once.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MagmaOrb&Combustion\: Gives Rolling Magma more fire damage, additional chance to ignite enemies and reduces the fire resistance of ignited enemies. This makes it a great all-round support for any fire based skill.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MagmaOrb&Empower\",\: Raises the gem level of Rolling Magma granting additional base fire damage and potentially allowing it to chain additional times. entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MagmaOrb&FasterCast\: Increases the cast speed of Rolling Magma, allowing the projectiles to be cast more frequently.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MagmaOrb&FirePenetra: Reduces enemy resistance to fire damage, making them take more fire damage from Rolling Magma.

entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MagmaOrb&SlowerProje: Increases Rolling Magma's damage and decreases the distance between each chain, allowing one orb to impact on a pack of monsters multiple times.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MagmaOrb&SpellEcho\": Repeats Rolling Magma an additional time while also greatly increasing the cast speed.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MoltenStrike&Ancestr: Allows Molten Strike to target two additional nearby enemies. With at least three enemies nearby this can result in triple the amount of molten projectiles.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MoltenStrike&Concern: Reduces the spread of Molten Strike's projectiles while greatly increasing the area damage they deal. This makes it ideal for formidable individual monsters.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"MoltenStrike&Element: Multiplies the elemental damage done by Molten Strike. Converting all physical damage from Molten Strike to elemental damage maximizes the benefit this support provides.

entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Perforate&Brutality\:

Try not to get any modifiers that grant lightning, fire, cold or chaos damage with this support gem. Only physical damage will be increased by this gem.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Perforate&CloseComba:
Close Combat improves your damage against monsters close to you. As Perforate only hits nearby enemies (without Sand stance), this support is a valuable way to increase your damage.

Travel Skills are also quicker after you hit enemies with this gem. Travel skills move you quickly to avoid danger.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Perforate&Impale\",\:
Deal more physical damage and Impale enemies with the Impale debuff.

Impaling enemies stores some of your damage on the enemy. For the next 5 hits on that enemy you deal extra stored damage. You can impale the same enemy more than once for extra damage from attacks.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Perforate&Maim\",\"D: Support Perforate with this gem to Maim enemies, dealing more physical damage and slowing their movement. Use this to slow monsters and make them easier to avoid.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Perforate&MeleePhysi: This gem causes Perforate to deal more damage. A simple but invaluable way to quickly kill enemies.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Perforate&Multistrik:
Greatly increase Perforate's attacking speed by performing three attacks in quick succession, dealing more damage on the second and third attacks.

You cannot stop or move while multistriking. This gem greatly improves damage but be careful not to get stuck while monsters damage you.

entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"Steelskin&CWDT\",\"D:
Automatically cast Steelskin after taking damage. This is valuable for defending against surprise attacks.

Power charges increases your chance to critically strike for high damage each charge (up to a maximum of 3).
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"StormblastMine&Conce:
Concentrated Effect makes your Stormblast explosions smaller, causing more damage in a tighter area.
This means they can hit less enemies but they deal more damage to the enemies they hit.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"StormblastMine&Incre: Increased Area of Effect makes your Stormblast Mine explosions wider, so they can hit more enemies. It also means Stormblast Mine can cause more enemies to take increased damage before exploding.
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"StormblastMine&Light:
Allows Stormblast mine's lightning damage to penetrate lightning resistance. This allows for more consistent damage against lightning-resistant enemies, such as Bosses, Rares, and Magic enemies.

entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"StormblastMine&Swift: While Swift Assembly supports Stormblast Mine, throwing a Mine grants a chance to throw additional mines. More mines means more Stormblast Explosions
entitySources.[\"SkillGemInfo\",\"StormblastMine&Trap&:

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet12.Fanatics are the most dangerous enemy,\n:
狂信者乃最危險的敵人，
畢竟他們棄自身安危於不顧。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet13.Forge your Perseverance on the Anvil of: 讓那信仰的鐵砧將你無比的毅力千錘百煉。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet14.Let the unrepentant be dragged ever down: 死不悔改的罪人被他們沉重的罪孽拉下地獄深處。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet15_.Mindless rage will shake the world,\nCun:
盲目怒火，將撼動世界，
狡詐謊言，將扭曲世界。
魯莽急躁，將粉碎世界，
並將其送入黑暗之界。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet16.He knew not why he was changing, only\nt:
他無從得知自己改變的原因，
只曉得自己想常伴家人左右……

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet17.The homeguard signalled for aid against:
守衛發出突襲支援信號，
但並非由部下回應。
索拉萊親自迎戰。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet18.Tale-women in training drink of a painfu:
說書女在熟習過程中啜飲沙漠之果。
她們學到火焰生於苦痛。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet1.A hearth unyielding, ever warm,\nA light:
屹立不搖的火爐，永不失去溫暖，
無堅不摧的光芒，無止境地重生。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet20.When Kabala the Serpent Queen was banish:
蛇后卡巴拉自凱斯驅逐後，
眾絲克瑪謹以一名人質作為懲戒。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet22.Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke th:
丹尼格雕琢著維里西姆，使其呈現出密登加德
漆黑高峰上的夜蓮姿態；
那種蓮花僅生長於灰燼、白雪與星光交匯之處。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet23.To stray is to condemn this world to sin: 偏離正道，便是將這世界推入罪孽。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet2.Worship of house gods was tolerated\nin:
在奧瑞亞，只要私下進行，
家神的崇拜是被默許的。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet3.What they saw was what they believed, an:
他們盡信雙眼所見，
常道月神尚留悲憫於世。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet6.Forged from the blood of countless wars,:
以無數戰事的鮮血鑄成，
對死亡的飢渴油然而生。

自然的恩惠出自誕生，而非獲取。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet8.The respect of Karui warriors is hard to:
卡魯戰士的尊重極難贏得，
但一旦獲得，便會持續一生……甚至超越生死。

item-flavour:FourUniqueAmulet9.You are slow, foolish and ignorant.\nI a:
你既緩慢、愚蠢又無知。

我則不然。

會流血只代表你還活著。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt12.All creatures have the potential for gre:
一切生物皆有潛力成就偉業，
當然失敗的潛力也不在話下。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt13.Death is your most important duty.\nFace:
死亡是你最重要的任務。
接受它，或是永世詛咒你的血繼。

切莫招惹戴有飾物的法師。

巧秒之技並非總是錯綜複雜。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt18_.\"A man's soul rules from a cavern of bo:
"骨骼是靈魂的居所，
血肉是精神和世界交流的窗口， 推動一切的力量就在心窩。
即使有了這些，失去了頭腦就沒有自我。"
- 岡姆軍師拉維安加

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt19.A Templar thinks he's righteous for flog:
聖殿騎士每鞭打別人十下，
就鞭打自己一下，便以為自己正義。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt1.Kaom's strength was rivaled only by\nthe:
岡姆的勇猛威震天下，
唯有北方的梅吉諾德能與他一較高下。

讓神祕躍然於世。循環往復。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt23.Kulemak sat triumphant, raising the crow:
骷髏馬克洋洋得意地坐下，高舉王冠。
黑暗將世界縈繞成了永夜。
勝利，僅在一瞬間，轟然倒塌。
此刻不再有征服者和被征服者之分，惟存炙熱的光芒。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt24.Rivers of power coursed through their ve:
強大的力量曾如江河般在他們的血管中奔流。
如今，無論福禍，這股力量已盡歸你所有。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt2.Adversity is the soil in\nwhich persiste: 逆境是滋養毅力成長的土壤。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt3.Below all living things,\nthere exists a:
在眾生萬物之下，
存在著一股流轉不息的力量……

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt4.\"The power of rebirth rivals that of im:
"重生之力堪比長生不老。"
- 伊席厄斯．普蘭德斯，古物收藏家，物品編號 3

有些家族，擁有極其奇特的……天賦。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt6.The Brinerot sail without fear of storms: 布琳洛特無懼風暴揚帆起航。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBelt8.Vaal bloodpriests were among the earlies:
瓦爾血祭師，知識的先行者。
靈魂竭盡其能，依偎於任何生命。
正是由血祭師們所發現。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex10.Shedding away her regal past,\nshe forge:
褪去了過往皇室的華服，
她鍛造了新的宿命。
犧牲了凡人轉瞬即逝的歡愉，
她擁抱了自然永恆的掌握。
奪得了她唯一真正的宿願，
她終於尋得了平靜。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex11.Feed a beast and it will not hunt.\nProt:
餵養一頭野獸，牠便不再狩獵；
保護牠，牠便不再戰鬥。
野性必須學習而得，而非教導。
苦難才能鑄就最偉大的戰士。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex15.Hyrri loosed a barrage of arrows,\ntippe:
西里射出一道弓箭的彈幕，
箭簇抹上了惡毒的仇恨，
在壓迫的歲月中醞釀而成。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex16.\"The boy is a bad omen,\" he cried. \"R:
"這孩子是不祥之兆！"他喊道。
"渡鴉都聚集在他面前！"
當晚，一隻新的渡鴉出現，
從此以後，它就一直尾隨著這位觀鳥者。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex1.When cornered and desperate, look within: 面臨四面楚歌的絕望境地時，探求內心的怒火以擺脫困境。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex2.To catch an animal, think like an animal: 瞭解你的獵物，才能駕馭你的獵矛。

橡樹雖已枯萎，依舊永世屹立。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex5.\"I carry neither food nor drink. I rely:
"我不會前去尋水覓食，
畢竟還有那斷了氣的同伴遺愛人世。"
- 野人塔盧克

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex6.Wraeclast has suffered many great disast:
瓦爾克拉斯曾歷經無數浩劫
但生命總能重新萌芽

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDex7.The truth lies inside every man, if you:
每個人的背後都藏著一份真實，
只要你挖的夠深。
坦白都藏於那真實的最深處。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDexInt13.Curse their vile Council,\nThey cast me:
這群達官顯要實在歹毒。
他們對我的力量一無所知，
便棄我如敝屣。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDexInt14.A gift from the Draíocht, lost in Darkne:
魔幻的饋贈，迷失於黑暗之中。
青銅嗡鳴。布料輕嘆。
她活生生的碎片，渴望著存在。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDexInt1.\"Prepare the rack, boy. And be careful:
"小子，準備好刑架。還有小心那些鉤子！"
- 刑求大師最後的遺言

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDexInt2.It was in this forsaken land, where mist:
在這片被遺棄的土地、霧氣籠罩的神秘世界，
盜賊、殺人者和放逐者在這裡尋求庇護。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDexInt3.Born among the high peaks, many Mutewind:
許多啞風族誕生於高山之巔
一輩子生活於在冰雪之中

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyDexInt6.Mortality is a curse.\nThe cure is simpl:
壽命是一種詛咒。
解藥很簡單。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyInt12.Reap what others have sown\nMuster them:
其戰鬥的狂熱不滅，
即使澎湃的熱血早已枯竭；
行進的腳步不絕於耳，
在永生中仍為你奮戰不懈。

item-flavour:FourUniqueBodyInt13.When the throat roars,\nAs eyes weep,\nW:
喉嚨嘶吼，
雙眼淚流，
兩手緊握，

item-flavour:FourUniqueStaff5.Burn to cinders, scar and maim,\nRule a:
燃為灰燼，崩裂焚解；
斯是霸權，立於火焰。

破碎的事物仍逃不過毀壞的命運。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTalisman10.\"A traditional hatungo does not carry a:
"傳統的靈語者確實不攜帶戰斧。
但正如那魯莫阿向我們展示的那樣，
粉碎敵人的方法，可不止一種……"

item-flavour:FourUniqueTalisman14.Gruthkul was the Mother of Despair...\nb:
葛魯斯寇曾是絕望之母……
但終有一日，那位"父親"將會歸來，
並親眼見證他子嗣們的命運。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTalisman1.A sensitive few among the first settlers:
艾茲麥最初的移民之中，有幾名敏感之人乘獨木舟跟隨著魂靈而行。
在那座迷霧瀰漫、林木蒼翠的小島上，塔斯的西瑞爾正等著迎接他們。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTalisman2.If you see the blushing tree of the nort:
如果你在北方樹林中看到那棵泛紅的樹，
請記住："紅花開，樹已飽餐。
白花開，準備開戰。"

item-flavour:FourUniqueTalisman4.In a time of great need, surrounded by A:
在極度艱危之時，被深淵族重重包圍之刻，
迷途德魯伊曾助太陽氏族一臂之力。
這份恩情，他們從未忘記。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTalisman8.Long ago, the witches of the Azak Tribe:
久遠以前，阿札克部族的女巫習得
如何汲取奔湧的鮮活生命力，
以"合作"之名……強制敵人與其同調。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace10.\"Drunken Erqi boasted to Tukohama; the:
"酩酊大醉的爾奇向戰爭之神圖克哈馬誇口，而神則向他發起了力量的挑戰。
神明啊，真是不幸——祂本該發起一場技巧的考驗！"

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace13.The secret Order endured by publicly\npr:
秘密的教團透過公開祈禱忍受著，
然而聖堂武僧卻對其予取予求，
終有一天，正義會降臨在他們身上……

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace14.Infinite mutations over endless eons bor: 無盡永劫間的無限變異，皆在轉瞬之間降臨其身。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace1.There was a very clear and delicious\nre:
艾茲麥人選擇不再逃亡，
並定居在法瑞爾，
原因非常明顯且誘人。

"碎骨濺血之聲
豈非天籟悅耳之音？"
- 艾茲麥人雷姆諾

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace3.The art of surgery advances one mistake: 外科手術的技藝隨著每次的失敗更加進步。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace4.The mind may have no limits, but the sku: 心靈或許沒有極限，但頭顱肯定有。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace5.Secrecy and silence are powers all their: 秘密和沉默的力量源於己身。

別被人類的陰謀給欺騙。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace7.The faithful may continue to serve, even: 信眾虔誠甚篤，即便死後依舊為神服事。

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace8.\"The finest prosperity grows from the d:
"最美好的繁榮誕生自最可怕的
毀滅。這就是進步的本質。"
- 瓦爾的多里亞尼

item-flavour:FourUniqueTwoHandMace9.The sea strikes the rock relentlessly.\n:
海浪無情地拍打著岩石。
不管是短短一天，還是漫長千年，
岩石終將粉碎，
而海洋之王的領域也會越來越龐大。

item-flavour:FourUniqueUltimatum1.Man retains sanity and strives toward ci:
人類保持理智並努力奔向文明
卻是被掩蓋在蒙祝福的無知之幕下。

item-flavour:FourUniqueUltimatum2.The most horrifying ideas often begin wi: 最可怕的想法往往始於簡單的創新。

item-flavour:FourUniqueUltimatum3.The Banished Architect sought to employ: 被放逐的設計師意圖運用瓦爾最黑暗的秘密。

item-flavour:FourUniqueUltimatum4.The first Karui born on the fringes of t: 第一批在瓦爾帝國邊緣地帶出生的卡魯人因腐化而患上血熱病。

item-flavour:FourUniqueWand15.In that moment, Viridi's bones became\nb:
在那一瞬間，維里迪的骨骼化作枝幹，
在黑暗之上交織穿梭。
她環繞著虛無盤旋而上，
用她的一切，將那片無物之境囚禁其中。

item-flavour:FourUniqueWand16.Smithed from ancient metal\nwrought from:
對能駕馭它的人而言，這是一種
召喚夜空本身的手段。

item-flavour:FourUniqueWand1.With a flick of the finger, their fates:
毫筆輕揮，他們的命運便已寫就，
頃刻間化為千萬泡影。

item-flavour:FourUniqueWand2.One way or another, it will find what it: 不論用什麼方式，它都會找到它所追求的東西。

item-flavour:FourUniqueWand3.From the smallest seeds\nTo the tallest:
至微者，須彌芥子
至偉者，參天神木，
無論微偉，皆可立足帝陸。

item-flavour:FourUniqueWand4.Adonia rose with eyes afire, emanating a:
艾多尼亞的雙眼迸出詭異的光芒，從寶座殿牆上的雕像現身：
"你認為沒有了法杖，我就一無是處？你膽敢再汙辱我！"

item-flavour:FourUniqueWand5.He alone was welcome in the sacred space: 孑然一身的他為泰坦聖地所接納。

item-flavour:FourUniqueWand7.Lost in the Black Fen, Erian hoped that:
埃里安迷失在黑色沼澤中，企盼黎明能拯救他。
他絲毫不知道，光明究竟還有多麼遙遠。

item-flavour:VaalLimbReplacements.\"Behold! A marvel of innovation! Pay no:
"看哪！創新的奇蹟！"
"至於血肉的代價——不必放在心上……"
——血肉建築師．瓜特利斯
